name: Wrenna Vael
title: the Drowned Cartographer
team_job: Long-range flood artillery. Anything your frontline stuns or roots in place, Wrenna drowns for double damage.

basic.name: Street Vial
basic.cast: UAL OVERHAND_THROW retimed to an underhand lob: her left hand thumbs the cork off a vial on the bandolier at her hip, and her right hand lobs it from hip height with a flick of the wrist. Her head tilts so the sextant monocle lines up with the target.
basic.projectile: A corked glass vial of green-black seawater with a tiny paper street label tied to the neck (Tanner's Row, Lamplight Steps, Kelp Market). The vial spins end over end and the water sloshes inside: a two-layer mesh with an animated inner liquid plane.
basic.flight: High arc, 14 m/s, apex 2.5 m. Droplets fall from the open neck along the way, and a thin dotted ink line is drawn on the ground under the arc like a route on a chart (decal ribbon, fades in 0.6 s). Sound: glass clink, slosh, then a gull-like squeak of the cork.
basic.impact: The glass bursts into a 2 m crown splash of seawater with salt-foam lace at the rim. It leaves a wet ground decal printed with faint depth soundings (small numbers and a compass tick) that dries out from the edges over 1.5 s.
basic.target_reaction: The target flinches back and turns its face away from the splash. It is now Soaked: a glossy darkened wet-sheen shader on the body, with water dripping from the elbows and chin (2 drip emitters on hand and head bones).
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, splash radius 2 m, 1.0x BA, 1.1 attacks/s. Applies Soaked for 3 s.
basic.telegraph: Enemies see a small red-rimmed landing circle 0.35 s before impact.
basic.team_use: Soaked marks targets for the whole team: Wrenna's Sounding deals +30% to Soaked targets, and Kallix's fire cannot ignite Soaked targets, so call it.

basic.name: Brackish Pair
basic.cast: Mirror of hit 1 with the other hand: she uncorks two vials at once with her teeth-side hand and lobs them so they leave the hand 0.12 s apart. Base UAL OVERHAND_THROW mirrored, with a slight hop at the start.
basic.projectile: Two smaller vials with their labels fluttering. One is clear seawater, the other cloudy with harbour silt (a brown-green tint), so the pair reads as two different streets.
basic.flight: Two slightly offset arcs at 14 m/s that land 0.7 m apart, side by side. Twin dotted ink routes cross on the ground like a navigator's cross-bearing. Sound: a double clink, a beat apart.
basic.impact: Two overlapping 1.6 m splashes. Where they overlap, the decal shows a crossed X like a fix on a chart.
basic.target_reaction: A stumble back half a step. A target already Soaked gets a second drip layer and slows 10% for 1 s.
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, each splash radius 1.6 m, 0.65x BA per vial (1.3x if both hit).
basic.team_use: The cross-bearing X shows allied artillery (Hespera, Ourax's militia) where a slow, wet target will be standing.

basic.name: Depth Charge
basic.cast: She pulls the heaviest vial from the strap across her chest, raises it to eye level and peers at the target through the sextant monocle for 0.2 s (additive head tilt and right-hand hold), then heaves it overhead. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW with a 0.2 s pose hold at the top.
basic.projectile: A fat squat bottle wrapped in fishing twine with a lead sounding weight tied to its base, so it falls bottom-first.
basic.flight: Tall arc, 12 m/s, apex 3.5 m. The bottle turns to drop bottom-first on the way down, trailing a knotted sounding line (ribbon with knot sprites every 0.5 m). Sound: a low whistle that drops in pitch as it falls.
basic.impact: It lands, sits for 0.3 s while the fathom knots tick, then erupts as a 1.8 m tall geyser column of seawater (cylinder mesh with a scrolling water shader and a foam crown flipbook). It leaves a 2.5 m puddle decal for 2 s.
basic.target_reaction: The target is launched in a short knock-up (0.4 s), arms flung up, and lands on its back foot. It gets Soaked plus a ring of salt crust on its boots for 1 s (slowed 20%).
basic.numbers: Range 10 m, radius 2.5 m, 1.6x BA, knock-up 0.4 s, slow 20% for 1 s.
basic.telegraph: Red-rimmed circle with three fathom ticks that count down over 0.3 s.
basic.team_use: The knock-up is long enough for Hob's Founder's Hammer or Lysandra's charged Chisel Split to land cleanly on the airborne target.

skills.name: Sounding
skills.cast: She swings a lead plumb-bob on a knotted line from her belt twice around her hand (UAL Spell_Simple_Enter with the right arm replaced by a sling loop) and casts it. Her map tattoos flare along her forearm as the line pays out.
skills.projectile: A lead sounding weight on a knotted rope. Where it lands it plants a compass-rose decal on the ground: a brass-gold rose with depth numbers around the rim.
skills.flight: A fast flat arc at 18 m/s. The rope ribbon follows it from her hand and snaps loose on landing. On the ground, the compass rose fills with water from the rim inward over 3 s while its numbers tick down 3, 2, 1 fathoms. Sound: the creak of a ship's timber, then a rising sea swell.
skills.impact: After 3 s the sea comes back: a 4 m wide column of green water erupts and crashes outward in a ring wave (ring mesh with a vertex-offset wave and a foam flipbook rim). It leaves Flooded ground for 4 s: a dark teal decal with drowned cobblestones showing under the water, which slows enemies.
skills.target_reaction: Caught enemies are slammed down and back, away from the centre (0.35 s stagger) and Soaked. Flooded ground shows on them as water lapping up to the shins (a height-clamped wet mask on the legs).
skills.numbers: Cast range 11 m, radius 4 m, 3.0x BA, delay 3 s, cooldown 9 s. Flooded ground lasts 4 s and slows 25%. Double damage on Stunned or Rooted enemies, +30% on Soaked.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see the compass rose with a red rim and a visible countdown. Allies see it in teal with a soft white outline.
skills.team_use: The squad's job is to keep someone on the rose for 3 s. Hob's seventh toll, Corrin's roots, Moss's maze box, Sena's Knot and Aurvan's Tidal Pull all turn Sounding into a double-damage flood.

skills.name: Rip Current
skills.cast: She drags a black-tipped finger down her tattooed forearm, tracing the seabed route, then flings the hand out along the ground. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with a low crouched lean, the casting arm swept horizontally.
skills.projectile: A 10 m by 2.5 m current lane: a scrolling decal of map lines with arrowheads and running foam streaks.
skills.flight: Appears instantly along the aimed line and scrolls in the cast direction at 6 m/s. Floating paper street labels and kelp ribbons ride the current. Sound: a rushing undertow.
skills.impact: Enemies standing in the lane are dragged 4 m along it over 1 s, then dropped. The lane fades after 3 s, leaving a wet streak decal.
skills.target_reaction: Dragged enemies skid with their feet sliding, arms windmilling (UAL SLIDE clip on the victim, driven by the lane), and kelp wraps their ankles as a sprite overlay.
skills.numbers: Length 10 m, width 2.5 m, lasts 3 s, displacement 4 m over 1 s, cooldown 12 s. Allies moving with the current get +35% move speed.
skills.telegraph: Red-rimmed lane for enemies with arrows showing the drag direction. Allies see a teal lane with soft white arrows.
skills.team_use: Aim it at your own Sounding to wash enemies onto the rose, or behind your squad as an escape conveyor. Wrenna rides it too (+35% speed).

passive.name: Tidemark
passive.effect: Her hits apply Soaked. Every 4th hit on a Soaked enemy takes 1 s off Sounding's cooldown. Below 30% HP her vials splash 25% wider, because the sea is pulling her closer.
passive.tell: The seabed map tattoos visibly crawl along her arms toward the nearest Soaked enemy. The brass sextant on her brow turns to show how close she is to death, and its lens slowly fills with seawater as her HP drops, so allies can read her health at a glance.

super.name: The Night Lirr Sank
super.style: Ground zone into tidal wave (line push)
super.cast: She pulls every vial from the bandolier and both coat pockets, a fan of seven bottles between her fingers. She holds them overhead, uncorks them all with one sweep of the thumb, and pours them out in front of her.
super.projectile: Seven streams of seawater, one per street of Lirr, that pool into ghost-blue outlines of the drowned city's streets and rooftops on the ground (a decal atlas of the Lirr street map), then lift into a 14 m wide tidal wave carrying the half-transparent silhouettes of fishing boats.
super.flight: First the map unrolls forward along the ground over 0.8 s. Then the wave rises 3 m and travels 16 m in the aimed direction at 12 m/s, curling forward with foam spray and gulls (sprite flock). Sound: a harbour bell muffled underwater, then a roar.
super.impact: Everything it passes is left as Flooded ground for 5 s. Where the wave hits a wall, terrain or another hero's structure, it breaks in a huge white foam burst and stops there.
super.target_reaction: Enemies are swept up and carried, tumbling, until the wave ends or hits a wall. A carry that ends against terrain stuns for 1.2 s, and the victims stay Soaked with kelp and paper labels stuck to them.
super.numbers: Width 14 m, travel 16 m, 4.5x BA to each enemy hit plus 1.5x if slammed into terrain, displacement up to 8 m, wall-stun 1.2 s, Flooded ground 5 s.
super.telegraph: The street map unrolling on the ground is a 1.2 s warning. Enemies see a red-rimmed horizon line across the wave's path.
super.team_use: Allies inside the wave ride it (Riding the Tide): they are carried at the same speed with a 1.0x BA shield and can still act. Aim it at a Moss maze wall, Camedown's stair or Pyrrhos's boulder to turn the push into a team stun.
super.cinematic: The camera dips slightly as Wrenna fans out seven vials. A close shot of her face shows the sextant arm spinning wildly. She uncorks them all and pours, and the ground in front of her becomes Lirr: ghost-blue streets, harbour steps, a church roof. For one second the whole street map lies flat on the arena floor. Then the sea that took it stands up as a wall of green water full of the outlines of fishing boats and rolls forward. Where it meets stone it breaks white, and anyone carried into that stone is left lying in kelp and wet paper labels.
super.charge: Charge is measured in Fathoms: +1 for each Soaked enemy hit by a basic, +4 for each enemy caught in Sounding, +8 for a Sounding on a Stunned or Rooted enemy. 100 Fathoms fills the super. On her body, the tattoos fill with glowing teal ink from the fingertips up to the collarbone. On the HUD, the super button is a sextant whose arc fills.
super.counterplay: 1.2 s windup with the street map unrolling as a giant warning. The wave stops at terrain, so any wall, stair or boulder behind you is safe ground. Dash sideways out of the 14 m width. Wrenna is rooted for 2 s while she pours.

beats.vfx: Tattoos flare teal. The street map decal unrolls forward from her feet.
beats.prop: 7-vial fan prop on the right hand bone, 2 vials on the left.
beats.sound: Corks popping in sequence; a muffled underwater harbour bell.

beats.tweak: Both arms sweep down and forward to pour, the torso pitched forward, one foot stepping in.
beats.vfx: Seven water streams (ribbons) pour onto the map. The wave mesh rises behind the map.
beats.prop: Vial fan props emptied (inner liquid planes scaled to zero).
beats.sound: A deep inhale of sea wind, rising to a roar.

beats.tweak: Hold the pose while the wave travels. Her hair and coat hem blow forward (vertex wind shader on the hem only).
beats.vfx: Wave travels 16 m with a foam rim flipbook, boat silhouettes and a gull flock. Foam burst wherever it meets terrain.

beats.tweak: She drops to one knee and wrings out her sleeve, then rises.
beats.vfx: Drips from her sleeves. The tattoo glow fades back to the passive state.
beats.prop: Empty vials vanish back to the bandolier.
beats.sound: Trickling water; a single distant bell.

locomotion: Waterlogged walk: a slightly heavy heel strike with the coat hem swinging late (cloth weight faked by a vertex wind shader on the hem). Her run leans forward with her left hand clamped over the vial bandolier so it doesn't clink. Base: UAL Jog_Fwd_Loop with an additive left-arm hold.
idle: Checks the sextant by tapping it with one fingertip, traces a tattoo line moving on her forearm, and once in a while tilts her head to shake water out of one ear. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with additive arm and head layers.
hit: A sharp flinch back with water spurting from her mouth and collar (a 6-frame flipbook) and the sextant lens fogging for 0.3 s. Base: UAL Hit_Chest.
death: She drops to her knees, then falls forward. Her body dissolves into a spreading puddle of seawater (dissolve shader into a puddle decal) with the map tattoos floating on its surface as ink lines. The brass sextant is left lying on the wet ground and clicks to zero. Base: UAL Death01 with a dissolve from 0.6 s.
victory: She unrolls a chart (prop scroll), marks an X on it with an inky fingertip, then looks out to sea through the sextant. Base: UAL Interact retimed into Idle_Loop.

name: Hob Tallagh
title: the Bellwright
team_job: A stun clock everyone can wind: every hit from Hob or his squad tolls, and the seventh toll freezes the fight.

basic.name: Clapper Jab
basic.cast: A short left jab driven from the shoulder. The bronze bracer's bell-mouth nozzle points at the target. Base: UAL Punch_Jab with the fist held 1 frame on contact.
basic.projectile: A visible bronze sound-ring: a thin torus that pops out of the bracer's bell-mouth at the fist, flecked with verdigris chips.
basic.flight: The ring expands from 0.3 m to 1.4 m over 0.2 s, travelling 2.2 m forward from the fist, with green dust shed from its rim. Sound: a short, bright toll (pitch C).
basic.impact: A puff of bronze dust and a ring-shaped ripple pressed into the target's armour. There is no ground decal.
basic.target_reaction: The head snaps back 10 degrees and the body rocks back on its heels. A small bronze ring appears orbiting above the head as the first toll counter.
basic.numbers: Range 2.2 m, 1.0x BA, 1.4 hits/s. +1 toll.
basic.team_use: Every toll counter is shared, so allies hitting the same target keep the count climbing.

basic.name: Clapper Cross
basic.cast: A right cross with a full hip turn; the cracked helmet dips with the punch. Base: UAL Punch_Cross.
basic.projectile: A double sound-ring, two concentric bronze tori a beat apart, with verdigris flecks spinning off.
basic.flight: Rings expand to 1.6 m over 0.25 s, 2.4 m forward. Sound: two tolls a third apart (C, E).
basic.impact: A bronze dust burst. The second ring's ripple is visible on the ground for 0.4 s.
basic.target_reaction: A twist away from the punch (a rotational stagger). A second ring joins the orbit above the head.
basic.numbers: Range 2.4 m, 1.1x BA. +1 toll.
basic.team_use: Fast toll building for the seventh-toll stun.

basic.name: Founder's Hammer
basic.cast: Both fists come up over the helmet, clasped, and slam into the ground. Hold the top of the windup 0.15 s. Base: UAL Sword_Attack overhead slash with empty clasped hands, blended with MELEE_JUMP_LAND for the impact crouch.
basic.projectile: A bell-shaped shockwave: a translucent bronze dome (half-bell mesh) that rises 1 m from the impact point and then cracks along one seam.
basic.flight: The dome rises and expands to 2.5 m over 0.3 s, then a jagged crack runs up its side and it shatters into bronze shards. Sound: a deep bell clang followed by a cracked buzz, the sound of a flawed bell.
basic.impact: A radial crack decal with green verdigris staining in the seams, lasting 2 s.
basic.target_reaction: Enemies are knocked back 1.5 m and look dazed, hands to their ears. A third ring joins the toll orbit.
basic.numbers: Radius 2.5 m, 1.5x BA, knock-back 1.5 m. +1 toll on everyone hit.
basic.telegraph: A 0.25 s bronze glow at Hob's fists before the slam.
basic.team_use: AoE toll building: one slam on three enemies is three tolls of progress.

skills.name: Casting Pour
skills.cast: Hob grabs a founder's ladle from the rope belt at his hip (prop, attached to the right hand bone) and sweeps it in a low arc, flinging molten bronze. Base: UAL HARVEST swing (a farming scythe sweep) retimed 20% faster.
skills.projectile: Molten bronze droplets, glowing orange-gold, that cool to green-brown as they fly.
skills.flight: A 70-degree cone, 6 m, at 15 m/s. Each blob trails smoke and a heat shimmer (refraction sprite), and the colour shifts from #F2C14E to #3E8C77 over the flight. Sound: a hiss, then hammer taps.
skills.impact: Bronze splatters harden on the ground into a rough metal crust decal for 3 s.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies hit are Rooted: a bronze shell climbs up their feet to the ankles (a height-masked metallic shader) and their legs lock in place.
skills.numbers: Cone 6 m by 70 degrees, 1.4x BA, Root 1.2 s, cooldown 10 s. +1 toll per enemy hit.
skills.telegraph: A red-rimmed cone flashes 0.2 s before the throw.
skills.team_use: Rooted counts as hard CC for Wrenna's Sounding (double damage) and keeps targets inside Hespera's Dusk ring.

skills.name: The Cracked Bell
skills.cast: Hob grips his helmet with both hands and bows his head toward the target area as if pointing the bell at it. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with both hands held to the helmet.
skills.projectile: A giant spectral bronze bell, 5 m across, with a jagged crack down one side, dropped from the sky.
skills.flight: It drops straight down from 8 m in 0.35 s, swinging slightly. Sound: a whoosh, then a deafening low clang.
skills.impact: The bell lands and stays for 2.5 s as a solid ring wall. Inside, a ring of verdigris stains the ground. Hits on the outside of the bell ring it.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies inside are Deafened for 1 s (silenced: musical notes crossed out above their heads, hands to ears), then trapped. Allies inside see a warm amber interior and are shielded from projectiles.
skills.numbers: Range 7 m, radius 2.5 m, lasts 2.5 s, silence 1 s, cooldown 14 s. Every hit any ally lands on the bell's outside adds +1 toll to every enemy inside.
skills.telegraph: A red-rimmed bell shadow grows on the ground for 0.35 s.
skills.team_use: Drop it on a diver to trap them while the squad beats on the bell to stack seven tolls, or drop it on your own carry as an emergency projectile shelter.

passive.name: Seven Tolls
passive.effect: Every hit Hob lands adds a toll to the target. Allies' hits on a target that already has at least one toll also add a toll (once per 0.5 s per ally). On the seventh toll, the target and every enemy within 3 m are stunned for 1.5 s and the counter resets.
passive.tell: The crack in his helmet glows from dull to bright gold as tolls build on his current target, and verdigris on his skin brightens. Enemies wear a ring of small bronze rings orbiting the head, one per toll, which turn red at six.

super.name: Saint Ennick's Last Note
super.cast: Hob raises both arms and the great bell of Saint Ennick descends over him. He headbutts its rim with his bell helmet, the one true note he has spent thirty years trying to find.
super.projectile: The great bell, a ghostly bronze bell 9 m tall with a crack down one side, plus the note itself: a vast expanding sound-ring with a wedge-shaped gap where the crack splits it.
super.flight: The ring rolls out from Hob to 10 m over 0.6 s. It is a flat torus with musical staff lines etched into it and verdigris dust shed behind it. The 40-degree gap faces the direction the crack points (aimed by the player during the windup). Sound: a perfect, pure bell note with no buzz, the first time Hob's bell has ever rung true.
super.impact: Every surface in the ring vibrates (a camera shake of 0.15 s). It leaves a 10 m soft green ring decal of staff lines that fades over 3 s.
super.target_reaction: Enemies fall Asleep: their eyes close and their heads drop forward, swaying (a sleep pose layer on the victim), with a slow bronze note glyph drifting up over them. Sleep is broken by damage after the first 1 s.
super.numbers: Radius 10 m with a 40-degree safe gap, 2.0x BA, Sleep 3 s (unbreakable for the first 1 s), cooldown none (charge). The first hit on a sleeping enemy deals +50% (Rude Awakening). The Sleeper is put to sleep for double duration.
super.telegraph: The giant bell shadow appears around Hob 1.0 s ahead, red-rimmed, with the crack gap clearly drawn as a clear wedge.
super.team_use: Huge setup for the squad: call a focus target, then everyone opens on the same sleeper for the +50% Rude Awakening. Wrenna's Sounding counts Sleep as hard CC, so she gets double damage.
super.cinematic: The light dims as a colossal cracked bell drifts down from the sky and settles over Hob like a cathedral. Camera tilts up for a breath to show its crack. Hob braces, roars and headbutts the rim. For once the note comes out pure, with no buzz and no crack in it. A shimmering ring of staff lines rolls across the arena, and enemies slump asleep mid-step, except in the one narrow slice where the crack still lets the sound leak away.
super.charge: Tolls rung: every toll Hob or his allies add counts toward 70 tolls; a seventh-toll stun counts as 5. On his body, the crack in his helmet fills with gold from top to bottom, and the forearm bracers grow brighter verdigris. HUD: a bell icon whose clapper swings faster as it fills.
super.counterplay: The crack gap is a safe lane: stand in the 40-degree wedge. Sleep breaks on damage after 1 s, so a scattered team only loses one target to the follow-up. Hob is rooted for the 1.0 s windup and can be interrupted by any stun, which drops the bell.

idle: Taps a bracer with a knuckle and listens with his head cocked, then frowns at the tone. Sometimes he scratches the green patch on his neck. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with additive arm and head layers.

death: He falls to his knees and pitches forward onto his helmet with a final cracked toll; verdigris dust blows off his body in a slow drift. Base: UAL Death02. VFX: a final toll ring that fails halfway and breaks apart.
victory: He takes off the helmet, cradles it, knocks it once and listens with his eyes closed, then smiles faintly. Base: UAL Idle_Talking_Loop with a held-helmet pose layer.

combos.payoff: Hob drops the Cracked Bell on them and the squad rings it to seven.

name: Corrin Ashgraft
title: the Grafted Warden
team_job: A walking orchard: Corrin's missed shots become healing fruit on the ground, and he can root in place to anchor a fight.

basic.name: Windfall
basic.cast: His bark hand twists a golden-red apple off a budding twig at his wrist (it grows in 0.2 s as a scale-up prop), and he lobs it overhand. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW retimed 10% slower, with the wooden fingers splayed on release.
basic.projectile: A Hollin apple: glossy red-gold with a single leaf, about 250 tris, faintly glowing at the core (a year of life inside).
basic.flight: Soft arc, 13 m/s, apex 2 m, spinning slowly on its stem axis. A trail of 3-4 drifting leaves and pollen motes. Sound: a creak of branch, then a soft whoosh.
basic.impact: On an enemy it bursts in a pulp-and-petal splash with grey blight spores puffing out. If it misses and lands on the ground, it stays as a glowing Windfall pickup for 4 s with a leaf-shadow decal under it.
basic.target_reaction: The target recoils with its head jerked back as if hit in the face, and grey spores cling to its shoulders for 1 s (heal received -15%).
basic.numbers: Range 8 m, splash 1.2 m, 1.0x BA, 0.95 attacks/s. A missed apple heals the first ally to touch it for 0.8x BA.
basic.telegraph: Small red-rimmed impact tick 0.3 s before landing.
basic.team_use: Throw behind your fighting allies and the misses become a trail of heals they can kite through.

basic.name: Second Windfall
basic.cast: Mirror of hit 1 with the left hand, the one with the blossom on its wrist. The pink blossom sways with the throw (a separate prop on the left hand bone with simple sway in code).
basic.projectile: A greener, unripe apple: harder, sour, with a darker leaf.
basic.flight: Flatter arc, 15 m/s, apex 1.5 m. Pollen trail, plus a blossom petal that peels off and follows the apple.
basic.impact: A harder thunk: no pulp, the apple bounces once 1 m and rolls to a stop as a pickup for 4 s.
basic.target_reaction: A shove back of half a step, with a stagger from the blunt hit.
basic.numbers: Range 8 m, 1.1x BA, bounce 1 m. Pickup heals for 0.8x BA.
basic.team_use: The bounce lets the pickup land closer to the ally behind the target.

basic.name: Rootfall
basic.cast: He swings both branch arms back like a tree in wind, then hurls a heavy seed-apple overhead. Hold the windup 0.2 s. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW with a two-handed pose layer and a forward step.
basic.projectile: A large golden seed-apple with roots already curling out of its base.
basic.flight: High arc, 11 m/s, apex 3 m. Roots wriggle from the base in flight (a 4-frame flipbook on a ribbon), dropping clods of soil.
basic.impact: It slams into the ground, and the roots burrow and push up a sapling (a small spawned tree mesh, 1.2 m) that lives 3 s and pulses 3 times with green rings. Enemies near the impact are briefly snared by roots.
basic.target_reaction: Enemies in 1.5 m have their ankles tangled in roots (a vine overlay sprite on their feet) and are slowed 35% for 1 s. Allies within 2.5 m of the sapling see green leaves drift onto their shoulders as each pulse heals them.
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, impact 1.5 m, 1.4x BA. Sapling pulses heal 0.4x BA per pulse to allies in 2.5 m (3 pulses). Slow 35% for 1 s.
basic.telegraph: Red-rimmed impact circle 0.4 s ahead. Allies see a green outlined sapling circle.
basic.team_use: A thrown heal zone that also slows divers chasing your backline.

skills.name: Take Root
skills.cast: He plants both feet and drives his toes into the earth. His spine straightens and his arms lift like branches. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Enter into Spell_Simple_Idle_Loop, with the arms raised as branches and the lower body locked.
skills.projectile: A spreading root network: roots surface around him in a ring (decal plus a few spawned root-arch meshes) and a canopy of leaves flutters overhead.
skills.flight: Roots spread from him to 6 m over 0.5 s (an animated decal mask). Leaves drift down within the ring. Sound: creaking wood and birdsong.
skills.impact: A 6 m root-ring ground decal that persists while he is rooted. Each second a green pulse ripples outward.
skills.target_reaction: Allies in the ring see moss sprout on their shoulders as they heal, plus a green outline. Enemies in the ring see a red-rimmed edge and have grey blight spores on them (heal received -20%).
skills.numbers: Radius 6 m, up to 5 s (cancel any time). Heals allies 0.5x BA/s and Corrin 0.8x BA/s. Corrin gets 30% damage reduction and +2 m reach on Windfall while rooted. Cannot move. Cooldown 16 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see a soft green ring with a white outline; enemies see a thin red rim.
skills.team_use: Defines where the squad fights. Combine with Mott's candles and Halven's warnings to make an unbreakable anchor.

skills.name: Graft
skills.cast: He presses his wooden palm toward an ally, and a living branch grows from his wrist to them. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with the palm held open and the fingers spread.
skills.projectile: A bark vine with small leaves and a single pink bud, joining his wrist to the ally's.
skills.flight: Grows to the ally at 25 m/s as a ribbon with a bark texture, swaying as both units move. Breaks beyond 10 m. Sound: a creak and a twig snap on attach.
skills.impact: Bark plates grow over the ally's shoulders (a bark armour shader overlay) for the duration.
skills.target_reaction: The ally sees bark on their arms and a pink bud on their wrist. If they fall below 25% HP, the vine contracts and yanks them 4 m toward Corrin (pull to safety).
skills.numbers: Range 8 m, tether breaks at 10 m, lasts 4 s. Redirects 35% of the ally's incoming damage to Corrin. One emergency pull of 4 m. Cooldown 14 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see the bark vine. Enemies see a thin vine with a grey rim, so they know focus is being split.
skills.team_use: Graft the diver, the carry or whoever is about to pull Pyrrhos's nail; Corrin's tankiness becomes theirs.

passive.name: Last Blossom
passive.effect: When Corrin drops below 30% HP, the blossom on his wrist falls and he regenerates 6% max HP per second for 2 s. The blossom regrows over 60 s. While the blossom is in bloom, his heals are 10% stronger.
passive.tell: The single pink blossom on his left wrist glows when ready; when used, petals scatter and only a closed bud remains, growing back visibly over 60 s.

super.name: The Orchard of Hollin
super.cast: He drives both branch arms into the ground to the elbow and lifts his head. Moss spreads up his armour. He is replanting Hollin for one moment.
super.projectile: Six spectral apple trees (low-poly spawned meshes, pink blossom canopies) that burst out of the ground in a 7 m circle around him, plus a falling orchard of apples.
super.flight: Trees rise in sequence over 0.8 s, spiralling outward, blossoms opening with a petal burst. Five seconds later, apples drop from the canopies in a soft rain. Sound: wind through branches, bees, a distant church bell of Hollin.
super.impact: A 7 m circle of blossom-covered grass decal with fallen petals. The trees are solid terrain that block enemy projectiles and movement.
super.target_reaction: Allies under the canopy see pink petals settle on them and a golden apple icon over their heads: One More Year. Enemies are pushed to the outside edge by the rising trees (1.5 m push) and grey blight spores cling to them.
super.numbers: Radius 7 m, lasts 6 s. Trees have 2.0x BA HP each. Heals allies 0.6x BA/s. At 5 s, One More Year: for 6 s, an ally who would die is left at 1 HP and healed 2.0x BA instead (once each). Corrin is rooted for the whole cast.
super.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed ring of tree trunks rising. Allies see a blossom-pink ring with a white outline.
super.team_use: It's a team fort: carries fight from behind the trunks, and One More Year turns a losing fight. Mott's candle shields stack on top of it.
super.cinematic: Corrin slams his arms into the earth to the elbows and his green eyes flare. Camera pulls back and up. One after another, six apple trees burst out of the ground around the squad, branches spreading, pink blossoms opening all at once in a cloud of petals. Arrows and bullets thunk into the trunks. The air turns golden. Then the apples ripen and fall in a soft rain, and every ally caught under them gets one more year: the next blow that should kill them doesn't.
super.charge: Blossoms: healing done fills the super. Each 20% opens a new pink blossom along his arms and shoulders (spawned blossom sprites on the arm bones), five blossoms at full charge. HUD: a sapling icon that grows into a tree.
super.counterplay: Trees can be cut down (each has 2.0x BA HP), shrinking the fort. Corrin is rooted for the full 6 s and can be focused or knocked up to cancel the remaining time. Anti-heal effects reduce the healing but not One More Year. Fight outside the ring and wait 6 s.

beats.tweak: Kneels on one knee and drives both arms down into the ground, holding the arms buried. Head lifts slowly.
beats.vfx: Moss spreads up his armour (shader mask), the ground cracks in a ring, and roots surface.

beats.tweak: Hold with the shoulders heaving (additive breathing).
beats.vfx: Six trees rise in a spiral with a blossom-burst flipbook on each canopy.

beats.tweak: Gentle sway like a tree in wind.
beats.vfx: Petal drift, healing pulses, apple rain at 5.0 s with a golden apple icon on allies.
beats.prop: Apple pickup meshes reused from Windfall.
beats.sound: Bees and soft bells; a chime at 5.0 s.

beats.tweak: He pulls his arms free and soil falls off them.
beats.vfx: Trees dissolve into falling petals and leaves.

locomotion: Creaking, stiff-kneed stride, as if every step pulls a root up. The run is a long-legged lope with the branch arms held slightly away from the body. Base: UAL Walk_Loop retimed 12% slower; Jog_Fwd_Loop with reduced knee bend.
idle: He looks at the blossom on his wrist and shields it with his other hand. Sometimes a bird sprite lands on his shoulder and flies off, or he flexes his wooden fingers and they creak. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with additive hand layers.
hit: A creak and splinter burst, bark chips flying, a half-step stagger. Base: UAL Hit_Chest.
death: He sinks to his knees and his arms lift into a frozen branch pose. Leaves fall from him all at once and grey blight creeps up from his feet (shader mask), then he dims into a dead stump silhouette as the last petal floats off his wrist. Base: UAL Death01, frozen at the knee frame, with the blight dissolve.
victory: He plants a seed in the ground, kneels, and a tiny sapling grows; he cups his hands around it. Base: UAL PLANT_SEED into Fixing_Kneeling.

Slower; ends with a hand planted.
Two-handed overhead, a 0.2 s hold at the top, forward step.
Arms raised as branches, lower body locked.
Open palm held toward the ally.
Both arms buried; held for the duration with additive sway.
Frozen at the knee frame with the arms up.

Green, harder variant with a darker leaf.
Large gold apple with a 4-frame root-wriggle flipbook at the base.
Pulp, pink petals and grey blight spores; 8 frames.
A glowing apple on the ground with a dappled leaf-shadow decal; it pulses every 0.5 s.
1.2 m sapling that pulses green rings 3 times, then fades.
Roots spreading through a 6 m mask with a green pulse every second.
Bark-textured ribbon with small leaves and a pink bud mid-span.
Bark shader patch on the ally's shoulders and forearms.
Low-poly apple tree with a pink blossom canopy and a petal-burst flipbook. Fallback: billboard trees.

Pink blossom sprites on the arm and shoulder bones, one per 20% super charge.

combos.setup: Mott's Vigil Candles shield the squad inside Take Root.
combos.payoff: Shield plus heal-over-time makes the root ring nearly unbreakable. In the lore, Mott's graves caused the blight; here, they fight it.

combos.setup: Pyrrhos pulls his nail and burns his own HP for power.
combos.payoff: Corrin grafts him to soak 35% of the damage, and Windfall apples keep him running for the full 4 s.

combos.setup: Vell's Lost Property Office finds things for allies.
combos.payoff: If Corrin is in the radius, Vell returns his wife's name and Corrin's super charge is filled instantly.

name: Brother Mott
title: the Tallow Saint
team_job: A candle-bearing shield battery: every candle Mott lights is a shield on the squad, and his seals can make an ally's promise to live come true for two seconds.

basic.name: Drip
basic.cast: He tips his head forward so the wick on his crown flares, pinches the melted wax pooling at the brim with his right hand, and flicks it outward. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot retimed 25% faster, with a forward head bow.
basic.projectile: Three hot wax droplets that harden in mid-air into little red wax seals stamped with a cross.
basic.flight: A 25-degree cone, 7 m, at 16 m/s. Each droplet starts as a glowing gold blob and hardens to a matte red disc at 3 m (a material lerp) with a wisp of smoke. Sound: a hiss, then the soft tock of wax setting.
basic.impact: Seals smack onto the target and stick for 1 s before falling off. A tiny wax spatter decal, 0.5 s.
basic.target_reaction: A small flinch. The stuck seals stay on the victim's chest and shoulders as decals for 1 s.
basic.numbers: Cone 7 m by 25 degrees, 0.45x BA per seal (1.35x if all three hit), 1.0 attacks/s.
basic.team_use: Spreads chip damage around a cluster. Every target hit by 3 seals within 3 s is Sealed (see hit 3).

basic.name: Drip
basic.cast: Mirror with the left hand, the flick coming from under the right arm in a backhand. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot mirrored.
basic.projectile: Same three droplet-seals; one in three is black wax (a cosmetic variation).
basic.flight: Same cone, angled slightly lower. Wax smoke trails.
basic.impact: Same as hit 1.
basic.target_reaction: Same as hit 1.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: The Seal
basic.cast: He presses his palm flat against one of the red seals on his coat, pulls it free, and slaps it toward the target, tilting his head so the wick drips a long thread of wax. Base: UAL Punch_Jab with an open palm, held 0.1 s.
basic.projectile: A big glowing wax seal the size of a hand, stamped with an ancient promise sigil, trailing a thread of molten wax back to Mott.
basic.flight: Straight, 14 m/s, 7 m, narrow cone. The wax thread breaks off at 4 m. Sound: a quill scratch, then a thump.
basic.impact: It slaps onto the target with a red splash ring, and wax runs down to their feet.
basic.target_reaction: Sealed: wax runs down the target's legs and hardens around the feet (height-masked wax shader). They are slowed 30% for 1 s, then the seal cracks for bonus damage.
basic.numbers: Range 7 m, 0.8x BA on hit + 0.8x BA when the seal cracks after 1 s, slow 30% for 1 s.
basic.team_use: Slow and pop. A Sealed target can't dash away from Wrenna's Sounding in time.

skills.name: Vigil Candle
skills.cast: He draws a tall candle from the bundle at his hip, touches it to the wick on his crown (head bowed forward), and tosses it. Base: UAL PickUp_Table reversed into OVERHAND_THROW.
skills.projectile: A tall cream candle with a tiny red seal on its base and a steady gold flame.
skills.flight: A lobbed arc, 12 m/s, spinning slowly. The flame stays upright (billboard flame always faces up), trailing wax droplets. Sound: a breathy whoomp as the flame catches.
skills.impact: It plants upright in the ground. A pool of wax spreads 0.5 m around the base (decal), and a soft gold light circle with a 4 m radius appears.
skills.target_reaction: Allies in 4 m wear a thin waxy translucent shell (a wax shield overlay: creamy fresnel with drip streaks). Enemies see the candle with a red rim and can stomp it out.
skills.numbers: Range 10 m, aura 4 m, lasts 8 s or 3 enemy hits. Gives allies in the aura a wax shield of 0.6x BA that refills every 2 s. Max 3 candles. Cooldown 7 s per charge, 2 charges.
skills.telegraph: Allies see a gold light circle with a white outline; enemies see the candle with a red rim and an HP pip ring.
skills.team_use: Plant candles where the squad will fight. Each one also counts toward his passive.

skills.name: Last Promise
skills.cast: He tears a red seal off his coat, kisses it to his mask, and presses it into the air toward the target. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with a 0.2 s hand-to-mask hold.
skills.projectile: A large blazing red seal that flies to the target and stamps onto their chest.
skills.flight: Homing, 20 m/s, trailing a ribbon of red wax and the smell-visual of smoke. Sound: a deep wax-stamp thud and a whisper.
skills.impact: On an ally: a seal glows on their chest with a ring of candle flames circling their feet. On an enemy: wax splashes and floods their boots.
skills.target_reaction: An ally becomes Sworn: they cannot drop below 1 HP for 2 s and see a ring of small flames at their feet. An enemy becomes Bound: wax seals their boots and they cannot dash or blink for 2.5 s.
skills.numbers: Range 9 m, Sworn 2 s, Bound 2.5 s, cooldown 22 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red seal icon fly at them. Allies see a gold seal icon.
skills.team_use: Sworn on the carry about to be bursted, or Bound on the diver about to leap onto your healer.

passive.name: Every Candle Counts
passive.effect: When an ally dies, a memorial candle lights where they fell and burns until they respawn. Every candle burning on the field (Vigil Candles plus memorial candles) gives all allies +3% max-HP shield regeneration per second, up to 5 candles.
passive.tell: The wick on his crown burns taller with each candle on the field, and the red seals on his coat glow one by one, one per candle.

super.name: The Valley's Light
super.cast: Mott lifts his face to the sky. The wick on his crown flares into a pillar of fire and every seal on his coat pops loose and floats.
super.projectile: Eleven floating candles, one per year of his vigil, each carrying a promise seal. They orbit the squad, and each ally is wrapped in a translucent wax effigy shield.
super.flight: The candles rise from his coat and spiral outward to circle the allies within 10 m, then each one settles above an ally's head. When an ally's shield breaks, that candle's flame peels off and homes to the attacker at 18 m/s as a burning wisp shaped like a small human figure (the valley's dead). Sound: a choir of whispers and a single held chord.
super.impact: Ground decal: a soft gold ring of drips and wax circles where each ally stands. Wisp hits burst into a puff of gold ash.
super.target_reaction: Allies see a waxen outline and a candle floating over their head. Attackers hit by a wisp are briefly Haunted: a pale figure clings to their back for 1 s (a slow 25%).
super.numbers: Radius 10 m. Shield on each ally: 3.0x BA for 6 s. When a shield breaks, the wisp deals 2.0x BA to the attacker and slows 25% for 1 s. If Wrenna is on the team, a 12th candle with her name rises and also refreshes her Sounding.
super.telegraph: Enemies see allies outlined in red-rimmed wax with a candle overhead, a clear warning that hitting them triggers a wisp.
super.team_use: A full-team shield. The wisps punish divers, which gives Corrin and Jory time to work.
super.cinematic: Mott tilts his masked face up and the wick on his crown flares into a column of gold flame. One by one, the red seals tear free from his coat and become floating candles, eleven of them, rising in a slow spiral. They drift over to each ally and settle above their heads like halos, and a waxen glow hardens around each body. When an enemy breaks through one of those shields, the candle's flame peels away into a small, pale human figure, one of the valley's dead, and it flies straight back at the attacker.
super.charge: Candles lit: every Vigil Candle placed, every memorial candle and every shield point absorbed charges it. On his body, wax drips further down his mask and the red seals on his coat light up one by one, so at full charge every seal is glowing. HUD: a candle icon that burns down to show charge.
super.counterplay: Spread damage instead of bursting shields one by one. AoE breaks several shields at once but takes several wisps. Wisps can be dodged by dashing (they home at 18 m/s). If Mott dies during the 6 s, every candle goes out and the shields vanish. The lore: the dead stay quiet only while the wick burns.

beats.vfx: Wick flares into a 1.5 m flame column. Seals on his coat pop off one by one.

locomotion: A careful, slightly hunched gravedigger's walk, one hand often raised to shield the flame on his crown from the wind. The run is a hurried shuffle that keeps the head steady to protect the flame. Base: UAL Walk_Loop with a head-stabilising layer; Jog_Fwd_Loop retimed 8% slower.
idle: He cups a hand around the wick, adjusts a seal on his coat, counts the candles in his hip bundle with one finger. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with additive hand layers.
hit: The flame on his crown gutters sideways (flame billboard bends), wax spatters off his shoulders, and he hunches. Base: UAL Hit_Chest.
death: He kneels, and his wick shrinks to a single blue point before going out with a thin curl of smoke. Pale wisps rise from the ground around him for a second and look around, confused. Base: UAL Death01 into a kneeling hold.
victory: He lights a new candle from his wick and sets it down, then stands with his hands folded. Base: UAL Interact into Idle_Loop.

25% faster with a forward head bow.
Draw a candle from the hip bundle and light it from the crown wick.

Thin grey smoke wisps behind each droplet.
Hand-sized glowing seal with a molten wax thread ribbon.
Height-masked creamy wax shader from the feet to the shins, hardening from glossy to matte.
Cream candle with a red seal at its base and a billboard flame; gold light circle decal.

Floating candles with seal plaques that spiral out to allies.
A small pale human-shaped flame (8-frame flipbook) with an ash trail.

combos.payoff: Mott's Vigil Candles stack shields on top; the circle becomes a fortress.

combos.setup: Jory's Spare Hourglass revives an ally.
combos.payoff: Mott's memorial candle for that ally stays lit for 5 s after they come back, giving the team bonus shield regen.

combos.setup: Mott's super lights Wrenna's sealed candle.
combos.payoff: Her Sounding cooldown is refreshed for an instant second flood.

name: Nyssa Obel
title: the Ferryman's Daughter
team_job: Marks a target, harvests coins from it as the squad hits it, then spends the coins to ferry herself and her allies across the arena.

basic.name: Obol Flick
basic.cast: She plucks a coin from her skirt of coin scales and flicks it with her thumb off a crooked forefinger, the way you'd toss a coin to call a bet. Base: UAL Pistol_Shoot with the pistol replaced by a thumb-flick hand pose, retimed 15% faster.
basic.projectile: A spinning tarnished coin: bronze with verdigris at the rim, a ferry stamped on one face and an eye on the other.
basic.flight: Flat and fast, 22 m/s, spinning on its edge so it flickers bronze and green. A faint river-mist trail curls behind it (soft particle ribbon). On a hit, it ricochets to the nearest other enemy within 4 m. Sound: a bright ping, and a ting on every bounce.
basic.impact: A small burst of mist and a coin-glint star at the hit point. No ground decal.
basic.target_reaction: The target's head flicks sideways as if stung. If Marked, a coin pops off them and spins to the ground.
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, 1.0x BA, then 0.6x BA on the ricochet (4 m bounce range), 1.25 attacks/s.
basic.team_use: Ricochets spread chip damage and pop coins off any Marked enemy nearby.

basic.name: Obol Flick
basic.cast: Mirror of hit 1 with the left hand, with a small skip step forward. Base: UAL Pistol_Shoot mirrored.
basic.projectile: A silver coin this time, brighter and newer.
basic.flight: Same path; it ricochets to a second target. Sound: a higher ping.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Double Fare
basic.cast: She flicks two coins at once from both thumbs, crossing her arms in front of her chest and snapping them outward. Base: UAL Punch_Cross into a two-arm flare, mirrored.
basic.projectile: Two coins, one bronze and one silver, that rotate around each other in flight like a binary star.
basic.flight: They corkscrew around each other at 20 m/s; each one can ricochet once independently. Sound: a two-tone chime.
basic.impact: Twin glint stars. On a Marked target, both coins stick in the victim's armour for a moment, then pop loose as two dropped coins.
basic.target_reaction: The target rocks back. A ghostly coin flashes over each eye for 0.2 s as a reminder of the toll.
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, 0.8x BA per coin (1.6x BA if both hit), each can ricochet once at 0.5x BA.
basic.team_use: The main coin harvester on Marked targets.

skills.name: Toll
skills.cast: She holds a coin up between two fingers to her eye, sights the target through the hole in its centre, then throws it overhand. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW with a 0.15 s sight-hold at eye level.
skills.projectile: A pierced funeral coin (a dark, worn obol with a square hole) trailing a thread of river mist.
skills.flight: Straight line, 24 m/s, 11 m. It does not bounce. The mist trail lingers 1 s as a pale ribbon. Sound: a whispered count, then a ferryman's bell.
skills.impact: It strikes and sinks into the target with a cold mist puff.
skills.target_reaction: Marked: two ghostly coins hover over the target's eyes for the duration, as on the eyes of the dead. Each time anyone on Nyssa's team hits the target (once per 0.5 s), a coin falls from them and rolls on the ground as a pickup.
skills.numbers: Range 11 m, width 0.6 m, 1.2x BA, Mark lasts 6 s, cooldown 8 s. Coins on the ground last 6 s; Nyssa picks them up by walking over them (magnet radius 2 m).
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a thin red line flash 0.15 s before the throw.
skills.team_use: Focus the Marked target as a team; every hit by anyone makes coins rain for Nyssa's ferry.

skills.name: Call the Ferry
skills.cast: She spends three coins: she tosses them into the air (they vanish in mist), raises a hand to call, and steps forward onto a ghostly boat that appears under her feet. Base: UAL SWORD_DASH with an upright stance and one arm raised.
skills.projectile: A ghostly ferry: a low black skiff with a bow lantern (spawned low-poly mesh, half transparent) on a ribbon of river mist.
skills.flight: She glides 9 m in 0.45 s standing at the prow, the boat sliding over a mist-river ribbon that lingers 1.5 s behind it. Sound: an oar splash and a creaking hull.
skills.impact: Where the boat passes, a river-mist lane remains for 1.5 s. Enemies inside are chilled.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies crossed by the boat stumble and are slowed 30% for 1.5 s, with frost-pale hands clutching their ankles (a sprite overlay). Allies who step into the mist lane within 1.5 s are carried 9 m along it as well.
skills.numbers: Dash 9 m, costs 3 coins (she holds up to 9), 0.6x BA to enemies crossed, slow 30% for 1.5 s. Ally ride window 1.5 s. Cooldown 10 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed mist lane. Allies see a soft violet lane with white oar-ripples.
skills.team_use: Squad mobility: dash forward to start a dive and your allies ride the same lane in behind you, or dash back and pull the squad out of a bad fight.

passive.name: The Ferryman's Coat
passive.effect: Each coin Nyssa carries (max 9) gives her +2% move speed and +2% damage. On death she drops half her coins for allies to collect, which refunds their dash cooldowns by 1 s per coin.
passive.tell: Coin scales on her skirt light up one by one with a bronze glint as she carries more coins. The single coin braided into her hair glows when she has enough for a ferry.

super.name: Passage Paid
super.style: Dash / leap strike along a summoned ground lane
super.cast: She lifts a fistful of coins over her head and lets them fall through her fingers into the ground. Where they land, the river of the dead rises.
super.projectile: A ghost river, 18 m long and 3 m wide, with the ferry gliding along it carrying Nyssa and every ally who steps aboard. Pale hands of the dead rise from the water.
super.flight: The river unrolls along an aimed line over 0.6 s. Then the ferry travels its full length in 1.2 s. At the end, Nyssa leaps from the prow and flicks one last gold coin, the coin for the dead, at the lowest-HP enemy within 8 m (homing, 26 m/s). Sound: oars, a ferry bell tolling three times, and whispers of the dead.
super.impact: The river stays for 4 s as a slowing zone of violet mist water with floating coins (decal plus a low fog layer). The final coin explodes in a gold flash.
super.target_reaction: Enemies in the river are grabbed by pale hands at the ankles (sprite flipbook) and slowed 50%. Marked enemies are dragged under: pulled to the river's centre line and rooted for 1.5 s, sinking to the knees. The final coin target freezes in a gold flash. If it kills, the victim fades into mist with coins on its eyes.
super.numbers: River 18 m by 3 m, lasts 4 s, slow 50%, Marked enemies rooted 1.5 s, 1.5x BA to each enemy crossed. Final coin 3.0x BA, and it executes enemies below 20% HP and refunds 30% charge.
super.telegraph: Enemies see the river line red-rimmed for 0.6 s before the ferry sails. Allies see a violet lane with a glowing boarding ring.
super.team_use: A squad transport and a pick: up to 3 allies ride the ferry 18 m. If Kerberon is on the team, the river's endpoint snaps to him wherever he is within 30 m: the ferry brings the squad to the gate.
super.cinematic: Nyssa raises her fist and lets a stream of coins pour from it. Each coin sinks into the floor, and the arena floor turns to black water. A river of the dead flows in a straight line across the field, mist curling off it, and the ferry glides up out of the fog with its lantern lit. Her allies step aboard and they sail, while pale hands rise from the water to clutch at every enemy on the banks. At the far end Nyssa vaults off the prow and flicks a single gold coin over her shoulder at the weakest enemy. Passage paid.
super.charge: Coins collected: every coin picked up over the match, 30 total. On her body, the coin scales on her armour light up row by row from hem to shoulder. HUD: a stack of coins on the super button.
super.counterplay: The river is announced 0.6 s early. Leave the 3 m strip and you are only slowed if you step back in. Stunning Nyssa during the 1.2 s sail sinks the ferry and drops everyone aboard where they are. The final coin only executes below 20% HP, so a shield or heal on the weakest ally saves them.

name: Pyrrhos
title: the Hollow Sentinel
team_job: A bronze wall that patrols: he lays guarded ground, throws cover boulders for the backline, and lets a teammate hammer his nail back in for a team shield.

basic.name: Patrol Swing
basic.cast: A heavy right backhand with his oversized bronze hand, the shoulder joint grinding. Base: UAL Punch_Cross retimed 15% slower with a 2-frame hold at full extension.
basic.projectile: A bronze afterimage of his arm: three fading ghost copies of the arm mesh trailing the swing (a cheap mesh-trail of 3 copies at 60/40/20% alpha), with barnacle grit flicking off.
basic.flight: Arc of about 110 degrees, 2.6 m reach, 0.25 s. Barnacle grit and dried salt specks spray along the arc. Sound: a grinding clank and a hollow boom from inside his chest.
basic.impact: Bronze sparks and a small cloud of dry sea-salt.
basic.target_reaction: The target is shoved sideways 0.5 m, stumbling, with salt flecks stuck to it.
basic.numbers: Range 2.6 m, arc 110 degrees, 1.0x BA, 0.9 hits/s.
basic.team_use: Wide swings let him tag several divers around a carry.

basic.name: Sentry Hook
basic.cast: A left hook with the whole torso turning like a tower crane. Base: UAL Punch_Jab mirrored, with a full torso rotation.
basic.projectile: Same ghost-arm trail, with a seawater drip ribbon from the elbow joint.
basic.flight: Arc 90 degrees, 2.4 m reach. Sound: a bronze clang with a deep resonance.
basic.impact: Sparks and a splash of trapped seawater from his joints.
basic.target_reaction: Head turned by the hook; a clear stagger.
basic.numbers: Range 2.4 m, 1.1x BA.
basic.team_use: Builds to the stamp.

basic.name: Seafloor Stamp
basic.cast: He lifts the nailed ankle high and stamps down. Base: UAL MELEE_JUMP_LAND (landing frames only) with a one-leg lift layered in front.
basic.projectile: A shockwave ring of cracked stone with seawater squirting up through the cracks.
basic.flight: Radial, expanding to 2.5 m in 0.2 s. Water jets pop through the cracks (3-4 small fountain sprites). Sound: an earthen thud and a wave slap.
basic.impact: A cracked-ground decal with seawater in the seams and a few barnacle clusters, lasting 2 s.
basic.target_reaction: Enemies are rocked off balance (a hop stagger) and slowed 20% for 1.5 s, with wet salt on their boots.
basic.numbers: Radius 2.5 m, 1.4x BA, slow 20% for 1.5 s.
basic.telegraph: A 0.2 s bronze glow at the raised foot.
basic.team_use: A slow that helps his team stick to divers.

skills.name: Boulder for Pirates
skills.cast: He tears a chunk out of the arena floor with both hands (UAL PickUp_Table retimed to 0.3 s), heaves it over his head and hurls it two-handed (UAL OVERHAND_THROW with a two-hand pose layer).
skills.projectile: A barnacle-crusted sea boulder (spawned mesh) dripping kelp and seawater.
skills.flight: Lobbed arc, 13 m/s, apex 4 m, tumbling slowly. Sand and seawater stream off it. Sound: a grinding rumble and a whistle.
skills.impact: A heavy impact: a crater decal (3 s), a dust and spray ring. The boulder stays as solid terrain for 6 s.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies at the centre are stunned 1 s with a dazed bronze ring above them. Enemies within 3 m are knocked back 2.5 m away from the centre.
skills.numbers: Range 12 m, impact radius 3 m, 2.0x BA, stun 1 s at the centre (1 m), knock-back 2.5 m, boulder lasts 6 s with 3.0x BA HP. Cooldown 11 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed landing circle for 0.6 s. Allies see the boulder's outline as cover.
skills.team_use: Instant cover for marksmen like Oko, and a wall for Wrenna's wave to slam enemies into.

skills.name: Pull the Nail
skills.cast: He crouches, grips the nail in his ankle, and yanks it out. Golden ichor sprays from the wound in an arc. Base: UAL Fixing_Kneeling retimed to 0.5 s, with a sharp pull-up at the end.
skills.projectile: The ichor itself: a glowing gold-red stream that spills from his ankle, and the nail, which he holds in one fist.
skills.flight: Ichor pours as a ribbon from the ankle and drips onto the ground behind him as he moves (a trail of glowing droplets). Sound: a hiss of steam and a heartbeat that speeds up.
skills.impact: Every step leaves a glowing gold footprint decal that fades in 1 s.
skills.target_reaction: Pyrrhos glows: golden ichor runs up the vein on his leg and spreads across his chest (emissive mask). Allies see a nail icon over his head: Hammer it back.
skills.numbers: Lasts 4 s: +50% damage, +25% attack speed, immune to crowd control, but he loses 4% max HP per second. Any ally can tap him (interact) to hammer the nail back in: Pyrrhos regains 15% max HP, and both he and that ally get a 1.5x BA shield for 3 s. Otherwise he hammers it back himself at the end. Cooldown 18 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see him blazing gold with a red rim: hard to stop, but bleeding out.
skills.team_use: Teams have to talk: someone needs to hammer him back in at the right time. The lore: someone always puts the nail back.

passive.name: Patrol
passive.effect: As he moves, Pyrrhos leaves bronze footprints that last 8 s. If he walks a loop (returns within 2 m of a footprint at least 5 s old), he completes a Lap: +1 armour plate (max 3, each +8% damage reduction), and the area inside the loop becomes Guarded Ground for 5 s, where allies get +15% damage reduction.
passive.tell: Bronze plates (ring-shaped spawned meshes) stack on his shoulders as laps complete. His footprints glow faintly, and the most recent loop's outline brightens as it closes.

super.name: Four Hundred Years of Patrol
super.style: Dash / leap strike (repeated charge along a fixed lane)
super.cast: He snaps to attention, salutes, and marches. Three times a day for four hundred years he walked this route, and now he walks it three times in four seconds.
super.projectile: Pyrrhos himself, unstoppable, wrapped in the ghost of the seabed: a shallow translucent sea surrounds him as he marches (water plane disc under him), and he leaves a line of bronze footprints. On the third pass, a giant boulder.
super.flight: He marches along an aimed 14 m lane three times (out, back, out) at 10 m/s, body-checking enemies aside. On the third pass he tears up a boulder and hurls it from the end of the lane. Sound: a march drum, waves breaking at each turn, a foghorn on the throw.
super.impact: The lane becomes Guarded Ground for 5 s with a line of glowing footprints. The final boulder makes a crater and stays as cover for 8 s.
super.target_reaction: Enemies on the lane are body-checked aside 3 m each pass and briefly stunned 0.4 s with salt spray on them. The final boulder stuns 1.5 s at its centre. Allies on the lane see bronze plates appear around them.
super.numbers: Lane 14 m by 3 m, 3 passes in 4 s, 1.5x BA per pass, displacement 3 m, final boulder 3.0x BA, radius 3.5 m, stun 1.5 s. Guarded Ground gives allies +25% damage reduction for 5 s. Pyrrhos is crowd-control immune during the march.
super.telegraph: The full lane is shown red-rimmed for 0.8 s before he steps off, with arrows on each pass.
super.team_use: Clears a corridor for your squad and armours allies standing on it. If Oko is on the team, Oko's lighthouse beam lights the lane and Pyrrhos marches a fourth pass.
super.cinematic: Pyrrhos stops, clicks his bronze heels together, and salutes. A shallow ghost sea washes around his ankles. Camera drops to knee height. He marches: down the lane, turn with a splash, back, turn, and out again, smashing everything in his path aside. Bronze footprints glow behind him like a sentry route on a map. At the end of the third pass he rips a boulder out of the ground and hurls it the way he once threw them at pirate ships.
super.charge: Laps and damage absorbed: each Lap completed is worth 10%, damage taken fills the rest. On his body, the red ichor vein on his leg glows and climbs up toward his chest. HUD: a small route map with three waypoints.
super.counterplay: The lane is shown 0.8 s early and he can't turn off it. Step out of the 3 m strip. He is crowd-control immune but still takes damage. After the march he stands still for 1 s, exhausted, steam venting from his joints: punish him then.

name: Moss
title: Child of the Labyrinth
team_job: Builds the maze: enemies get boxed in, while Moss's allies follow his red thread straight through the walls.

basic.name: Thread Ball
basic.cast: He unhooks a ball of red thread from the coil around his neck and bowls it underhand, keeping the loose end wrapped around his fingers. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW retimed to an underhand bowl with a forward lean.
basic.projectile: A fist-sized ball of the hero's red thread that unspools as it flies, a taut red line connecting it back to his hand.
basic.flight: Out straight at 16 m/s to 9 m, then he tugs and it reels back to his hand at 20 m/s, rewinding. The thread is a thin taut ribbon that sags slightly on the return. Sound: a soft whir going out, a zipping rewind coming back.
basic.impact: A puff of red fibres where the ball hits. No decal.
basic.target_reaction: A blunt bonk that turns the head; a few red fibres cling to the victim.
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, 0.7x BA going out and 0.7x BA returning (1.4x BA if both connect), 1.0 attacks/s.
basic.team_use: Returning hits clip enemies chasing your backline.

basic.name: Thread Ball
basic.cast: Mirror with the left hand: a sidearm toss. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW mirrored, lower release.
basic.projectile: Same ball, slightly more frayed.
basic.flight: Same, curving 10 degrees on the return.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Tangle
basic.cast: He spins the ball overhead on its thread like a sling, twice, then lets it fly. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Enter with a looping arm swing, into OVERHAND_THROW.
basic.projectile: A bigger thread ball with a loose loop trailing behind it.
basic.flight: Out at 15 m/s. On the first enemy hit, it wraps around them three times (the thread visibly coiling), then unwinds and returns. Sound: a whirr, then a snap of thread pulling tight.
basic.impact: A coil of red thread spirals around the victim and fibres drift.
basic.target_reaction: Tangled: red thread loops around the victim's wrists and ankles (a coiled ribbon overlay on the hand and foot bones), slowing 30% for 1.5 s. Their arms are pinned to the body for the first 0.3 s.
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, 1.2x BA, slow 30% for 1.5 s.
basic.team_use: Tangled enemies are slow enough to box in with Maze Walls.

skills.name: Maze Walls
skills.cast: Moss stamps a hoof, and the maze pattern on his tunic glows green. Base: UAL MELEE_JUMP_LAND (stamp frames) with an arm sweep layered on to aim the opening.
skills.projectile: Modular stone wall segments carved with maze patterns, moss growing on their tops (spawned meshes, 2 m tall).
skills.flight: Walls burst up from the ground around the target area in 0.3 s, rising with stone dust and moss flicking off. Sound: grinding stone and the echo of a long corridor.
skills.impact: Forms a 4 m by 4 m box with a single exit that faces the direction Moss chooses. Walls stay 3 s.
skills.target_reaction: Trapped enemies bump against the walls (a recoil reaction) and see the walls with a red rim. Allies see a glowing red thread passing through the wall and can walk straight through it.
skills.numbers: Range 9 m, box 4 by 4 m, walls 2 m tall, lasts 3 s, each segment 1.5x BA HP. Cooldown 14 s. 0.8x BA to enemies caught under a rising wall, plus a small knock-up.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see red-rimmed wall outlines 0.3 s before they rise.
skills.team_use: Box the target, then your squad walks in through the walls. Wrenna's Sounding loves a box.

skills.name: Ariadne's Thread
skills.cast: He unwinds the red thread from his neck, ties one end around his own wrist, and tosses the other end to an ally. Base: UAL Interact into OVERHAND_THROW.
skills.projectile: A long glowing red thread linking Moss's wrist to the ally's wrist.
skills.flight: The end flies to the ally at 22 m/s and knots around their wrist. The tether sags and sways naturally (verlet rope, 8 segments). Sound: a soft knot tightening.
skills.impact: A red thread bracelet appears on the ally's wrist.
skills.target_reaction: The ally sees a red bracelet and a glowing thread. Moss can tug once: pull the ally 6 m to his side (out of danger), or pull himself to the ally.
skills.numbers: Range 10 m, tether lasts 8 s, breaks at 14 m. One tug: 6 m pull over 0.3 s. Cooldown 12 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see the thread in bright red with a soft outline; enemies see a thin grey-rimmed thread.
skills.team_use: A rescue line: tie it to the diver going in, then yank them back out.

passive.name: The Labyrinth Follows
passive.effect: When Moss stands still for 2 s, a single maze wall segment (2 m wide) rises behind him as cover; max 2 segments, each lasts 6 s. Moss and allies within 3 m of him pass through any wall, his or anyone else's.
passive.tell: The carved maze lines on his tunic glow green as a wall is about to rise. The red thread around his neck stirs as if alive (vertex wiggle).

super.name: The Labyrinth Followed
super.cast: Moss shuts his eyes and lets out a long, tired breath. The labyrinth he spent his whole childhood inside comes up out of the ground around him.
super.projectile: A full maze: dozens of carved, moss-topped wall segments in a 14 m radius (one of three hand-authored maze prefabs, rotated to the cast direction), and the hero's red thread laid through it.
super.flight: Walls rise in a wave rolling outward from Moss over 0.8 s. Then a red thread unspools from his neck, splits into one strand per ally, and runs through the maze from each ally to the nearest enemy, a glowing path. Sound: deep stone grinding, a far-off bull's bellow echoing in corridors.
super.impact: Maze stays 6 s. The ground inside becomes a dim corridor decal with a faint maze pattern. Three exits glow faintly at the edge.
super.target_reaction: Enemies inside are Lost: their minimap blanks out and their screen edge shows a stone vignette. Bumping a wall staggers them back. Allies see the red thread under their feet leading them, and pass through walls freely.
super.numbers: Radius 14 m, lasts 6 s, each wall segment 2.0x BA HP. Allies walking through walls get +20% move speed. Enemies hitting a wall take 0.5x BA and a 0.3 s stagger.
super.telegraph: Enemies see the red-rimmed wave of walls rising toward them for 0.8 s.
super.team_use: Splits the enemy team apart so your squad can pick them off one corridor at a time. Moss always knows the way out.
super.cinematic: Moss closes his eyes, and the ground around the whole fight shakes. Walls of carved, mossy stone surge up in a rolling wave until the arena is a labyrinth. Camera rises to a near-top-down view for a moment to show the maze. Enemies turn in place, lost, and the corridors echo with the distant bellow of a beast. Then the red thread unwinds from Moss's neck and splits, laying a glowing line through the maze from each of his allies straight to their prey. They walk right through the stone.
super.charge: Wrong turns: every time an enemy bumps one of his walls or is hit by the thread ball, he gains charge. Walls standing count over time too. On his body, the red thread coil on his neck grows longer, wrapping one more loop around his shoulders per 20%. HUD: a tiny maze icon that fills from the outside in.
super.counterplay: The thread is visible to everyone, so enemies can follow it in reverse to find the allies hunting them. Wall segments can be broken by heavy hits. Leaps and blinks hop over walls. The three exits glow, so enemies who look can walk out.

name: Ione
title: the Unsung
team_job: Speed for the whole squad and a song that pulls a trapped ally home: Ione decides how fast her team moves and who gets out alive.

basic.name: Plucked Note
basic.cast: She gives the key on the side of the music box at her chest one click with her right hand, then opens that hand toward the target as the note sounds. Tap fires at the nearest enemy; drag the attack stick over an ally to send the note to them instead. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with a short crank-turn layer on the right wrist.
basic.projectile: A single music-box tine (a thin brass comb tooth) wrapped in a glowing note glyph, riding on a wisp of sea fog.
basic.flight: Homing, 15 m/s, gentle S-curve, 10 m. Fog curls behind it (soft particle ribbon) and tiny brass sparkles fall off. Sound: one plucked music-box note; each hit in the chain plays the next note of her tune.
basic.impact: On an enemy: a small burst of cold fog and a cracked note glyph. On an ally: a warm ripple of brass light at their chest.
basic.target_reaction: Enemy: a slight sway as if dizzy, with a crooked note glyph circling their head (Off-key: slowed 12% for 1.5 s). Ally: a brass note settles above their head and they see a soft teal ripple on their body: a small heal and haste.
basic.numbers: Range 10 m, 0.9x BA damage to enemies, or 0.45x BA heal plus +10% move speed for 1.5 s to allies. 1.1 attacks/s.
basic.team_use: Every ally note also counts toward her passive.

basic.name: Second Note
basic.cast: Same, cranking with the left hand this time, so she twists to reach the key. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot mirrored.
basic.projectile: Same tine, the next note higher.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Chord
basic.cast: She cranks the key a full turn with both hands and the box plays a three-note chord. Her head tilts back as though she is singing behind the cage. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Enter into Spell_Simple_Shoot.
basic.projectile: Three tines with glyphs, each a different colour of brass (pale, bright, dark).
basic.flight: Three homing notes fan out, each picking a different target (enemies or allies, nearest first), at 14 m/s. Sound: a chord in a minor key.
basic.impact: Each note bursts on its target as above.
basic.target_reaction: As hit 1, per note.
basic.numbers: Range 10 m, 3 notes, each 0.6x BA damage or 0.35x BA heal plus haste.
basic.team_use: Spreads small heals and speed across the squad in one beat.

skills.name: Wind the Box
skills.cast: She grips the key on her music box and cranks it three full turns, each turn a distinct shoulder roll. The tune begins to play. Base: UAL Fixing_Kneeling upper-body crank motion layered on Idle_Loop, three repetitions, then a release.
skills.projectile: The tune itself: a ring of floating brass notes and musical staff lines circling Ione, carried on fog.
skills.flight: The aura expands to 6 m in 0.3 s. Notes orbit at the edge, and as the tune runs down they slow and the ring shrinks. Sound: the full music-box tune, which audibly slows down toward the end.
skills.impact: A faint fog ring decal under her that shrinks with the aura.
skills.target_reaction: Allies inside see brass notes orbiting their feet and a teal speed shimmer on their legs. The tune runs down, so the buff fades as the ring shrinks.
skills.numbers: Radius 6 m, lasts 6 s (radius shrinks from 6 m to 3 m), allies get +25% move speed and +10% attack speed. Cooldown 16 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see a soft teal ring with white notes. Enemies see nothing harmful (no red rim).
skills.team_use: Engage speed for divers like Fenwick and Nyssa, or escape speed for everyone.

skills.name: Sing Them Home
skills.cast: She grips the brass cage over her mouth and pulls its little door open (a hinged prop piece on the head bone, rotated in code). She leans toward the target ally and sings one long note. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with a reaching hand and a forward-lean layer.
skills.projectile: A guiding light: a lantern-gold beam of fog-light (like the lighthouse she used to sing boats past) that reaches out to the ally.
skills.flight: A hitscan fog-light beam to the ally, then the ally is drawn along it toward Ione at 18 m/s. Sound: her real voice, a long clear note, the only time she sings outside her super.
skills.impact: A trail of glowing fog along the pull path that lingers 1 s.
skills.target_reaction: The ally is lifted slightly and glides toward her. They see a warm lantern glow, and slows, roots and charms are washed off them in a ripple of seawater.
skills.numbers: Range 12 m, pulls the ally to within 2 m of Ione, cleanses slows, roots and charms. Ione loses 8% max HP (her throat bleeds). Cooldown 18 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see a gold line; enemies see a grey-rimmed beam.
skills.team_use: The squad's pull to safety: grab the diver who went too deep, or the carry who got rooted.

passive.name: The Only Tune
passive.effect: Each different ally Ione touches with a note or aura in 8 s gets a brass note above their head. When three different allies carry a note, her next Wind the Box is 50% stronger, and her next basic becomes a Chord.
passive.tell: The brass comb tines visible inside the music box on her chest light up one per noted ally. The crank key turns on its own a few degrees when she's ready.

super.name: The Song That Answered
super.cast: She tears the brass cage from her mouth (the cage prop detaches and falls) and, for the first time since Lirr sank, sings.
super.projectile: A rolling bank of sea fog spreading from Ione, filled with warm guiding lantern lights for allies and cold, beckoning lights for enemies, plus visible ripples of her voice.
super.flight: The fog rolls out to 16 m over 1 s (a ring of fog cards plus a ground fog decal). Voice ripples pulse from her every 0.5 s as rings of sheet-music staves. Sound: her full siren voice, unaccompanied, with a faint deep voice answering from under the ground.
super.impact: The fog stays for 5 s with soft lantern-glow spots. When it lifts it leaves a damp sheen on the ground.
super.target_reaction: Allies are Sung Home: a warm lantern glow around them, +35% move speed, and they can't be targeted by enemies further than 8 m away (the fog hides them). Enemies are Charmed: they turn and walk slowly toward Ione for 1.5 s with blank faces and fog curling from their eyes, then are slowed 30% for the rest.
super.numbers: Radius 16 m, lasts 5 s. Allies: +35% speed, hidden beyond 8 m, heal 0.4x BA/s. Enemies: charm 1.5 s (breaks if they take damage after 0.5 s), then slow 30%. Ione is rooted while singing and loses 3% max HP per second.
super.telegraph: Enemies see the fog bank with a red rim at its edge and her cage falling. Allies see a soft teal edge.
super.team_use: Turns a retreat into a clean escape or an engage into a slaughter. If The Sleeper is in the match, it answers: on Ione's team, it gets its super charged by 25%; on the enemy team, it is charmed for 3 s.
super.cinematic: Ione grips the brass cage over her mouth and wrenches it off. It falls and clinks on the stones. Camera tilts low on her face. She sings, and fog pours out of nowhere, rolling across the arena. Inside it her allies are lit by small warm lantern lights, as if boats were coming home. Her enemies stop, turn, and walk dreamily toward her voice. Underneath it all, from somewhere far below the arena floor, something sings back.
super.charge: Notes played: every heal, haste, aura tick and cleanse she gives an ally fills the super. On her body, the music box crank spins faster and the lid glows brighter brass. HUD: a music-box icon with a rotating comb.
super.counterplay: Charm breaks on damage after 0.5 s, so enemies who still get hit snap out early. Ione is rooted and bleeding for the whole 5 s. Any stun or silence ends the song immediately. Enemies within 8 m can still see and hit her allies.

beats.vfx: Cage prop drops with a spark; fog begins to curl from her feet.
beats.prop: Mouth-cage prop released to physics, falling.
beats.sound: A metallic clank; a sharp breath.

beats.tweak: Swaying as she sings; hair floats (vertex wind on hair cards only).
beats.vfx: Lantern-glow lights on allies, charm fog on enemies.

beats.tweak: She coughs, hand to throat, and picks the cage back up.
beats.vfx: Fog thins out.
beats.sound: Her cough; the music box clicks back on.

locomotion: A drifting walk with bare feet barely lifting, as if wading. The run is a long-strided glide with the arms trailing back. Base: UAL Walk_Loop retimed 10% slower; Jog_Fwd_Loop with arms swept back.
idle: Turns the music-box key a little, listens to the single tune, then touches the cage over her mouth sadly. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with additive hand layers.
hit: The music box skips a note with a sour twang; she clutches it protectively. Base: UAL Hit_Chest.
death: She sinks down as if underwater, hair floating upward. The music box plays its tune slower and slower until it stops on an unfinished note. Base: UAL Death01 slowed to 70% with an upward hair float.
victory: She winds the music box, closes her eyes, and sways to its tune. Base: UAL Dance_Loop retimed to 60%, upper body only.

animations.notes: Reaching hand and forward lean; cage door opened in code.

Soft fog-white ribbon with a teal tint.
A crooked, cracked note glyph circling an enemy's head.
Small brass note above an ally's head.
Staff-line ring with orbiting notes that slows and shrinks over 6 s.
Lantern-gold fog-light beam with drifting motes.
Ring of seawater washing off the ally.
16 m rolling fog ring with soft lantern spots. Fallback: ground fog decal and 6 cards.

Staff-line rings pulsing outward every 0.5 s.
Brass mouth cage that can detach and fall during the super.
