name: Fenwick Marl
title: the Inverse Wolf
team_job: A late-game hunter: he tags a target for the whole squad, leaps onto it, and gets stronger the longer the match goes.

basic.name: Lunge
basic.cast: He drops his weight forward and springs 2.5 m at the target, swiping a clawed hand diagonally. Base: UAL SWORD_DASH with empty hands, retimed to 0.3 s, plus a claw-swipe arm layer.
basic.projectile: Three pale moon-silver claw ribbons (one per finger), with grey fur tufts shed along the lunge.
basic.flight: A short dash, 2.5 m in 0.2 s. Claw ribbons sweep diagonally and fade in 0.25 s, with a dust kick from his boots. Sound: a snarl and a cloth-rip swish.
basic.impact: Three parallel scratch marks glow briefly on the target. A short claw-gouge decal on the ground, 1 s.
basic.target_reaction: Twisted aside by the swipe, with scratch marks glowing silver on the torso for 1 s.
basic.numbers: Lunge 2.5 m, reach 1.8 m, 1.0x BA, 1.2 attacks/s.
basic.team_use: Constantly repositions him onto targets; he sticks to fleeing carries.

basic.name: Lunge
basic.cast: Mirror with the other claw, angled up. Base: SWORD_DASH mirrored.
basic.projectile: Same ribbons, angled upward.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same, lifted slightly.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1, 1.05x BA.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Pounce
basic.cast: He crouches low (a 0.15 s hold) and leaps 4 m, both claws raised over his head, landing on the target with all his weight. Base: UAL NINJUMP_JUMP into NINJUMP_LAND, with both arms up.
basic.projectile: Paired double claw ribbons forming an X, plus a wolf-head silhouette afterimage (a faint wolf-shaped billboard sprite) at the apex.
basic.flight: Short arc, 4 m, 0.35 s, apex 1.2 m. Fur and dust trail behind. Sound: a snarl that becomes a short bark.
basic.impact: A dust and fur burst; an X-shaped claw-gouge decal, 2 s.
basic.target_reaction: Knocked flat for 0.3 s (knock-down) with an X scratch glowing on them.
basic.numbers: Leap 4 m, radius 1.5 m, 1.5x BA, knock-down 0.3 s.
basic.telegraph: A 0.15 s crouch with his eyes flaring yellow.
basic.team_use: The knock-down is long enough to land a skillshot like Oko's Fresnel Lance or Thimble's button.

skills.name: Name Tag
skills.cast: He rips one of the thirty-one brass name tags off his collar with his teeth (head dip plus a hand pull) and flings it sidearm. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW sidearm, with a head-dip layer.
skills.projectile: A small brass dog tag engraved with a name from one of the families (BISCUIT, PIP, CAPTAIN, MR. WOLF and so on, random each cast).
skills.flight: Straight line, 24 m/s, 10 m, spinning flat with a glint. Sound: a jingle, and a family voice calling the name, faint.
skills.impact: The tag sticks to the target with a little brass clink.
skills.target_reaction: Tagged: the brass tag dangles from the target's neck for 6 s with its name floating above it, so the whole squad can read it. Fenwick can recast to leap onto them from up to 10 m.
skills.numbers: Range 10 m, 1.0x BA. Tagged 6 s: Fenwick and allies deal +15% damage to the target. Recast: leap to the target, 1.4x BA. Cooldown 10 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a thin red line before the throw. Allies see the tag's name in yellow over the target.
skills.team_use: A visible focus-fire call for the squad: everyone hits the dog with the name tag.

skills.name: Howl at Nothing
skills.cast: He throws his head back and howls, even though he hates it, his hands half-raised as if embarrassed. Base: UAL Idle_Talking_Loop torso, with a head-back spine layer held 0.6 s.
skills.projectile: Pale crescent-moon rings rolling out of his mouth like sound waves.
skills.flight: A 60-degree cone, 6 m, rings expanding at 10 m/s, each ring a thin moon crescent. Sound: a long, lonely wolf howl that cracks at the end into a cough.
skills.impact: Frost-silver crescent marks on the ground, fading in 1.5 s.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies are Feared for 1 s: they turn and run away from him with their arms flailing, a crescent glyph above their heads. Allies within 8 m hear the howl and get a pale moon shimmer: Pack.
skills.numbers: Cone 6 m by 60 degrees, 0.6x BA, fear 1 s, cooldown 14 s. Allies within 8 m get +15% move speed for 3 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed cone flash 0.25 s before.
skills.team_use: Peel: scatter divers off your healer. Engage: the Pack speed buff lets the squad close in.

passive.name: Waning Moon
passive.effect: Fenwick grows stronger the longer the match lasts: every 60 s, and every takedown he's part of, the moon over him wanes one phase (5 phases). Each phase gives +5% damage and +3% attack speed. At the last phase he sprints on all fours (+10% sprint speed).
passive.tell: His borrowed clothes visibly tear further each phase (a shader dissolve on the shirt and vest), the name tags rattle more, and a small moon crescent above his HUD bar thins. His tail is part of the mesh skinned to the hips bone with a vertex-shader sway, so it wags more in later phases.

super.name: No Moon at All
super.cast: Fenwick drops to all fours and looks up. The full moon above the arena darkens and goes out, the one night a month he gets to stop being a man. He becomes, for a few seconds, entirely wolf.
super.projectile: A huge spectral wolf shape around him (a translucent wolf-shaped shell made from layered billboard cards around his body), silver at the edges, plus moon-claw slashes.
super.flight: He chain-leaps between up to 6 enemies within 6 m of each other, 0.3 s per leap, each leap a silver arc trail. Each target gets an X of moon-claws. Sound: a pack howl layered from many wolves, each leap a snarl.
super.impact: Every landing leaves a silver X decal (2 s). The arena's ambient light dims while it lasts.
super.target_reaction: Each victim gets a silver X slash and a short stagger. The last target is knocked down for 0.8 s. A family name tag glints over each victim's head.
super.numbers: Up to 6 leaps, 6 m max between targets, 1.6x BA per leap (a single target can be hit twice at most). The final hit knocks down for 0.8 s. Fenwick is untargetable during each leap's air time (0.2 s). At the end, he gets a shield of 2.0x BA: one family's porch light.
super.telegraph: Enemies see a red marker over the next target 0.3 s before each leap.
super.team_use: Cleans up a fight the squad started. The Tagged target from Name Tag is always leaped to first.
super.cinematic: The light dims. Overhead, a full moon hangs above the arena, then visibly shrinks and goes dark. Fenwick drops to all fours, and his outline swells into a vast silver wolf. He howls, and many wolves howl with him. Then he vanishes from spot to spot across the fight in silver arcs, slashing, until the last enemy is on the ground. As the moon comes back, he's just a scruffy man in a torn vest again, and one name tag on his collar glows warmly.
super.charge: Moon phases: charge fills from match time (slowly) and from hits and takedowns. On his body, his yellow eyes glow brighter and the brass tags on his collar shine one by one. HUD: a moon icon that wanes from full to new.
super.counterplay: Spread out more than 6 m apart and the chain stops. Each next target is marked 0.3 s before the leap. Any hard crowd control on Fenwick between leaps ends the chain. He shows up with a big shield at the end, so burst him just before it.

beats.vfx: Moon sprite in the sky darkens; the wolf-shell cards fade in around him.

beats.tweak: A leap-slash per target, each 0.3 s with a 0.05 s hold on contact.

beats.tweak: Lands in a crouch on the last target, claws down.
beats.vfx: Silver burst, knock-down dust.

beats.tweak: Stands up awkwardly, tugs his vest straight, embarrassed.
beats.vfx: Wolf shell fades; one name tag glows.

locomotion: Upright he walks awkwardly, as if his boots pinch, shoulders hunched. He runs leaning far forward. In late phases his sprint drops to all fours. Base: UAL Walk_Loop with a hunch; Sprint_Loop; Crouch_Fwd_Loop retimed fast for the four-legged sprint.
idle: Scratches behind an ear with a clawed hand, sniffs the air, tugs at his collar of tags in irritation. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with additive head and hand layers.
hit: He yelps and flinches with his ears flattening (an ear-shape morph would need blend shapes, so instead he ducks his head sharply). Base: UAL Hit_Head.
death: He drops to all fours, then lies down on his side like a tired dog. The name tags spill off his collar onto the ground. Base: UAL Death02.
victory: He sits on the ground with his legs out, scratches behind an ear, then looks at one particular name tag and almost smiles. Base: UAL Sitting_Idle_Loop.

animations.notes: 200% speed, hands brushing the ground, for late phases.
0.15 s crouch hold, both arms raised.
Sidearm, with a teeth-pull head dip.
Head back 0.6 s, hands half raised.

vfx.direction: Three moon-silver ribbons from the fingertip bones, fading in 0.25 s.
Grey fur tufts on lunges.
Three-line claw gouge; an X variant for Pounce.
A faint wolf head shape at the Pounce apex.
Small brass tag with a random engraved name; the name floats over the tagged target.
Thin crescent rings expanding in a cone.
Small crescent moon glyph above feared enemies.
Dissolve mask on shirt and vest per moon phase.
Layered silver wolf-shaped cards around his body. Fallback: one wolf billboard.
Arena moon sprite that darkens during the super.

combos.setup: Aurvan lets the moon out (an allied super).
combos.payoff: Fenwick's super charge jumps by 50%: the moon is the reason for his curse.

combos.payoff: Fenwick's Lunges and Name Tag leap chain into targets twice as fast.

combos.payoff: Fenwick Name Tags and leaps onto the lone target.

name: Thimble
title: the Left-Behind
team_job: Moves people: he swaps an ally out of danger, opens fairy-ring portals for the squad, and swaps the enemy carry into the middle of your team.

basic.name: Button Shot
basic.cast: He pulls a little slingshot from his satchel (a forked hazel twig with a knitted sock for the band; prop on the right hand bone), loads a button from his sweater cuff, and fires. Base: UAL Pistol_Aim_Neutral into Pistol_Shoot, with the left hand drawing back the band.
basic.projectile: A mismatched sweater button (wooden, horn or red plastic, chosen at random) trailing a single strand of mustard yarn pulled from his sweater.
basic.flight: Straight line, 22 m/s, 10 m. The yarn strand trails out behind it for 1.5 m and snaps off. Sound: a twangy pop, a little whistle through the button holes.
basic.impact: The button bounces off with a tiny pop of yarn fluff.
basic.target_reaction: A flinch with one eye squeezed shut, as if hit by a pea.
basic.numbers: Range 10 m, width 0.4 m, 1.0x BA, 1.15 attacks/s.
basic.team_use: Poke damage that keeps him safe while his skills do the real work.

basic.name: Button Shot
basic.cast: Same, quicker reload, with a hop. Base: Pistol_Shoot retimed 10% faster.
basic.projectile: A different button.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Acorn Cap
basic.style: Aimed skillshot line (lands as a small trap)
basic.cast: He loads a fae acorn cap instead of a button, pulls the band all the way back with his tongue out, and fires. Base: Pistol_Aim_Neutral with a 0.2 s hold.
basic.projectile: An acorn cap glowing faint fae green, with sparkles of pollen.
basic.flight: Straight line, 18 m/s, 10 m. At the end of its range, or on hitting an enemy, it drops and sprouts. Sound: a soft pop, then a tinkle like tiny bells.
basic.impact: A 2 m fairy ring of little red-capped toadstools springs up for 2 s (decal plus small instanced toadstool meshes).
basic.target_reaction: Enemies hit or stepping into the ring are Turned Around: they spin once in place (the victim plays a quick turn) and are slowed 30% for 1.5 s, with fae sparkles circling them.
basic.numbers: Range 10 m, 1.2x BA, ring radius 2 m for 2 s, slow 30% for 1.5 s.
basic.telegraph: Enemies see the toadstool ring with a red rim.
basic.team_use: A small zone that slows chasers.

skills.name: Swap
skills.cast: He points at the target, then at himself, squinting, and snaps his fingers. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with a point-and-snap hand layer.
skills.projectile: A twin flash of fae glamour: a swirl of green-gold sparkles and a crib-blanket shimmer around both units.
skills.flight: Instant. Both units blink out (a 0.1 s shrink-and-sparkle) and swap positions, leaving a faint knitted-yarn line connecting the two spots for 0.5 s. Sound: a lullaby chime and a pop.
skills.impact: A small toadstool ring appears at each spot for 1 s.
skills.target_reaction: Ally: lands with a little hop, sparkles on their shoulders and the speed buff. Enemy: lands dizzy, a halo of tiny stars around the head for 0.5 s.
skills.numbers: Range 12 m, any ally or enemy. Recast within 2 s to swap back. Enemies are dizzied 0.5 s. Cooldown 12 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a green sparkle burst on themselves 0.15 s before they swap.
skills.team_use: Rescue an ally who is being dove, pull an enemy into your squad, or put yourself in the line of fire for a friend.

skills.name: Fairy Ring
skills.cast: He tips his thimble helmet off, shakes mushroom spores out of it onto the ground, then throws a second handful far ahead. Base: UAL PLANT_SEED (drop frames) into OVERHAND_THROW.
skills.projectile: Two rings of red-capped toadstools: one where he stands, one up to 14 m away. The spores fly as a glowing green-gold puff.
skills.flight: The far spores arc at 14 m/s and plant a ring where they land. A faint glowing yarn thread links the two rings. Sound: fairy bells.
skills.impact: Two toadstool rings, 1.5 m radius, with a soft green light inside, lasting 6 s.
skills.target_reaction: Allies who step into a ring are whisked to the other ring with a sparkle (0.2 s). Enemies who step in are made to dance: a short jig on the spot (the victim plays a dance clip), rooted 0.8 s.
skills.numbers: Ring distance up to 14 m, rings last 6 s, ally teleport 0.2 s with a 1 s per-ally cooldown, enemy root 0.8 s. Cooldown 18 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see green-gold rings with a soft white outline. Enemies see red-rimmed rings.
skills.team_use: A portal network: put one ring behind your squad and one at the objective. Retreat paths, flank paths, rescues.

passive.name: Two Families
passive.effect: Allies swapped or teleported by Thimble get +20% move speed for 2 s (the Pellings cheering them on). Thimble takes 15% less damage while an ally is within 4 m.
passive.tell: The red patches knitted onto his sweater glow when an ally is near, and his thimble helmet glints.

super.name: Changeling
super.cast: He takes the thimble off his head, blows into it like a whistle, and a fae lullaby plays. He points at one enemy. The fae are calling their changeling home, and he swaps that enemy into his place.
super.projectile: A spiralling column of fae glamour (green-gold sparkles and pale moths) around the target, then the target themselves, transformed.
super.flight: A 0.6 s channel ring forms under the target. Then the target and Thimble swap positions in a flash. The enemy arrives in the middle of Thimble's team, shrunk to half size and wrapped in a knitted mustard sweater with a thimble on their head. Sound: a lullaby music box, a baby's giggle, and a pop.
super.impact: A toadstool ring at both swap points; a puff of moths.
super.target_reaction: The enemy is Changelinged for 2.5 s: their model scales to 55% with a fae-green tint, a knitted sweater shader over their clothes and a thimble prop on their head bone. They can't attack or use skills and move 30% slower.
super.numbers: Range 9 m, channel 0.6 s, polymorph 2.5 s, enemy takes +20% damage while polymorphed. Thimble and the target trade places.
super.telegraph: The target sees a green-gold ring on the ground and lullaby notes for 0.6 s.
super.team_use: A pick for the whole squad: the enemy carry arrives in your team as a helpless fae child for 2.5 s. Thimble lands in the enemy's spot, so pair it with Fairy Ring to get him back out.
super.cinematic: Thimble tugs his thimble helmet off and blows into it. A thin, sweet lullaby plays and pale moths swirl around one enemy. Camera nudges in. Then pop: Thimble is standing where the enemy was, and the enemy is standing in the middle of Thimble's team, half-size, wrapped in a mustard sweater with a thimble on their head, blinking. They have 2.5 seconds to regret it.
super.charge: Lunches packed: every swap, teleport and ally rescue fills the super. On his body, the patches on his sweater fill in with new red knitting, one patch per 20%. HUD: a thimble icon filling with sparkles.
super.counterplay: The 0.6 s channel ring is a warning: dash out of it or break line of sight to cancel. A cleanse ends the polymorph. Thimble lands deep in the enemy's position and needs a ring or an ally to get out.

beats.tweak: Lifts the thimble off his head and raises it to his lips; his other hand points at the target.
beats.vfx: Lullaby notes and a moth swirl around the target; a green-gold ring forms under them.

name: The Unwritten
title: the Golem Without a Word

team_class.secondary: Flex: the day's word (dive, tank, damage or sustain)

team_job: A clay bruiser that becomes whatever the squad needs today: brave, patient, angry or hungry. It can lend its word to an ally, and its super writes that word onto the whole team.

basic.name: Chalk Jab
basic.style: Transform / stance swap (melee in every word)
basic.cast: A heavy clay jab. Before the match, the player picks two words from BRAVE, PATIENT, ANGRY and HUNGRY. Each word is a stance with its own pose layer: BRAVE leans forward, PATIENT stands square, ANGRY hunches, HUNGRY crouches. Base: UAL Punch_Jab with a per-word additive pose layer.
basic.projectile: The clay fist itself, plus a chalk letter that flies off the knuckles on impact (one letter of the current word per hit, as a glowing chalk glyph sprite).
basic.flight: A short 2.2 m punch. A puff of chalk dust trails the fist, and the chalk letter pops off and sticks to the target. Sound: a dull clay thud and a chalk-on-slate scratch.
basic.impact: A chalk dust cloud and a crumb of clay. The letter is stamped onto the target.
basic.target_reaction: The victim's head rocks back, and a glowing chalk letter appears on their body. The letters spell the current word across successive hits (B-R-A-V-E, A-N-G-R-Y and so on).
basic.numbers: Range 2.2 m, 1.0x BA, 1.0 hits/s. +1 letter.
basic.team_use: Each completed word on a target triggers a word effect (see passive), so the whole chain builds toward it.

basic.name: Clay Hook
basic.cast: A wide clay hook. BRAVE: a stepping hook. PATIENT: a short parry-hook that blocks the next hit for 0.4 s. ANGRY: a wild haymaker. HUNGRY: a grabbing hook that pulls the target in 0.5 m. Base: UAL Punch_Cross with the per-word layer.
basic.projectile: The clay forearm with a smear of wet clay flicked off its arc (clay spatter particles), plus a second chalk letter.
basic.flight: Arc of 100 degrees, 2.4 m reach. Clay spatter flies along the arc. Sound: a thick wet thwack.
basic.impact: Clay smears onto the target; a chalk letter sticks.
basic.target_reaction: Turned by the hook, with a clay smear on the cheek and the next letter added.
basic.numbers: Range 2.4 m, 1.1x BA. +1 letter. PATIENT: blocks the next hit for 0.4 s. HUNGRY: heals 15% of damage dealt.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Word Strike
basic.style: Transform / stance swap (finisher changes per word)
basic.cast: The finisher changes with the word. BRAVE: a 4 m shoulder charge (SWORD_DASH). PATIENT: a palm push that raises a clay slab wall (Spell_Simple_Shoot palm). ANGRY: a two-fisted ground slam (Sword_Attack overhead, empty hands). HUNGRY: a grab-and-squeeze (MELEE_HOOK).
basic.projectile: BRAVE: a rush of chalk dust shaped like a shield ahead of it. PATIENT: a 2 m wide clay slab that rises from the ground. ANGRY: cracked clay shrapnel bursting from the fists. HUNGRY: clay tendrils pulling the target in.
basic.flight: BRAVE: 4 m charge in 0.3 s. PATIENT: the slab pushes out 2 m. ANGRY: a 2.5 m radial burst. HUNGRY: a 2 m pull. Sound per word: battle cry, low hum, roar, stomach growl.
basic.impact: BRAVE: a chalk skid line. PATIENT: the slab stays 2 s as cover. ANGRY: a shattered-clay crater decal. HUNGRY: a wet clay puddle.
basic.target_reaction: BRAVE: knocked back 2 m. PATIENT: pushed 2 m and slowed. ANGRY: knocked up 0.4 s. HUNGRY: dragged in and held 0.4 s. Each adds a chalk letter.
basic.numbers: 1.5x BA. BRAVE: knock-back 2 m. PATIENT: slab wall 2 s, 2.0x BA HP. ANGRY: radius 2.5 m, knock-up 0.4 s. HUNGRY: heals 40% of damage dealt.
basic.telegraph: A 0.2 s glow of the chalk word on its chest.
basic.team_use: Each word's finisher fills a different team need.

skills.name: Rewrite
skills.cast: It wipes the word off its chest with a flat palm, plucks the chalk stick from behind its ear, and scrawls the other word. Base: UAL Fixing_Kneeling (hand motion only) layered on Idle_Loop, with a wipe then a write.
skills.projectile: The new word in chalk on its chest, glowing gold for a moment, and an arc of chalk dust.
skills.flight: Chalk dust bursts outward in a 3 m ring. Sound: a squeak of chalk, a deep clay settle.
skills.impact: A chalk scribble decal under its feet, 1 s.
skills.target_reaction: The Unwritten itself: its posture changes, and the word on its chest glows for 2 s.
skills.numbers: Swap between the two chosen words. 1.0 s cast. The new word's passive is 30% stronger for 2 s. Cooldown 8 s.
skills.telegraph: Everyone can read the word on its chest from the top-down camera (an oversized glowing chalk glyph on the chest).
skills.team_use: Read the fight: BRAVE to dive, PATIENT to hold a point, ANGRY to finish, HUNGRY to outlast.

skills.name: Lend a Word
skills.cast: It walks its chalk to an ally and writes its current word on the ally's back. Base: UAL Interact with a reaching write motion. A quick-cast flings the chalk scrawl from 6 m (the letters fly as glyphs).
skills.projectile: Chalk letters that fly from its hand to the ally, settling on their back as a glowing word.
skills.flight: Glyphs fly at 18 m/s in a string, one after another. Sound: rapid chalk scratches.
skills.impact: The ally's back shows the word for the duration.
skills.target_reaction: The ally sees the word glowing on their own back. BRAVE: +20% damage and crowd-control immune for 1.5 s. PATIENT: 25% damage reduction for 3 s. ANGRY: +25% attack speed for 3 s. HUNGRY: 20% lifesteal for 3 s.
skills.numbers: Range 6 m, durations as listed, cooldown 14 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see the word in chalk-gold; enemies see it with a grey rim so they know what the target has.
skills.team_use: Gives a buff to whoever needs it: BRAVE on the diver, PATIENT on the carry.

passive.name: Spelled Out
passive.effect: When all the letters of its current word are stamped on one enemy, the word triggers. BRAVE (5 letters): the Unwritten gains a 1.5x BA shield. PATIENT (7): the enemy is rooted 1 s in hardening clay. ANGRY (5): a clay burst deals 1.5x BA around the enemy. HUNGRY (6): the Unwritten heals 2.0x BA. In water (Wrenna's floods, the Sleeper's sea, Nyssa's river), the chalk runs: the word doesn't trigger, but its hits slow by 15% because it turns to mud.
passive.tell: The chalk word on its chest glows brighter with each letter landed on the current target; letters run and drip in water. The chalk stick behind its ear wears down over the match.

super.name: The True Word
super.style: Ground zone (word written on the arena)
super.cast: It snaps its chalk in half and, for the first time, writes a word that is not for itself. It drags both halves across the ground in huge letters, and the word becomes law for its squad.
super.projectile: A giant glowing word written across the ground in chalk-gold strokes, 10 m wide (its current word), and the Unwritten's body briefly fired hard and shining like glazed pottery.
super.flight: It scrawls the word in 1.2 s, the strokes appearing as an animated decal while it moves along them. The finished word lifts glowing letters (billboard glyphs) 1 m off the ground. Sound: an enormous chalk scratch, then a kiln roar.
super.impact: The word stays written on the ground for 6 s as a 10 m zone. Enemies can scuff letters by standing on them.
super.target_reaction: Allies inside see the word on their own backs. BRAVE: crowd-control immune and +25% damage. PATIENT: 40% damage reduction. ANGRY: +35% attack speed, and a giant clay fist rises from the ground and slams the nearest enemy every 1.5 s. HUNGRY: 30% lifesteal. Enemies see the word red-rimmed.
super.numbers: Zone 10 m wide, lasts 6 s. Effects as listed (ANGRY fist 2.0x BA per slam). Each letter an enemy stands on for 1 s is erased and shortens the effect by 1 s. The Unwritten takes 30% less damage during the effect (fired clay).
super.telegraph: Enemies see the letters being written over 1.2 s with a red rim: get there and scuff them.
super.team_use: A team-wide buff that matches the squad: write BRAVE to dive the backline, PATIENT to hold a choke, ANGRY to finish, HUNGRY to win a long brawl.
super.cinematic: The Unwritten looks down at its chest, at the word it wrote this morning, and snaps its chalk in two. It drops to its knees and drags both pieces across the arena floor in huge, careful letters. The strokes burn gold. When it finishes, the letters rise off the ground like they are being read aloud, and every ally standing on the word feels it written on their own back. The Unwritten's clay hardens and shines as if fired. Its maker gave it no word, so it has given one to everyone else.
super.charge: Letters landed: +1 per chalk letter stamped, +5 for each completed word. On its body, the chalk stick behind its ear glows brighter, and the chest word fills with gold from the first letter to the last. HUD: a chalk tally that fills.
super.counterplay: Scuff the letters: every letter an enemy stands on for 1 s is erased and cuts 1 s off the effect. The 1.2 s writing is a long warning, and the Unwritten is slowed 50% while writing. Rain-themed water effects (enemy Wrenna or Sleeper floods) smear the letters twice as fast.

name: Lysandra Kole
title: the Stonemason's Widow
team_job: A bodyguard with stone hands: she blocks shots aimed at the carry, chisels allies free of crowd control, and turns a diving team into a garden of statues.

basic.name: Mason's Jab
basic.cast: A short, efficient jab with a heavy stone fist, as if knocking a flaw off a block. Base: UAL Punch_Jab with a heavier follow-through.
basic.projectile: Her marble fist, with a spray of white stone chips and a puff of marble dust from the knuckles.
basic.flight: A 2.2 m punch. Chips spray forward in a narrow cone and dust hangs for 0.4 s. Sound: a sharp stone crack, like a chisel tap.
basic.impact: Chips scatter and a dust puff hangs in the air.
basic.target_reaction: The target's head is knocked back, with grey dust left on its clothes.
basic.numbers: Range 2.2 m, 0.9x BA, 1.1 hits/s.
basic.team_use: Quick poke to stay on a diver.

basic.name: Mason's Cross
basic.cast: A right cross with a full step in. Base: UAL Punch_Cross.
basic.projectile: Stone fist with a heavier chip spray.
basic.flight: Same, 2.4 m.
basic.impact: Chips and dust.
basic.target_reaction: A stagger back.
basic.numbers: Range 2.4 m, 1.0x BA.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Chisel Split
basic.cast: Hold: she draws the hammer and chisel from her hip holster (props to both hand bones), kneels slightly, sets the chisel against the ground and raises the hammer, her goggles lowering over her eyes. Release: one perfect hammer strike. Base: UAL Fixing_Kneeling hold, then a hammer strike from Sword_Attack on the right arm.
basic.projectile: A straight crack that splits the ground along the aimed line, with flakes of stone peeling up from its edges.
basic.flight: Instant line, 4-7 m depending on charge. The crack races out at 30 m/s with stone flakes flipping up along it. Sound: a ringing chisel strike, then the splitting crack of quarried stone.
basic.impact: A deep straight crack decal with flake debris, 3 s.
basic.target_reaction: Enemies on the line are Flaked: stone flakes peel from their bodies (falling flake particles) and their armour is shredded 15% for 4 s. At full charge they are also stunned 0.8 s, stone creeping briefly over their feet.
basic.numbers: Line 4-7 m by 1 m. Damage 1.4x BA (tap-release) to 2.4x BA (full 1.2 s). Armour shred 15% for 4 s. Full charge: stun 0.8 s.
basic.telegraph: Enemies see a red line growing as she charges.
basic.team_use: Armour shred makes the whole squad's damage hit harder; the stun sets up Wrenna's flood or Hob's Founder's Hammer.

skills.name: Stone Hands
skills.cast: She turns her hands fully to stone (marble creeps over them in 0.1 s) and slams them together in front of her as a wall. Base: UAL IDLE_SHIELD with both forearms raised, palms out.
skills.projectile: A broad marble barrier made of her two giant hands, plus a ghostly stone wall extending 1 m to each side (a translucent marble quad).
skills.flight: Instant. The barrier holds in front of her. Blocked projectiles hit it and crumble to dust. Sound: a grinding slam, and a crunch for each blocked hit.
skills.impact: Blocked projectiles leave dust puffs and small rubble at her feet.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies that melee the barrier have their weapon arm jarred back (a recoil reaction) and are slowed 20% for 1 s. Allies behind her see a pale marble outline on the barrier.
skills.numbers: Frontal 120 degrees, 3 m wide, blocks all damage for up to 2 s (+0.2 s per Flake stack). Cooldown 8 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a solid marble wall with a red rim on its front.
skills.team_use: Stand in front of your carry and catch Oko's lance, Nyssa's coins or Kallix's embers.

skills.name: Chisel Free
skills.cast: She leaps to an ally, lands beside them and taps them sharply with her chisel. Base: UAL NINJUMP_JUMP into a chisel tap (Punch_Jab with the chisel prop).
skills.projectile: A ring of stone flakes and marble dust bursting off the ally, as if a statue were being chiselled free.
skills.flight: Leap 8 m in 0.35 s, then the tap. Flakes burst outward. Sound: a single precise chisel ping.
skills.impact: A small ring of fallen stone flakes at the ally's feet.
skills.target_reaction: The ally sees their crowd control crack off their body like a stone shell breaking and falling, then a thin marble skin over them (shield). Enemies within 2 m are knocked back 1.5 m.
skills.numbers: Leap range 8 m, cleanses stun, root and slow on the ally, gives a 1.5x BA shield for 3 s, knock-back 1.5 m around them. Cooldown 14 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see a white chisel icon over themselves when she's in range.
skills.team_use: The squad's anti-stun: free the carry from a root or stun and bodyguard them in one move.

passive.name: Flake by Flake
passive.effect: Each Stone Hands use adds a Flake stack (max 5, lasting 20 s): +5% damage reduction per stack, but -3% move speed per stack. At 5 stacks she becomes Half-Statue: +10% more damage reduction and Chisel Split charges 30% faster.
passive.tell: Stone visibly climbs her body: marble creeps from her hands to her elbows, shoulders, collarbones and finally her jaw with each stack (a height mask on the marble shader). Her goggles fog with dust at 5 stacks.

super.name: The Gorgon's Garden
super.cast: She drives both stone fists into the ground. Stone floods out of her into the earth, and everyone near her starts to become a statue, the same thing she spent thirty years carving faces onto.
super.projectile: A wave of marble spreading across the ground, then stone creeping up every enemy in it until they stand frozen as statues with blank carved faces.
super.flight: The marble wave radiates from her to 7 m in 0.4 s (an animated decal mask with crack lines). Then stone climbs each enemy from their feet upward over 0.6 s. Sound: grinding stone, then a deep echoing silence, then a single chisel tap.
super.impact: A marble floor decal with fine cracks, lasting 4 s.
super.target_reaction: Petrified: a marble shader climbs the enemy from feet to head, their pose freezes mid-motion (animation paused), and their face goes blank and carved. They are stunned for 1.8 s. Hits on them chip off stone flakes.
super.numbers: Radius 7 m, 2.0x BA, petrify 1.8 s. Allies' hits on petrified enemies deal +40% (Shatter). If Ophira is on the team, her gaze shatters petrified enemies below 25% HP. Lysandra herself turns to stone for 1.0 s after the cast (invulnerable but unable to act).
super.telegraph: Lysandra's own body goes fully marble first over 1 s, from hands to head, an unmistakable warning; enemies see a red-rimmed 7 m circle.
super.team_use: Locks down a group dive for a full squad burst. The +40% Shatter rewards everyone focusing the statues.
super.cinematic: Lysandra's stone hands crack the ground as she drops to her knees. Camera tightens on her goggles as marble creeps up over her face, the stone she has fought to chisel off everyone else. Then she slams both fists down and the stone pours out of her across the floor, and every enemy in reach freezes mid-step, marble climbing to their necks and then over their faces, carved blank. For a moment the arena looks like the garden outside the gorgon's cave. Her allies get to work with hammers.
super.charge: Flakes chiselled: damage blocked by Stone Hands and armour shredded by Chisel Split fill the super. On her body, her goggles slowly fill with swirling marble dust and her hands glow with fine white cracks. HUD: a chisel icon that fills with stone.
super.counterplay: 1 s warning while she turns to stone first: leave the 7 m circle. A cleanse removes petrify. Lysandra is stuck as stone for 1 s after the cast, so she can't follow up and the super can't be chained with her own Chisel Free.

basic.target_reaction: Each victim jerks as if stung, and a small singe mark glows on them (an ember decal on the body) for 1 s.

skills.projectile: A burning spectral hand, made of ember ribbons in a hand shape (a flipbook of a grasping hand), that grabs a glowing icon of the enemy's last-used ability.
skills.flight: Straight line, 30 m/s, 8 m. The hand returns along the same line carrying the ability glyph. Sound: a whoosh, a snatch, then a cackle.
skills.impact: A flare at the target's chest as the ability is ripped out.
skills.target_reaction: The victim stumbles toward Kallix as if something was pulled out of their chest. A small flame-shaped hole flickers on their chest for 2 s, and their stolen ability shows a burning padlock on their skill bar (their own HUD).
skills.numbers: Range 8 m, width 0.8 m. Steals the target's last-used ability for 8 s (Kallix can cast it once, recoloured in ember and ash). The victim's ability cooldown is extended by 2 s. Cooldown 20 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red line flash 0.2 s before the grab.
skills.team_use: Steal a heal, a wall or a crowd-control tool to save an ally. Stealing Ione's Sing Them Home lets him pull his own ally to safety.

skills.name: Bellows
skills.cast: He squeezes the leather bellows bulb on his belt (a prop; it compresses with a scale animation) with one hand and holds the other palm out to aim the gust. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with a hip-squeeze layer.
skills.projectile: A gust of wind that fans every ember it touches into roaring flame: an orange cone of fire with ash curls.
skills.flight: A 50-degree cone, 6 m, flames rolling out at 12 m/s. Burning enemies in the cone flare up. Fire jumps along any tether, thread, wax or rope effect it touches. Sound: a bellows huff, then a roar.
skills.impact: A scorched cone decal for 2 s.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies hit are set Burning (flame flipbook on the body) and pushed back 1 m. If they were already burning, they flare white-hot for a burst.
skills.numbers: Cone 6 m by 50 degrees, 1.2x BA, Burning 0.3x BA/s for 3 s; burning targets take an extra 1.0x BA burst. Fire travels along allied tethers and threads (Sena's Knot, Moss's Thread, Ysolt's chains) to every enemy connected, and ignites Mott's wax seals on enemies. Cooldown 9 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red cone flash 0.2 s before.
skills.team_use: Sena ties enemies together; Kallix lights the thread and the fire runs to all of them.

passive.name: The Spark Is Going Out
passive.effect: His chest coal slowly dims over time (from bright to dim in 30 s without feeding). Every enemy he sets burning feeds it. When bright, he deals +20% damage; when dim, -20%. Takedowns refill it fully.
passive.tell: The glow behind his chest grate brightens and dims, and the flames on his bracers grow and shrink. When it's nearly out, he coughs a puff of ash.

super.name: Who Gets Fire Next
super.cast: He grips the grate on his chest with both hands and tears it fully open. The original spark, the first fire ever stolen, floats out in front of him, and he decides who gets fire.
super.projectile: The original spark (a small white-gold star with a corona of red flame) above his hands, then dozens of small flames: some ripped out of enemies, some thrown to allies.
super.flight: For 1.5 s, a small flame is pulled out of the chest of every enemy within 12 m and streams into the spark (homing ember ribbons). Then the spark bursts and throws a flame to every ally within 12 m (homing at 20 m/s). Sound: a deep inhale like a furnace drawing air, then a roar.
super.impact: The arena light dims except around Kallix (a screen-tint pass). Ash drifts down for 4 s.
super.target_reaction: Enemies hunch as their flame is pulled out of their chest, and for 6 s they are Unlit: no flame-heart, colours desaturated, and their super charge is drained by 25%. Allies receive Fire-Given: a small flame burns over their heart, their attacks leave embers and ignite.
super.numbers: Radius 12 m. Enemies: 1.5x BA, -25% super charge, -15% damage for 6 s. Allies: +20% damage and attacks ignite (0.3x BA/s for 2 s) for 6 s. Kallix's passive coal is refilled to full.
super.telegraph: Enemies see their own chest flame pulling toward Kallix during the 1.5 s channel, a clear sign to stun him.
super.team_use: A team-wide damage buff and an enemy-wide debuff in one move, and it takes away a quarter of each enemy's super.
super.cinematic: Kallix tears his chest grate open with both hands and the arena light fades. Camera pushes in on the open grate. Inside, a white-gold point of fire floats free, the spark he stole back from mortals. Around him, tiny flames lift out of every enemy's chest and stream into it, and the enemies go grey. Then he grins, throws his arms wide, and the spark bursts: a flame flies to each of his allies and settles over their heart. He decides who gets fire next.
super.charge: Fire stolen: every ignite and stolen ability fills it. On his body, the flames on his bracers climb up his forearms toward the elbows, and the grate glows white at full charge. HUD: a flame icon behind a grate.
super.counterplay: The 1.5 s channel exposes the spark: Kallix takes double damage while channelling, and any stun or silence cancels it and refunds half the charge. Soaked enemies (Wrenna, Sleeper floods) are immune to the theft half.

name: Oko
title: the Lighthouse Cyclops
team_job: The squad's lighthouse: long-range beam damage, a sweep that reveals and blinds, and a passive that shows allies enemy skillshots before they're thrown.

basic.name: Lens Flash
basic.cast: He squares his shoulders, plants his rubber boots, and narrows his single great eye behind its brass lens ring. The lens ring clicks a quarter turn (a prop ring on the head bone, rotated in code). Base: UAL Pistol_Aim_Neutral with the arms down and a head-forward layer.
basic.projectile: A narrow warm-white beam of lighthouse light from his eye lens.
basic.flight: Hitscan, 12 m, held for 0.08 s, with dust motes lit up along it and a lens-flare star at the hit point. Sound: a click of brass and a short hum.
basic.impact: A bright starburst on the target and a small heat shimmer.
basic.target_reaction: The victim squints and raises an arm against the glare (a flinch with a forearm-up layer).
basic.numbers: Range 12 m, 1.0x BA, 0.95 attacks/s.
basic.telegraph: Enemies see a thin yellow aim line from his eye while he's attacking them.
basic.team_use: Reliable long-range damage that never misses within range.

basic.name: Lens Flash
basic.cast: Same, the ring clicking the other way.
basic.projectile: Same beam.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1, 1.05x BA.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Fresnel Lance
basic.cast: He cups both huge hands around the sides of his lens like a man shading his eye against the sun, focusing the light. The lens ring spins up. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Enter with hands framing the head, held 0.3 s.
basic.projectile: A thick ringed beam: a concentric Fresnel-lens pattern visible inside the light (a scrolling ring texture) like the light from a real lighthouse lens.
basic.flight: Hitscan, 14 m, pierces all enemies on the line, held 0.15 s. Rings scroll along it. Sound: a rising whine, then a deep thrum.
basic.impact: Each target bursts with light; a scorched line decal, 1 s.
basic.target_reaction: Victims recoil and are Dazzled for 1 s: a white glare overlay on the face and a 10% slow.
basic.numbers: Range 14 m, width 0.6 m, pierces, 1.6x BA, Dazzle 1 s.
basic.telegraph: A 0.3 s yellow aim line that thickens before firing.
basic.team_use: Lines up through the enemies Lysandra just shredded or Aurvan just pulled together.

skills.name: Sweeping Beam
skills.cast: Oko turns his whole upper body slowly from one side to the other like the light in a lighthouse tower, his eye blazing. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with a slow 180-degree spine and neck rotation layer over 1.5 s.
skills.projectile: A wide fan of lighthouse light, 10 m long, swinging across 180 degrees.
skills.flight: The beam rotates 180 degrees over 1.5 s. Its leading edge is bright and its trailing edge fades. Dust motes and sea-spray particles drift in the light. Sound: a low foghorn and the turning creak of a lighthouse mechanism.
skills.impact: Swept ground is briefly lit pale yellow and fades over 1 s.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies swept are Revealed (a yellow outline visible to his whole team through walls, 4 s) and Blinded for 2 s: their basic attacks miss 50% of the time, and their own screen gets a white glare vignette.
skills.numbers: Radius 10 m, 180-degree sweep over 1.5 s, 0.8x BA per enemy, Reveal 4 s, Blind 2 s. Allies' skillshots deal +15% to Blinded targets. Cooldown 12 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see the beam's path as a red-rimmed half-circle with the sweep direction marked.
skills.team_use: Reveals stealthed divers and flankers, and blind protects the backline for 2 s.

skills.name: Keeper's Rope
skills.cast: He shrugs the coil of rope off his shoulder and throws its weighted end in a long lasso throw. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW with a loop-swing windup layer.
skills.projectile: The lighthouse keeper's rope with a heavy iron mooring ring on its end.
skills.flight: Straight line, 22 m/s, 10 m. The rope pays out from his shoulder as a verlet ribbon. Sound: a rope whir and a clank.
skills.impact: The ring clamps on, the rope snaps taut, and he hauls hand over hand.
skills.target_reaction: An enemy is dragged 4 m toward him and stumbles. An ally is pulled to his side and sees a yellow mooring ring on their waist.
skills.numbers: Range 10 m. Enemy: pull 4 m, 0.8x BA, 0.3 s stun at the end. Ally: pull to Oko's side and +15% damage reduction for 2 s. Cooldown 14 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red rope line flash. Allies see a gold line.
skills.team_use: Pull an ally out of a bad fight, or drag a diver into your squad's reach.

passive.name: Seen It Before
passive.effect: Oko sees enemy skillshot telegraphs 0.3 s earlier than normal, and shares them: every enemy skillshot aimed within 10 m of Oko shows its line as a faint yellow lighthouse ray to his whole team before it's thrown.
passive.tell: His great eye darts toward the danger and the brass lens ring glints yellow a split second before an enemy casts.

super.name: The Light Stays On
super.cast: He plants his feet and lifts his head. The brass lens over his eye unfolds into a full lighthouse Fresnel lens, ring after ring of brass and glass opening around his head. The night falls, and the light stays on.
super.projectile: A colossal rotating lighthouse beam from the enormous lens around his head, sweeping the whole arena.
super.flight: The lens opens over 0.8 s. Then the beam sweeps a full 360 degrees twice over 4 s, 30 m long and 10 degrees wide. Night falls over the arena (a screen-space darkening pass), so the beam is the only light. Sound: a foghorn, and the slow clockwork tick of a lighthouse mechanism.
super.impact: The beam's path is lit like sunlight on water and fades over 1 s behind the sweep.
super.target_reaction: Enemies hit are blinded (white glare overlay) and revealed, and they stagger with an arm thrown over their eyes. Allies hit are Guided Home: a warm glow, a yellow path line toward the nearest safe ally, and a heal.
super.numbers: Range 30 m, 2 full rotations over 4 s. Each pass: 1.5x BA to enemies (3.0x BA total), Blind 2 s, Reveal for the rest of the super. Allies: heal 1.0x BA per pass and +20% move speed for 3 s. Walls and terrain block the beam.
super.telegraph: The lens opening is a 0.8 s warning, and enemies see the beam's sweep direction with a red rim.
super.team_use: A full-arena reveal and team heal. Your squad knows where every enemy is for 4 s.
super.cinematic: Oko stops and plants his boots. Camera drops low as the brass lens over his eye starts to unfold, ring after ring of brass and glass blooming around his head until he is wearing a lighthouse. The arena goes dark. Then the light comes on: a vast beam swings slowly around the whole field, twice. Enemies caught in it throw their arms over their eyes. Allies caught in it are bathed in warm light and see the way home. He spent three hundred years making sure this light could never go out.
super.charge: Nights kept: time spent channelling beams, enemies revealed, and allies pulled to safety fill it. On his body, the brass lens ring glows brighter and small rays leak from its edge. HUD: a lighthouse icon whose lamp brightens.
super.counterplay: Walls and terrain block the beam, so stand behind Moss's walls, Camedown's steps or Pyrrhos's boulder. Oko is rooted for the full 4.8 s. The sweep speed is fixed and visible, so time a dash through it. Stunning him shuts the lens.

idle: Gazes far off at a horizon nobody else can see, polishes his lens with a sleeve, tugs his beard braid. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with hand layers.

death: He sinks to sit on the ground and the light in his lens dims slowly to nothing, like a lamp running out of oil. Base: UAL Sitting_Enter into a slump.
victory: He shades his eye with a hand and looks out to sea, then nods slowly as if he finally sees a boat coming home. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with a salute-like shading layer.

name: Madame Ysolt Crane
title: the Blood Ledger
team_job: Puts a debt on the enemy everyone is hitting, then collects it as damage and healing for the squad. She also cuts enemy healing.

basic.name: Ledger Slap
basic.cast: She lets the ledger chained to her right wrist drop to the end of its chain and swings it in a flat arc, prim and precise. Base: UAL Sword_Attack (horizontal slash) with the arm extended, the ledger prop on the chain swinging from the hand bone.
basic.projectile: The heavy leather ledger on its iron chain, pages fluttering, flinging a spatter of red ink in an arc.
basic.flight: Arc of 120 degrees, 3 m reach. The chain is a short verlet ribbon. Red ink droplets fly off the arc and pages flicker. Sound: a chain rattle and a heavy book thwack.
basic.impact: A splatter of red ink on the target and on the ground (a decal, 1 s).
basic.target_reaction: Knocked sideways by the book, with red ink spattered across their chest.
basic.numbers: Range 3 m, arc 120 degrees, 1.0x BA, 1.0 hits/s.
basic.team_use: Wide swings put red ink on several enemies near your frontline.

basic.name: Balanced Backhand

basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same, the other direction.
basic.numbers: Range 3 m, 1.05x BA.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Collection
basic.cast: She hurls the ledger out on the full length of its chain. It flies open, snaps shut on the target like jaws, and she hauls them in with one tug. Base: UAL MELEE_HOOK.
basic.projectile: The ledger flying open, pages fanned like teeth, on a chain that pays out to 7 m.
basic.flight: Straight line, 24 m/s, 7 m. The chain pays out as a ribbon. On hit, the book snaps shut on the target and the chain yanks taut. Sound: a whoosh, a thump of a slammed book, then the chain rattling in.
basic.impact: Red ink burst; a drag mark decal along the pull path for 1 s.
basic.target_reaction: The victim is pulled 3 m toward her, feet skidding (the victim plays UAL SLIDE), with the ledger's red ribbon bookmark wrapped around their wrist for a moment.
basic.numbers: Range 7 m, 1.3x BA, pull 3 m.
basic.telegraph: A thin red line flash 0.15 s before.
basic.team_use: Drags an enemy out of position into the squad.

skills.name: Entry
skills.style: Aimed skillshot line (applies a debt mark)
skills.cast: She plucks the red quill from her hair bun, licks the tip, and flicks it like a dart. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW with a hand-to-hair pluck layer.
skills.projectile: The red quill, its nib wet with blood-red ink, writing a thin line through the air as it flies.
skills.flight: Straight line, 26 m/s, 10 m. It leaves a thin handwritten-looking red ink line in the air that fades in 0.6 s. Sound: a fast quill scratch.
skills.impact: The quill sticks in the target for a moment, then flies back to her bun.
skills.target_reaction: Indebted: a floating red ledger line appears over the target's head with a number that counts up as anyone on Ysolt's team damages them (the amount owed).
skills.numbers: Range 10 m, 0.8x BA, the debt mark lasts 6 s. Ysolt heals for 40% of the damage she deals to Indebted enemies. Recast to Collect early: deals 20% of all team damage dealt to the target during the mark as bonus damage, and heals Ysolt and allies within 6 m for that amount, split evenly. Cooldown 10 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a thin red line flash 0.15 s before.
skills.team_use: Everyone focuses the Indebted target; the bigger the debt, the bigger the payout to the squad when she collects.

skills.name: Balance the Books
skills.cast: She unhooks the gold scales from her belt and sets them on the ground with a precise click. They tip toward her enemies. Base: UAL PickUp_Table reversed (placing an object down).
skills.projectile: Her small gold balance scales, grown to 1 m tall as a spawned prop, with a ring of ledger columns drawn on the ground around them.
skills.flight: Placed at her feet or thrown 6 m in a short arc. The ledger-column ring draws itself outward to 4 m. Sound: a coin clink and a ledger page turning.
skills.impact: A 4 m ring decal of red-ruled ledger columns with numbers ticking in them. Lasts 5 s.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies inside see their heal numbers turn grey and get subtracted (a red minus glyph floats when they're healed). Allies inside see a faint red droplet stream from enemies into themselves.
skills.numbers: Radius 4 m, lasts 5 s. Enemies inside: healing received -50%. Allies inside: 10% lifesteal. Cooldown 16 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed ledger ring.
skills.team_use: Anti-heal for the squad against Corrin, Mott or Jory comps.

passive.name: Exactly What You Owe
passive.effect: Ysolt can't overheal. Any healing beyond her max HP becomes a Credit shield (max 20% of her HP) that lasts 6 s.
passive.tell: Her ledger's pages glow faintly red as Credit builds, and the gold scales on her belt tip toward her side.

super.name: Foreclosure
super.cast: She opens the ledger to its oldest page and reads out every debt. Iron chains burst out of the book toward every enemy who owes her.
super.projectile: Spectral iron chains, one per indebted enemy, that shoot from the open ledger and hook into each debtor's chest, then reel them in.
super.flight: Chains fire at 30 m/s to every enemy within 14 m who carries a debt (has been Indebted at least once this match and not paid off). They hook, then reel each debtor 3 m toward her. Sound: a heavy ledger slam, chain rattles, and a cash-register ring for each debt collected.
super.impact: Red ink spills from the ledger in a 4 m pool decal under her for 3 s.
super.target_reaction: Each debtor jerks forward as the chain hooks their chest and stumbles toward her, with their debt number floating over them and draining into the book.
super.numbers: Range 14 m. Every enemy who has been Indebted this match: pulled 3 m, takes 2.0x BA plus 30% of the total team damage dealt to them during their past debt marks (capped at 4.0x BA). Ysolt heals for the total; allies within 8 m share it as shields.
super.telegraph: A 1.0 s windup with the ledger opening and glowing pages, and every debtor sees a red chain icon over their own head.
super.team_use: The more the squad has focused Indebted targets, the bigger the collection. A long fight makes her super huge. If Jory is on her team, enemies below 15% HP are executed: Death collects too.
super.cinematic: Ysolt snaps the ledger open with a flourish. Camera pushes in on the page: a long column of names in red ink, and at the very top, in her own handwriting, a debt to Death. She runs her finger down the page, and each name she touches pulls taut a chain that bursts out of the book. Chains fly across the arena and hook every enemy who owes her. With one sharp tug she hauls them all in, and their debts drain into the book as numbers.
super.charge: Debt collected: every Collect and heal from Indebted targets fills it. On her body, red ink creeps up the chain from the ledger to her wrist, and the number on the ledger's cover counts up. HUD: a ledger icon with a red total.
super.counterplay: Only enemies who have been Indebted are hit: dodge her quill and you're immune. Chains need line of sight, so walls cut them. The 1.0 s windup lets debtors move behind cover. Pulling a debtor with a cleanse beforehand doesn't erase the debt, but staying outside 14 m does.

name: Sir Halven

team_job: A bruising herald who throws his own head as a lookout: his squad gets early warnings, damage reduction, a rally horn and a royal decree.

basic.name: Herald's Swing
basic.cast: The body unhooks the iron lantern cage from its belt and swings it on its chain in a flat arc, the head inside it yelling. Base: UAL Sword_Attack (horizontal) with the lantern prop swinging on a short verlet chain from the right hand bone.
basic.projectile: The lantern cage with Halven's own bearded head inside (a separate prop; the face uses 4 expression textures: calm, alarmed, furious, smug). It leaves a warm lantern-light ribbon trail and pops a speech bubble with angry glyphs.
basic.flight: Arc of 140 degrees, 2.8 m reach. The lantern ribbon is warm gold, and a comic speech-bubble sprite pops out: !! or a grumble glyph. Sound: a chain whoosh, a metal clang, and the head shouting Mind the face!
basic.impact: An iron clang and a burst of lantern sparks.
basic.target_reaction: Knocked sideways with soot sparks on the cheek.
basic.numbers: Range 2.8 m, arc 140 degrees, 1.0x BA, 0.95 hits/s.
basic.team_use: Wide swings tag several divers at once.

basic.name: Backswing
basic.cast: The swing back the other way, the body pivoting at the hips. Base: Sword_Attack reversed. The head's face swaps to the alarmed texture.
basic.projectile: Same lantern, a bubble reading Careful!
basic.flight: Same arc, reversed.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Range 2.8 m, 1.05x BA.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Proclamation
basic.cast: The body whirls the lantern overhead once and slams it down; the head inside bellows a proclamation as it lands. Base: UAL Sword_Attack overhead with a full overhead whirl layer.
basic.projectile: The lantern slamming down, plus the head's bellow: a ring of sound with a parchment-scroll pattern on it.
basic.flight: The lantern arcs overhead and down. On impact, the sound ring expands to 3 m at 15 m/s. Sound: a clang, then the head shouting Hear ye!
basic.impact: A ring of scroll-patterned dust and an iron crack decal, 1.5 s.
basic.target_reaction: Knocked back 1.5 m, hands to their ears.
basic.numbers: Radius 3 m, 1.4x BA, knock-back 1.5 m.
basic.telegraph: A 0.2 s lantern flare as it whirls overhead.
basic.team_use: Knock-back peels divers off the squad's backline.

skills.name: Lookout
skills.style: Lobbed arc (lands as a ward; recast to recall as a boomerang)
skills.cast: The body unhooks the lantern and lobs it underhand toward a spot, a little too hard. The head screams the whole way. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW retimed to an underhand lob.
skills.projectile: The lantern cage with the head, now a ward: it lands upright and the lantern light swells into a beacon. The head starts shouting warnings.
skills.flight: Lobbed arc, 14 m/s, up to 12 m, spinning end over end with the head's face on the alarmed texture. On recast, the lantern flies straight back to the body on its chain like a boomerang at 18 m/s, hitting enemies on the way. Sound: a scream going out; on landing, a bell-like clank and the head shouting Enemy left!
skills.impact: On landing, an 8 m lantern-light circle (warm gold decal, white outline for allies).
skills.target_reaction: Enemies in the circle are revealed with a gold outline. Allies in it are Warned: a small gold arrow appears at their feet pointing at the nearest threat, and the next hit they take within 4 s is reduced 40%.
skills.numbers: Throw range 12 m, ward lasts 8 s, vision radius 8 m. Warned: 40% damage reduction on the next hit within 4 s (refreshes every 4 s). Recall: 1.0x BA to enemies along the path. While the head is away, the body attacks 15% faster with bare gauntlet punches. Cooldown 12 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see the lantern with a red rim and hear it.
skills.team_use: Vision, warnings and damage reduction for the squad. Place it where the enemy will flank.

skills.name: Herald's Horn
skills.cast: The body pulls the brass horn off its back and holds the mouthpiece up to the lantern's cage. The head blows it, cheeks puffed. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with both hands holding the horn at the lantern, the lantern raised to chest height.
skills.projectile: A blast of brass sound: cone-shaped rings with royal purple pennant streamers flying in them and a puff of steam from the horn's bell.
skills.flight: A 60-degree cone, 7 m, rings expanding at 14 m/s with streamers fluttering. Sound: a heraldic fanfare call.
skills.impact: Purple pennant scraps drift down for 1 s.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies in the cone are knocked back 2 m and hold their ears. Allies in the cone see purple pennant streamers around them: Rallied.
skills.numbers: Cone 7 m by 60 degrees. Enemies: 0.8x BA, knock-back 2 m. Allies: +20% move speed and cleanse slows, 3 s. Cooldown 14 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed cone flash 0.2 s before.
skills.team_use: Push enemies back and speed your squad up in the same direction: a charge order.

passive.name: Two Minds
passive.effect: While the head is at his belt, every 3rd basic attack the head negotiates: the target is Persuaded and deals 15% less damage for 2 s. While the head is away (Lookout), the body attacks 15% faster.
passive.tell: The lantern's glow is warm gold while the head is in charge and turns red when the body is in charge. Small speech-bubble sprites pop above the lantern as the head talks.

super.name: The King's Last Message
super.cast: The lantern's cage swings open. A rolled scroll unfurls from inside it, and the head, for the first time, reads aloud the last message the king ever sent.
super.projectile: A large golden scroll unrolling in mid-air above Halven (a spawned ribbon mesh with a parchment texture and glowing gold letters), a royal seal, and a crown-shaped ring of light spreading out.
super.flight: The scroll unrolls over 0.8 s and lifts 3 m above him. Golden letters scroll across it. A crown ring expands to 14 m. Sound: a long royal fanfare on the horn, then the head reading in a booming voice.
super.impact: A 14 m ring of purple and gold banner-light decal on the ground, lasting the 6 s.
super.target_reaction: Allies see a gold crown glyph above their heads: By Royal Decree. Enemies are forced to Kneel: they drop to one knee for 1.2 s with a gold crown stamp above their heads.
super.numbers: Radius 14 m (line of sight to the lantern required). Allies: +25% damage, +25% damage reduction, and a cleanse, for 6 s. Enemies: Kneel (stun) 1.2 s, 1.0x BA. The body and head fight together for the 6 s: both his passive bonuses are active at once.
super.telegraph: A 1.2 s windup with the horn fanfare and the scroll unrolling; enemies see a red-rimmed crown ring.
super.team_use: A team-wide fight-starter: kneel the enemies, buff the squad, go.
super.cinematic: The body raises the horn and blows a long fanfare, and the lantern's little door swings open by itself. Camera pushes toward the cage. Halven's head looks up and clears its throat. A golden scroll unrolls from the lantern into the air, glowing with letters, sealed with the king's seal. The head reads it aloud in a voice that fills the arena. Every enemy within earshot drops to one knee. Every ally stands taller, crowned in gold. For six seconds, the head and the body agree on something.
super.charge: Warnings shouted: hits prevented by Warned allies and enemies revealed by Lookout fill it. On his body, the brass horn on his back puffs more and more steam from its bell. HUD: a scroll icon unrolling.
super.counterplay: Line of sight to the lantern is required, so break line of sight behind walls during the 1.2 s fanfare. Stunning the body during the windup drops the scroll. A cleanse frees an ally of Kneel early.

beats.tweak: Body raises the horn to the lantern; the head blows a fanfare.
beats.vfx: Steam from the horn; the lantern door swings open.
beats.prop: Horn prop moves from back bone to hands; lantern door hinged in code.

beats.tweak: Body lifts the lantern high in its right hand like a torch.
beats.vfx: Scroll unrolls from the lantern 3 m into the air.
beats.sound: A head clearing its throat; a parchment unroll.

beats.tweak: Lantern thrust forward.
beats.vfx: Crown ring expands 14 m; Kneel stamps on enemies.
beats.sound: The head booming: By order of the King!

beats.tweak: Body re-hooks the lantern; the head looks smug.
beats.vfx: Scroll dissolves to gold dust.
beats.prop: Horn back on the back bone.

locomotion: A stiff knightly march with plate clanking; the lantern bounces at the hip and the head complains about the jostling. The run is a heavy armoured jog. Base: UAL Walk_Formal_Loop; Jog_Fwd_Loop.
idle: The body stands at parade rest while the head looks around, argues with it (speech bubbles), and the body ignores it. Sometimes the body taps the lantern to shut the head up. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with a hand-tap layer; face texture swaps on the head prop.
hit: The armour clangs; the head screams Ow! even though the body was hit. Base: UAL Hit_Chest.
death: The body falls to its knees and topples forward. The lantern rolls away a few metres and the head says, I told you so. Base: UAL Death01. The lantern detaches to physics.
victory: The body raises the lantern high and the head gives a dignified nod, then says something smug in a speech bubble. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with a raised-arm layer.

animations.notes: Parade rest; lantern tap. Head face swaps in code.
Lantern on a chain instead of a sword.
Bare-gauntlet punches while the head is away.
Both hands hold the horn to the lantern.

vfx.direction: Iron lantern cage with the bearded head inside; 4 face textures (calm, alarmed, furious, smug).
Warm gold lantern-light ribbon on swings.
Comic speech bubbles with glyphs (!!, grumble, Careful!).
Sound ring with a parchment scroll pattern.
8 m warm gold vision circle; red rim to enemies.
Small gold arrow at an ally's feet pointing at the nearest threat.
Cone sound rings with purple pennant streamer ribbons; steam puff from the horn.
Parchment scroll with glowing gold letters and a red seal.
14 m crown-shaped light ring and purple-gold banner decal.
Gold crown stamp above kneeling enemies.
Steam wisps from the horn's bell, rate tied to super charge.

combos.setup: Lookout reveals an isolated enemy.
combos.payoff: Fenwick Name Tags it and leaps in from 10 m.

combos.setup: Lookout lands on a flank.
combos.payoff: Nyssa's Call the Ferry carries the squad straight to the revealed target.

combos.setup: The King's Last Message forces a group to kneel for 1.2 s.
combos.payoff: Hespera's charged Cinder Sling and Dusk ring land on enemies who can't move.

name: Sena
title: the Fourth Fate
team_job: Ties enemies to each other and to her fingers. She can hold an ally's thread so they can't die, and her super cuts one enemy's thread for good.

basic.name: Loose End
basic.cast: She flicks her right fingers like casting a fishing line, and a red thread whips off them. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot retimed into a wrist flick, the fingers spreading.
basic.projectile: A fine red thread with a tiny glowing knot at its tip.
basic.flight: Whips out in a slight curve at 30 m/s, latches onto the target, then stays as a tether from her finger to their wrist (verlet ribbon, 6 segments). Sound: a taut thrum like a plucked string, and a faint hum while the tether holds.
basic.impact: A small red knot appears at the victim's wrist.
basic.target_reaction: The target's wrist is tied with red thread (a thread loop overlay on the wrist bone). Their arm jerks toward Sena when she tugs, a small stagger every tick.
basic.numbers: Range 7 m, tether breaks at 9 m. 0.6x BA on attach, then 0.3x BA per second while tied. One tether per hand (2 total). Attacks at 1.0/s.
basic.team_use: Tethered enemies feed the rest of her kit; anything tied is also something Kallix can set on fire.

basic.name: Loose End
basic.cast: Same with her left hand.
basic.projectile: Same thread.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Two tethers: two targets for Snip.

basic.name: Snip
basic.cast: She draws the giant gold shears from her belt (prop on the right hand bone) and snips both threads at once with a heavy, satisfying cut. Base: UAL Sword_Attack with a two-handed scissor-close layer.
basic.projectile: The gold shears closing on the threads, a flash of gold where the blades meet.
basic.flight: Instant at her hands. The cut travels down each tethered thread as a gold spark running to the victim at 40 m/s. Sound: a loud, crisp metal snip, then strings twanging.
basic.impact: A small gold flash on each victim; the thread ends curl up and fall.
basic.target_reaction: Each victim jolts as the thread snaps back; their tied wrist flails.
basic.numbers: 1.4x BA to each tethered enemy (2 max). Ends both tethers.
basic.team_use: Burst on two enemies at once, wherever they are within tether range.

skills.name: Knot
skills.cast: She plucks a thread from a nearby enemy and ties it to a second one with a quick knotting motion of both hands. Base: UAL Interact with a two-hand knot layer.
skills.projectile: A thick double red thread connecting two enemies, with a big knot in the middle.
skills.flight: Cast on the first enemy (thread whips to them), then the second (thread stretches to them). The knot slides to the midpoint. Sound: two string plucks and a tight knot creak.
skills.impact: A knot sprite floats at the midpoint.
skills.target_reaction: Both enemies are Bound: a red thread loop at their waists. If they move more than 5 m apart, the thread yanks them back together and they stumble into each other, slowed 30% for 1 s.
skills.numbers: Range 8 m per target, lasts 4 s. Yank pulls both together and slows 30% for 1 s. 30% of damage dealt to one is echoed to the other. Cooldown 12 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed thread.
skills.team_use: Kallix can ignite the thread so the fire travels to both. Wrenna's Sounding on one drags the other onto the rose.

skills.name: Held Thread
skills.cast: She reaches toward an ally and, between finger and thumb, takes hold of an invisible thread above their head, and winds it round her finger. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with a pinch-and-wind hand layer.
skills.projectile: The ally's own life-thread made visible: a glowing white-gold thread from the top of the ally's head to Sena's finger.
skills.flight: Appears instantly. The thread hums and shimmers. Sound: a long sustained harp note.
skills.impact: A faint white-gold halo of loose threads around the ally.
skills.target_reaction: The ally sees a white-gold thread rising from their head and their colours go slightly washed out: they can't die, but they can't fully live either.
skills.numbers: Range 9 m, lasts 2.5 s. The ally can't drop below 1 HP but can't receive healing and moves 15% slower. Cooldown 24 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see a gold thread; enemies see the same thread with a grey rim, so they know not to waste burst.
skills.team_use: A save tool against a burst combo. Pair with Corrin or Jory to heal them up the moment the thread is released.

passive.name: Thousands of Threads
passive.effect: Every enemy Sena has tethered in the last 10 s keeps a faint thread running to her fingers (up to 6). Each held thread gives her tethers +5% damage, and her Snip +10%.
passive.tell: Faint threads multiply from her fingers, trailing off toward enemies. One thread on her left hand always glows gold: her own.

super.name: The Cut
super.cast: She draws the shears, and they grow to full size in her hands (scale up 1.8x). She finds one enemy's life-thread and cuts it.
super.projectile: A single glowing red life-thread rising from the target's head into the sky, and the colossal gold shears closing on it.
super.flight: She points the shears; a red thread rises from the target's head, visible to everyone. She snips it, and the cut thread starts fraying, unravelling upward as a countdown. Sound: an enormous metallic snip, then the ticking creak of a thread fraying.
super.impact: A fraying red thread floats over the target's head, unravelling strand by strand for 8 s.
super.target_reaction: The target hears a heartbeat and sees the frayed thread over their own head. When it runs out, they fall, unless they win first.
super.numbers: Range 10 m, 2.0x BA on the cut. Timer 8 s; each hit from Sena's team on the target shortens it by 0.25 s (minimum 4 s). At 0, the target falls (execute). The target is spared if, before the timer ends, they get a takedown or deal damage equal to 40% of their max HP to Sena's team. If Sena dies first, the target is spared. Tychon as a target rolls a die: on a 6, the timer is reversed onto Sena.
super.telegraph: The target sees the shears open over their head and a red thread rise for 0.6 s before the snip.
super.team_use: The squad's job is to keep the target from winning first: peel, kite and protect Sena. If Wrenna is on the team, she gets a free Held Thread when Sena casts The Cut.
super.cinematic: Sena draws her shears and they grow huge, gleaming gold, almost as tall as she is. Camera tightens on her face: blank, patient. A single red thread rises from one enemy's head into the sky, and everyone in the arena can see it. She opens the shears around it and closes them. The snip echoes. The two loose ends start to fray, strand by strand, and the enemy has eight seconds to win something, or fall.
super.charge: Threads held: seconds of tether time on enemies and allies fill it. On her body, the threads on her fingers multiply from three to ten strands, and the gold shears at her belt glow brighter. HUD: a spool that winds full.
super.counterplay: The target can save themselves by winning first: get a takedown or deal 40% of their max HP to Sena's team. Kill Sena and the cut is undone. The 0.6 s shears-open warning lets the target break line of sight before the snip lands.

beats.tweak: Draws the shears; they scale up; she raises them, blades open, toward the target.
beats.vfx: A red thread rises from the target's head into the sky.
beats.prop: Shears prop scales 1.0 to 1.8 on the right hand bone.

beats.tweak: Two-handed scissor-close, a sharp snap of the arms inward.
beats.vfx: Gold flash at the blades; the thread is cut.

beats.tweak: She returns to idle; the timer runs.
beats.vfx: Frayed thread unravels over the target.
beats.sound: Thread fraying creak; the target's heartbeat.

beats.tweak: Lowers the shears and tucks them back into her belt.
beats.vfx: None.

locomotion: A light, drifting walk with her arms slightly out from her sides so the threads don't tangle. The run is quick with her hands held close. Base: UAL Walk_Loop with an arm-out layer; Jog_Fwd_Loop.
idle: Winds a thread around a finger, looks at it closely, untangles two threads with great care. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with finger layers.
hit: Her threads tangle and snap in a little burst; she flinches but never lets go. Base: UAL Hit_Chest.
death: She lowers her hands and every thread on her fingers goes slack and drifts away, except one gold thread, which pulls taut toward the sky. She fades along it. Base: UAL Death02.
victory: She ties a neat bow on a single thread and lets it go; it floats up out of sight. Base: UAL Interact.

animations.notes: Two-handed scissor close with the shears.

vfx.direction: Fine red thread, 6 segments, with a glowing knot tip.
Red thread loop on the victim's wrist bone.
Giant gold shears; scales up 1.8x for the super.
Gold spark running down a cut thread; curl-and-fall thread ends.
Thick double red thread with a big knot sprite at the midpoint.
White-gold life-thread from an ally's head to her finger, humming shimmer.
Faint threads from her finger bones, up to 10 strands.
Red thread rising from the target's head into the sky; unravels strand by strand as a timer.

combos.setup: Knot ties two enemies.
combos.payoff: Bellows ignites the thread and the fire travels to both.

combos.setup: Knot ties two enemies; Sounding lands on one.
combos.payoff: The thread drags the other onto the rose. Casting The Cut gives Wrenna a free Held Thread.
