combos.payoff: Jory's Running Late then rewinds them to their HP from 2 s earlier.

name: Jory Ashby
title: Death's Understudy
team_job: Death's stand-in on your side: he hands out second lives, rewinds allies out of a bad two seconds, and for a few seconds can stop anyone on his team from dying.

basic.name: Keyring Toss
basic.cast: He unhooks Death's great iron keyring from his belt and spins it on one finger, then flings it sidearm like a discus. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW sidearm, with a finger-spin layer for 0.15 s.
basic.projectile: Death's keyring: a heavy iron ring with five bone-handled keys, spinning flat like a saw blade.
basic.flight: Out straight to 8 m at 18 m/s, then curves back to his hand at 20 m/s. A ghostly soul-blue trail with faint key silhouettes follows it. Sound: keys jangling, then a cold whistle.
basic.impact: A soul-blue spark burst on each hit and a jangle.
basic.target_reaction: A clip across the body, staggering the target; for a moment a ghostly key turns in a keyhole over their chest.
basic.numbers: Range 8 m, 0.7x BA out and 0.7x BA back (1.4x BA if both hit), 0.95 attacks/s.
basic.team_use: Return hits catch divers chasing allies.

basic.name: Keyring Toss
basic.cast: Same with the other hand, with a hop.
basic.projectile: Same.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Late Notice
basic.cast: He throws the keyring hard and then checks a pocket watch-like hourglass on his chest, tapping it as if he's late. Base: OVERHAND_THROW into Idle_Loop with a chest-tap layer.
basic.projectile: The keyring, glowing hourglass gold.
basic.flight: It flies out to 9 m and hangs at the apex, spinning in place for 0.6 s while a little trickle of sand pours from it, then rockets back at 26 m/s. Sound: a ticking clock, then a whoosh.
basic.impact: Sand bursts on each hit; a small hourglass-shaped decal, 1 s.
basic.target_reaction: Victims stagger. On a target below 30% HP, the hit lands Early: a soul-blue flash and a skull glyph over their head for 0.5 s.
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, 0.8x BA out, hover 0.6 s (0.4x BA per 0.2 s to enemies under it), 1.0x BA return. Targets below 30% HP take 1.5x on the return.
basic.telegraph: Enemies see a gold hourglass marker where the ring hangs.
basic.team_use: The hover zones a chokepoint; the return finishes stragglers.

skills.name: Spare Hourglass
skills.cast: He pops one of the two hourglasses off the bone toggles on his chest and tosses it underhand to an ally. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW retimed to a gentle underhand toss.
skills.projectile: A small brass hourglass with gold sand, spinning gently in the air, trailing sand grains.
skills.flight: A soft homing arc to the ally at 14 m/s. Sound: a soft chime and running sand.
skills.impact: The hourglass settles above the ally's head and orbits it slowly.
skills.target_reaction: The ally sees a small hourglass orbiting their head. If they would die, it flips: they freeze for 1 s in a column of reversing sand (the sand flows up), then stand back up at 30% HP.
skills.numbers: Range 10 m, lasts 12 s on the ally. Revives once at 30% HP after 1 s. Jory carries 2 hourglasses; each recharges in 30 s. One per ally at a time.
skills.telegraph: Allies see a gold hourglass; enemies see it with a grey rim, so they know the target has a second life.
skills.team_use: A second life for the diver going in, or the carry who's about to be focused.

skills.name: Running Late
skills.cast: He grabs both hourglasses on his chest and flips them upside down at once. Base: UAL Interact with a two-handed flip layer at the chest.
skills.projectile: A sphere of reversing sand: gold grains flowing backward toward their source, and ghostly afterimages of each ally where they were 2 s ago.
skills.flight: Instant around him, radius 5 m. Each ally in it is pulled back along a ghostly trail to their position from 2 s ago over 0.3 s. Sound: a reversed whoosh and a clock ticking backward.
skills.impact: A gold sand ring decal under him, 1 s.
skills.target_reaction: Allies see their own afterimage and slide back into it, while debuffs fall off them like sand. Their HP snaps back to what it was 2 s ago if that was higher.
skills.numbers: Radius 5 m. Allies return to their position and HP from 2 s ago (if HP was higher), and every debuff applied in the last 2 s is removed. Cooldown 18 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see a soft gold ring; enemies see nothing harmful.
skills.team_use: Undo a combo: if the enemy just landed a burst on the squad, rewind it.

passive.name: Never On Time
passive.effect: Enemies below 20% HP within 10 m are Due: a ghostly appointment card hangs over them. Jory deals +25% damage to Due targets, and if one dies to Jory's team, one hourglass recharges 10 s faster.
passive.tell: The empty eye sockets of the skull on his head glow soul blue when someone nearby is Due.

super.name: Covering Shift
super.cast: Jory pulls the skull down from the top of his head over his face like a mask. His coat smokes. For the next few seconds, he is Death, and nobody on his team dies on his shift.
super.projectile: A 12 m zone of stopped time: a dome of hanging sand grains frozen mid-air, soul-blue lanterns hanging in it, and clock-face rings on the ground.
super.flight: The zone rises from his feet over 0.5 s as a dome of drifting gold sand, then hangs for 7 s. Clock hands on the ground decal sweep backward. Sound: a single deep bell toll, then a slow ticking that never advances.
super.impact: A 12 m clock-face decal on the ground, ticking backward. Frozen sand grains hang in the air.
super.target_reaction: Allies inside see a pale blue rim around their HP bar: they can't drop below 1 HP. Enemies who die inside fall into a puddle of sand: Late.
super.numbers: Radius 12 m (fixed where cast), lasts 7 s. Allies inside cannot die. Enemies who die inside take +5 s to respawn. Jory himself is NOT protected. If Jory dies, the zone ends.
super.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed clock-face zone rising for 0.5 s.
super.team_use: A full-team invulnerability window for an all-in. Combine with Hespera's sun or Wrenna's flood and fight with impunity.
super.cinematic: Jory reaches up and pulls the skull down from the top of his head over his own face. His coat starts to smoke at the hem. Camera pushes in on the empty eye sockets as they light up soul blue. A bell tolls once and time stops around him: sand hangs in the air, a clock face appears on the ground and its hands start to tick backward. Inside it, for seven seconds, nobody on his team can die. He's Death's understudy, and he's getting good at the job.
super.charge: Appointments kept: revives, cleanses and takedowns on Due enemies fill it. On his body, the two hourglasses on his chest fill with glowing gold sand, and the skull's eye sockets glow brighter. HUD: an hourglass that fills from the bottom.
super.counterplay: Kill Jory: he isn't protected by his own zone, and the zone ends when he dies. Knock or pull allies out of the 12 m area. Or retreat and wait out 7 s. The zone is fixed where it's cast.

beats.tweak: Reaches up with both hands and pulls the skull down over his face.
beats.vfx: Coat hem smokes; sand starts to rise.
beats.prop: Skull prop moves from the top of the head bone to the face (local offset change).
beats.sound: A bone scrape; a single deep bell.

beats.tweak: Arms open at his sides, palms down.
beats.vfx: Sand dome rises to 12 m; clock-face decal.

beats.tweak: Holds the pose (he can cancel to act).
beats.vfx: Frozen sand; blue HP rims on allies; sand puddles on enemies who die.

beats.tweak: Pushes the skull back up onto his head and exhales.
beats.vfx: Sand falls all at once.
beats.prop: Skull back to the top of the head.

locomotion: A slightly hurried apprentice's walk, always checking the hourglasses on his chest. The run is gangly with the coat flapping. Base: UAL Walk_Loop with a chest-check layer; Jog_Fwd_Loop.
idle: Checks the keys on his ring, mutters a list of names, looks up toward the stands as if someone is watching him. Base: UAL Idle_Talking_Loop.
hit: His skull cap knocks askew and he straightens it, embarrassed. Base: UAL Hit_Head.
death: He falls, his keyring skids away, and his hourglasses crack, sand pouring out onto the ground. A pale hand from offscreen (Death, watching) waves him back. Base: UAL Death02.
victory: He tips the skull at the camera like a hat, then checks a name off on a long list. Base: UAL WAVE into Idle_Talking_Loop.

animations.notes: Key check; muttered list; look to the stands.
Two-handed hourglass flip at the chest.

Gold sand trickle from the hovering ring.

Sand flowing upward in a column on revive.
Translucent copy of each ally at their 2-second-old position.
Ghostly appointment card over Due enemies.
12 m clock face with hands ticking backward.
Frozen sand grains hanging in a 12 m dome. Fallback: decal plus a light particle ring.
Soul-blue emissive in the skull's eye sockets.

name: The Sleeper
title: Beneath Saint Ennick
team_job: Turns the floor into sea: every swing leaves slowing water, it drags enemies into the deep end, and its super floods the whole arena for your squad.

basic.name: Tide Palm
basic.cast: A slow, heavy open-palm slap down to the ground in front of it, as if testing the depth of water. The bell at its chest sways. Base: UAL Sword_Attack overhead, empty hand, retimed 20% slower, with the palm open.
basic.projectile: Its basalt palm, and the seawater that wells up where it lands.
basic.flight: A 3 m reach downward slap. Teal water spurts from between its fingers on contact. Sound: a wet stone slap and a deep, slow wave.
basic.impact: A 2.5 m puddle of dark teal seawater appears (a ripple decal with a reflective water shader) and lasts 3 s.
basic.target_reaction: The target is knocked down to one knee for an instant and splashed; enemies standing in its water have their feet sink slightly (a wet-legs mask).
basic.numbers: Range 3 m, puddle radius 2.5 m, puddle lasts 3 s and slows enemies 20%. 1.0x BA, 0.8 hits/s.
basic.telegraph: Enemies see puddle edges with a red rim.
basic.team_use: Every puddle is slowing ground for the whole squad to fight on.

basic.name: Undertow
basic.cast: The other palm, sweeping slightly sideways. Base: Sword_Attack mirrored, slowed.
basic.projectile: Same palm and a sideways spray of water.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: A second puddle. Where puddles overlap they darken into Deep Water.
basic.target_reaction: Enemies in Deep Water wade up to their thighs (a higher wet mask) and slow more.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1. Deep Water slows 35%.
basic.team_use: Two quick hits build Deep Water on a chokepoint.

basic.name: Sinking
basic.cast: Both palms press flat to the ground and it leans its weight into them; the ground sinks. Base: UAL Push_Loop retimed to a single 0.6 s push, angled down.
basic.projectile: A whirlpool in the water: a swirling teal vortex decal with a dark centre.
basic.flight: The vortex spins up in the nearest puddle over 0.3 s. Sound: a draining gurgle and a low groan.
basic.impact: The puddle sinks (the decal darkens toward its centre) and enemies in it are pulled toward the middle.
basic.target_reaction: Enemies stumble toward the centre (pulled 1.5 m), water up to their waists.
basic.numbers: Affects every puddle within 4 m, 1.6x BA to enemies in them, pull 1.5 m toward each puddle's centre.
basic.telegraph: Swirl arrows on red-rimmed puddles for 0.3 s.
basic.team_use: Pulls enemies together for Wrenna, Hespera or Kallix.

skills.name: Undertow Grip
skills.cast: It reaches one hand down into a puddle and pulls up and back, like hauling a net. Base: UAL MELEE_HOOK slowed 20%.
skills.projectile: A huge hand of seawater and seabed stone (a spawned mesh with a water shader and barnacles) that rises from the target puddle and grabs.
skills.flight: The hand erupts from any puddle of the Sleeper's (range 10 m from the Sleeper) at 20 m/s, closes on one enemy, and drags them through the water to the deepest puddle nearby. Sound: a giant wave suck and a stone grind.
skills.impact: The drag leaves a wake decal for 1 s.
skills.target_reaction: The victim is grabbed around the waist, dragged 5 m, and dunked: knocked down for 0.5 s with seaweed on them.
skills.numbers: Range 10 m (must start in or target an enemy in a puddle), drag 5 m, 1.5x BA, knock-down 0.5 s. Cooldown 11 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies standing in its puddles see a red-rimmed shadow of a hand under them 0.3 s before.
skills.team_use: Drags a carry out of their backline, or drags a diver off your healer.

skills.name: Drowse
skills.cast: It tilts its huge square head back and yawns slowly, eyes drooping. The bronze bell on its chest gives one dull toll. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with a head-back yawn layer held 0.8 s.
skills.projectile: A slow, heavy ring of sound and sleepy blue-teal mist rolling out from the bell.
skills.flight: A ring expanding to 6 m over 0.8 s, mist rolling along the ground. Sound: a deep muffled bell, then a yawn.
skills.impact: Sleepy mist hangs on the ground for 2 s.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies become Drowsy: eyes heavy, heads nodding (a slow nod layer on the victim), slowed 30%. Still Drowsy after 2 s, they fall Asleep for 1 s (heads drop, Zzz-shaped bubbles of seawater rise).
skills.numbers: Radius 6 m, Drowsy 2 s (slow 30%), then Asleep 1 s. Damage wakes a sleeping target. Cooldown 14 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed mist ring.
skills.team_use: Peel and setup: the squad has 2 s to choose whether to hit (no sleep) or wait (sleep).

passive.name: Calm and Curious
passive.effect: The Sleeper regenerates 1% max HP per second while standing in its own water. Allies standing in its water get +10% damage reduction: the sea holds them.
passive.tell: Teal water drips faster from its mouth while it's in water, and the barnacles on its body slowly open like listening ears.

super.name: The Floor Goes Into the Sea
super.cast: It plunges both fists into the floor, grips it, and pulls the arena down, slowly, the way it pulled Lirr down to sleep beside it.
super.projectile: A global sea: a water plane rising 0.4 m over the entire arena, with the drowned rooftops and streets of Lirr visible beneath its surface, and whirlpools spinning up under the weakest enemies.
super.flight: The arena floor drops (a camera shake and a slight downward camera move) while the water plane rises over 1.5 s from the edges inward. Every 2 s, a whirlpool spawns under the lowest-HP enemy. Sound: a deep groan of stone, a rising ocean roar, and far below, a bell.
super.impact: The flood lasts 8 s over the whole arena. Raised terrain (walls, steps, boulders) stays dry.
super.target_reaction: Enemies wade up to the waist (a wet mask to the hips), lean into the water, and move heavily. Their dashes and leaps are blocked. Allies of the Sleeper float lightly on the surface with a soft sea-shield shimmer.
super.numbers: Whole arena, 8 s. Enemies: slowed 30%, can't dash or leap. Allies: not slowed, +15% damage reduction. The Sleeper moves 30% faster and regenerates 2% max HP/s. Whirlpools every 2 s under the lowest-HP enemy: 1.0x BA and a 2 m pull toward the centre. Hob's Saint Ennick's Last Note (if Hob is an enemy) ends the flood immediately.
super.telegraph: 1.5 s windup with the floor shaking and water rising from the arena edges; whirlpools show a red-rimmed spiral 1 s before they open.
super.team_use: The whole match tilts toward the Sleeper's team for 8 s: they keep their mobility, the enemies lose theirs. Ione singing during the flood puts charmed enemies to sleep.
super.cinematic: The Sleeper kneels and drives both fists into the arena floor, gripping it like the edge of a table. Camera pulls up and back. It leans back and pulls, and the whole arena groans and drops. Seawater pours in from every edge, rising past ankles, past knees, and under the surface everyone can see the rooftops and streets of a drowned city. Enemies wade, heavy and slow. The Sleeper's allies float. Somewhere under it all, a bell rings, and the Sleeper tilts its head to listen.
super.charge: Fathoms sunk: time its water has spent on the field and enemies slowed by it fill the super. On its body, the bronze bell on its chest glows and swings harder (a pendulum prop driven in code), and teal water pours from its mouth more and more. HUD: a bell icon that sinks into waves.
super.counterplay: Get to high ground: anything raised (Moss's walls, Camedown's steps, Pyrrhos's boulder, Corrin's orchard roots) stays dry and unslowed. Hob's super ends the flood instantly. The Sleeper is rooted for the 1.5 s windup and can be stunned to cancel it.

beats.tweak: Kneels and plunges both fists into the floor, then leans back, gripping.
beats.vfx: Floor cracks around its fists; water seeps from the arena edges.

beats.tweak: One massive backward pull.
beats.vfx: Floor drops (camera move); water plane rises fast.

beats.clip: UAL Idle_Loop with a listening head tilt
beats.tweak: Stands and listens, head tilted.
beats.vfx: Global water plane with drowned Lirr beneath; whirlpools.

beats.tweak: It watches the water drain away, curious.
beats.vfx: Water drains back to the edges.

locomotion: A slow, heavy, rolling walk, like moving through water even on dry land. The run is a lumbering, purposeful trot. Base: UAL ZOMBIE_WALK_FWD retimed and straightened (less lurch); Jog_Fwd_Loop retimed 20% slower.
idle: Stands still with its head tilted, listening. Once in a while it taps the bell on its chest with one finger and waits. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with a head-tilt layer.
hit: A deep thud like a hammer on a cliff; barnacles crack off and a spurt of seawater sprays. Base: UAL Hit_Chest slowed.
death: It sits down slowly, lies back, and sinks into a spreading pool of seawater until only the bell is left on the surface, ringing once. Base: UAL Death01 slowed, plus the dissolve.
victory: It sits cross-legged, closes its eyes, and sways slowly as if listening to a song. Base: UAL Sitting_Idle_Loop.

vfx.direction: Dark teal water with a reflective ripple shader; a Deep Water variant where puddles overlap.
Teal water spurts between its fingers.
Swirling teal vortex with a dark centre.
Height-masked wet shader to shins, thighs or waist depending on depth.
Huge hand of water shader with stone knuckles and barnacles.
Sleepy blue-teal mist and a slow sound ring from the bell.
Seawater bubbles rising from sleeping enemies.
Bronze bell prop on the chest bone, swinging as a code-driven pendulum.
Arena-wide water plane with a scrolling normal map. Fallback: decal-only flooding with a blue tint.
Rooftops and streets of Lirr visible beneath the water.
Teal drips from the mouth, rate tied to charge.

combos.payoff: Charmed enemies in the flood fall asleep, and the Sleeper's super gets 25% charge when Ione's super starts.

combos.payoff: Wrenna's Sounding in flooded ground deals +30%, because everything is Soaked.

combos.setup: Aurvan's Tidal Pull drags enemies over the Sleeper's puddles.
combos.payoff: The moon pulls the tide: puddles inside the pull turn into Deep Water at once, and Sinking drags the group into the middle.

name: The One Who Came Down
title: First Ascendant
team_job: Builds marble stairs on the battlefield: high ground and safety for the squad, knock-ups for enemies, and a super that carries the whole team up the sky-stair and drops them wherever they choose.

basic.name: Step
basic.cast: They lift an open palm, upturned, the way you offer someone a hand up the stairs. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with the palm turned up and a slow upward lift.
basic.projectile: A single marble stair-step (1.2 m wide, 0.4 m tall, gold kintsugi veins) that bursts up out of the ground under the target.
basic.flight: Appears under the target at range after a 0.2 s ground crack; it rises in 0.1 s. Marble chips fly and a gold vein flashes. Sound: a stone grind and a single clear chime.
basic.impact: The step stays as terrain for 3 s, then sinks with gold dust. A crack-ring decal around it.
basic.target_reaction: The target is popped up into a short knock-up (0.3 s) and lands awkwardly beside the step, with marble dust on them.
basic.numbers: Range 7 m, 1.0x BA, knock-up 0.3 s, step lasts 3 s with 1.0x BA HP. 0.85 attacks/s.
basic.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed step outline under them for 0.2 s.
basic.team_use: Every step is terrain an ally can stand on for their passive bonus.

basic.name: Second Step
basic.cast: The same gesture with the other hand. Base: Spell_Simple_Shoot mirrored.
basic.projectile: A second step, placed adjacent to the last one if it still exists, so stairs form.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same, joined to the previous step as a little stair.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Builds stairs for allies to stand on.

basic.name: Flight of Stairs
basic.cast: Both palms lift together, then sweep forward as if inviting someone up. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Enter into Spell_Simple_Shoot with both hands.
basic.projectile: A flight of three marble steps erupting one after another in a line toward the target.
basic.flight: Three steps rise in sequence along a 6 m line, 0.08 s apart. Sound: three chimes rising in pitch.
basic.impact: The flight stays 3 s as a short staircase.
basic.target_reaction: Every enemy on the line is popped up 0.4 s.
basic.numbers: Line 6 m by 1.2 m, 1.5x BA, knock-up 0.4 s, 3 steps lasting 3 s.
basic.telegraph: Red-rimmed line of step outlines for 0.25 s.
basic.team_use: A line knock-up that sets up Oko's Lance or Lysandra's Chisel Split on the same line.

skills.name: Stair to Nowhere
skills.cast: They sweep both arms up in a rising gesture, as though showing someone the way to the sky. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Enter with both arms sweeping high.
skills.projectile: A rising staircase of five marble steps, each higher than the last, ending in mid-air at 2 m.
skills.flight: The steps rise along an 8 m line in 0.4 s, each one with a chime. Gold dust drifts from the top step. Sound: a rising scale of chimes.
skills.impact: The staircase stays 6 s as solid terrain: a wall for enemies, a ramp for allies.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies hit by the rising steps are pushed aside 1.5 m. Allies who climb it see a gold rim of light at their feet: High Ground.
skills.numbers: Line 8 m, 5 steps up to 2 m tall, lasts 6 s, each step 1.5x BA HP. Allies on it get +15% range, shots that pass over walls, and the passive bonus. Cooldown 14 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see the stair as a red-rimmed wall.
skills.team_use: High ground for Oko, Wrenna and Hespera; a wall that splits the enemy team.

skills.name: Come Back Down
skills.cast: They crouch and spring straight up, out of the top of the screen, then come down feet-first on a target spot. Base: UAL NINJUMP_JUMP (up), then MELEE_JUMP_LAND (down).
skills.projectile: Camedown themselves, falling like a statue from the sky, with a step forming beneath their feet as they land.
skills.flight: Up and out of view in 0.3 s, untargetable for 0.4 s, then down onto the target point in 0.2 s. A white-blue streak of sky trails them. Sound: a whoosh up, silence, then a falling whistle and a marble crash.
skills.impact: A landing step and a ring of cracked marble with gold seams (decal 3 s).
skills.target_reaction: Enemies in the landing ring are stunned 0.6 s, with gold cracks flickering over them.
skills.numbers: Range 10 m, radius 3 m, 1.6x BA, stun 0.6 s, untargetable for 0.4 s. Cooldown 12 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed landing circle 0.4 s before the drop.
skills.team_use: An engage, or a fast way to drop next to an ally and body-block.

passive.name: The Arena Steps
passive.effect: While standing on any of their own steps, Camedown can't drop below 1 HP. Allies standing on their steps take 20% less damage. Steps are destructible and short-lived, so knock Camedown off them or break them.
passive.tell: When Camedown stands on a step, the gold kintsugi cracks across their marble skin glow bright and the broken stair-crown on their head shines. Allies on steps see a thin gold line of light at their feet.

super.name: The Top of the Stair
super.style: Wall or terrain (team lift and drop)
super.cast: They raise both hands and the sky-stair comes down to meet them: a spiral of floating marble steps rising out of sight. Their squad climbs it with them, and then, as they once wished, they all come back down.
super.projectile: A spiral staircase of floating marble steps (spawned instanced steps) rising from Camedown into the sky, then a ring of marble steps erupting where the team lands.
super.flight: The stair spirals up over 0.6 s. Allies within 10 m are lifted up it in a white-blue streak and leave the battlefield for 2 s (untargetable). Camedown chooses a landing point within 16 m. The whole team drops back down there. Sound: an ascending choir, a moment of eerie silence at the top with a faint whisper, then a crash of marble.
super.impact: A ring of marble steps erupts at the landing point (radius 5 m), staying 5 s.
super.target_reaction: Allies at the top get a brief view: a 0.5 s camera cut shows an empty throne and a shapeless dark figure behind it, then they land in a gold flash with an Ascended shield. Enemies at the landing are thrown into the air (knock-up 1 s) with gold cracks over them.
super.numbers: Lift radius 10 m, up to 3 allies plus Camedown. Untargetable for 2 s. Landing radius 5 m within 16 m, 3.0x BA, knock-up 1 s. Landing allies get a 2.0x BA shield for 4 s. The landing ring of steps counts for Camedown's passive and the allies' 20% damage reduction for 5 s.
super.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed ring of step outlines at the landing point for 1.5 s while the team is in the sky.
super.team_use: A team-wide dive or a team-wide escape. If Oko is on the enemy team and in the landing zone, he isn't knocked up: he saw it coming.
super.cinematic: Camedown lifts both hands, and the sky answers: a spiral of floating marble steps unrolls upward out of sight. Their allies are swept up it in a streak of white light. For half a second at the top, the camera sees what Camedown saw: a vast empty throne, and behind it, something shapeless that isn't a god. Then the whole squad comes back down, crashing onto the battlefield in a ring of marble steps, and every enemy under them is thrown into the air.
super.charge: Steps climbed: seconds allies spend standing on Camedown's steps and steps created fill it. On their body, the broken stair-crown grows a glowing gold step for every 20%. HUD: a stair icon that fills step by step.
super.counterplay: The landing zone is shown 1.5 s in advance: scatter. Camedown's passive is off during the 2 s lift. Breaking the landing steps afterwards removes the team's damage reduction. Stuns during the 0.6 s raise cancel it.

beats.tweak: Both arms rise slowly, palms up, head tilted back.
beats.vfx: The spiral stair rises from their feet into the sky.

beats.tweak: Leap up the stair; off-screen 2 s.
beats.vfx: Allies streak up; white-blue sky trail; a 0.5 s camera cut to the empty throne.
beats.prop: Throne and dark-figure set piece (a 2D matte card).

beats.tweak: Lands in a crouch, palm on the ground.
beats.vfx: Gold flash; the ring of steps erupts; enemies knocked up.

beats.tweak: Stands up and looks up at the sky for a moment.
beats.vfx: Stair dissolves upward into light.

locomotion: A calm, unhurried walk, each step placed deliberately as if climbing stairs that aren't there. The run is light and even. Base: UAL Walk_Loop with a slightly raised knee layer; Jog_Fwd_Loop.
idle: Looks up at the sky with a still face, touches the broken crown, then looks at their own hands and the gold cracks in them. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with head and hand layers.
hit: A sharp crack sound and a new hairline crack appears and fills with gold in 0.3 s. Base: UAL Hit_Chest.
death: They kneel and their marble body cracks apart along every gold seam, falling into a pile of marble pieces held together by gold threads, then the gold dims. Base: UAL Death01, with a fracture dissolve.
victory: They sit on a single marble step, looking down at the arena as if from far above. Base: UAL Sitting_Idle_Loop.

animations.notes: Sky gaze; crown touch; hand look.

vfx.direction: 1.2 by 0.4 m marble step with gold kintsugi veins; rises in 0.1 s; sinks in gold dust.
Crack ring with gold seams.
White marble chips with gold sparkle.
Five ascending steps up to 2 m, solid collider.
Thin gold light line at allies' feet on steps.
White-blue streak of sky behind leaps and lifts.
Cracked marble ring with gold seams, 3 m or 5 m.
Spiral of floating steps rising out of view. Fallback: 8 steps plus a light column.
0.5 s cutaway image: empty throne with a shapeless dark figure.
Emissive gold on the skin cracks; brightens on steps.
The stair-crown grows a lit step per 20% charge.

combos.payoff: +15% range and beams that pass over walls.

combos.setup: Camedown's steps are terrain.
combos.payoff: The Night Lirr Sank slams enemies into a stair for the wall-stun.

name: Vell
title: God of Lost Things
team_job: Takes enemies out of the fight for a while: his traps put them in his coat, and he gives back the cooldowns and health your squad has lost.

basic.name: Something You Dropped
basic.cast: He pats his coat, digs a hand into one of the patch pockets at his hip (it goes in up to the elbow: the arm sinks behind a pocket-mouth decal), pulls out whatever comes, squints at it through the loupe, and tosses it underhand. Base: UAL PickUp_Table (reach-in frames) into OVERHAND_THROW retimed to a lazy underhand.
basic.projectile: A random lost object, different every throw from a pool of 12 small meshes: a brass key, a single knitted glove, a closed black umbrella, a pocket watch, a child's shoe, a spoon, a love letter, a marble, a hairpin, one earring, a teacup, a tin soldier. Each has a cream luggage tag tied to it with string.
basic.flight: Slow homing at 13 m/s with a lazy curving path, as if the object were finding its own way home. It tumbles end over end and its luggage tag flutters behind on a short ribbon. A faint lilac trail of dust motes follows it. Sound: the rustle of a coat pocket, then a soft chime like a shop doorbell on arrival.
basic.impact: The object bonks off the target and drops to the ground, where it sits for 1 s with a lilac glint, then fades. A tiny lost-and-found tag decal is left for 1 s.
basic.target_reaction: The target flinches and looks puzzled, patting their own pockets (a short pat-down layer on the victim's arms). A small lilac question mark pops over their head.
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, homing turn rate 180 degrees/s, 1.0x BA, 0.9 attacks/s. Each hit adds 1 Mislaid stack (max 3, lasts 5 s).
basic.team_use: Mislaid stacks are what Vell's traps and super feed on. Focus one enemy and he can lose them.

basic.name: Something Else You Dropped
basic.cast: Same reach-in with the other hand, into a different pocket (a pocket inside a pocket: the hand goes in twice). Base: mirrored.
basic.projectile: Another random object from the pool.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Unclaimed Umbrella
basic.cast: He pulls out the black umbrella that always sticks out of his right pocket, snaps it open with a whump, and flings it spinning. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW with a 0.2 s open-umbrella hold layer.
basic.projectile: The open black umbrella, spinning like a parasol-shaped top, with a dozen smaller lost things raining from under its canopy (buttons, coins, a thimble).
basic.flight: Homing at 11 m/s, spinning; the small objects fall from under it in a 1 m ring along its path. Sound: an umbrella whump, and a little patter of trinkets landing.
basic.impact: It lands on the target point and drops the rest of its trinkets in a 2 m circle; they lie on the ground 1.5 s as a cluttered decal.
basic.target_reaction: Enemies hit are struck by falling trinkets, stumble over them and are slowed 25% for 1.5 s. Each takes 1 Mislaid stack.
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, radius 2 m, 1.4x BA, slow 25% for 1.5 s. +1 Mislaid to each enemy hit.
basic.telegraph: Red-rimmed circle where it will land, 0.3 s.
basic.team_use: Spreads Mislaid across a group to set up the super.

skills.name: Lost and Found
skills.cast: He takes a brass Lost and Found tag off his lapel, licks his thumb, writes a mark on it, and drops it flat on the ground at his feet or flicks it up to 8 m away. Base: UAL PickUp_Table reversed (placing down) or OVERHAND_THROW for the flick.
skills.projectile: A brass luggage tag lying flat on the ground (hard to spot: a 0.4 m decal with a faint lilac shimmer), connected by a thin dotted string to a second tag that Vell keeps pinned to his own coat.
skills.flight: Flicked tags spin through the air in a short arc at 12 m/s. Once placed, the tag goes semi-transparent to enemies after 1 s (25% opacity). Sound: a tiny brass clink.
skills.impact: When an enemy steps on it, a coat-pocket mouth (a dark lilac-lined ellipse decal) opens in the ground and swallows them.
skills.target_reaction: The victim is Misplaced: they drop into the pocket-mouth (a 0.25 s sink) and are gone from the arena for 1.5 s (untargetable, can't act). Then they are spat out at the spot where Vell is standing, landing in a heap (knocked down 0.4 s), patting their pockets. If they had 3 Mislaid stacks, they stay lost for 2.5 s instead.
skills.numbers: Placement range 8 m, up to 3 tags, each lasts 20 s. Misplaced 1.5 s (2.5 s at 3 Mislaid), 1.0x BA on return, knock-down 0.4 s. Cooldown 10 s per tag, 3 charges.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a faint tag with a red rim only within 3 m. Allies always see tags in lilac with a white outline.
skills.team_use: Put tags on the enemy's flank route: the diver who steps on one is delivered right into your squad 1.5 s later, lying on the ground.

skills.name: Lost Property Office
skills.cast: He sets a small brass counter-bell down (prop), rings it with his palm, and opens his coat wide with both hands like a shopkeeper showing his stock. Base: UAL Interact into Spell_Simple_Enter with both hands holding the coat lapels open.
skills.projectile: A burst of labelled lost things flying out of his coat to the allies who lost them: small glowing items with luggage tags, each one shaped like what was lost (an hourglass for cooldown, a heart-shaped locket for health, a boot for speed).
skills.flight: Each item homes to an ally within 7 m at 16 m/s and pops into them with a lilac sparkle. Sound: a counter-bell ding, then a cascade of pocket rustles and little chimes.
skills.impact: A ring of luggage tags on the ground around Vell for 1 s.
skills.target_reaction: Each ally sees a small tagged item pop into their chest. They get back what they lost: 40% of the HP they lost in the last 4 s, and 2 s off every active cooldown. If an ally is suffering a slow or silence, it is lost too (cleansed) and appears in Vell's coat as a tagged item.
skills.numbers: Radius 7 m. Allies: restore 40% of HP lost in the last 4 s, -2 s on all cooldowns, cleanse one slow or silence. Cooldown 22 s. If Corrin is in range for the first time this match, Vell gives back his wife's name and Corrin's super is filled instantly.
skills.telegraph: Allies see a lilac ring with white tags. Enemies see nothing harmful.
skills.team_use: A post-fight reset: after the burst lands, Vell gives the squad back its losses.

passive.name: Pockets Within Pockets
passive.effect: Every enemy takedown and every Misplace hides a trinket in Vell's coat. Each trinket gives +2% damage reduction (max 10). Every 4 trinkets, his next basic throw pulls out something big and strange from the pool of rare objects (a lost church bell, an anchor, a city gate key) for 2.0x BA.
passive.tell: His coat visibly bulges more with every trinket (a blendshape-free swap: three coat mesh variants with fuller pockets, plus extra luggage tags spawning on the coat as props). The halo above his head tilts and wobbles when a rare object is ready.

super.name: Lost Without Trace
super.style: Ground zone (mass banish) with a homing return
super.cast: Vell turns his coat inside out. Every pocket opens at once, and the whole fight around him falls into them.
super.projectile: A swirling vortex of pocket-mouths: dozens of lilac-lined coat pockets opening on the ground in a 9 m circle, and a storm of lost things (keys, gloves, umbrellas, letters, a small war in a bottle) whirling around him.
super.flight: The pockets open across the circle over 0.6 s. Every enemy inside with at least 1 Mislaid stack is pulled down into the nearest pocket. The rest are knocked back 3 m by the storm of objects. After the banish, lost enemies come back out one at a time, wherever Vell's allies tap on the ground (each ally gets one Return Here marker to place within 8 m of themselves). Sound: a huge rustle of fabric, a thousand tiny objects clattering, then a muffled silence like being inside a coat.
super.impact: The 9 m circle is covered in scattered lost objects for 3 s (a cluttered decal). Wherever a lost enemy is returned, a pocket-mouth opens and spits them out in a puff of lilac dust and lint.
super.target_reaction: Lost enemies vanish for 3 to 5 s (3 s at 1 Mislaid, 4 s at 2, 5 s at 3), see a dark coat-lining vignette on their own screen with a lilac luggage tag reading their name, then return in a heap, knocked down for 0.6 s. Enemies without Mislaid are knocked back 3 m and slowed 30% for 2 s.
super.numbers: Radius 9 m. Banish duration 3-5 s by Mislaid stacks. Each lost enemy takes 2.0x BA when returned. Allies place up to 4 Return Here markers; any lost enemy not placed by an ally comes back at their original spot. Vell is rooted for 1.0 s while the coat is inside out, and takes 30% more damage during it.
super.telegraph: Enemies see a 0.6 s red-rimmed ring of pocket outlines opening; enemies with Mislaid stacks see a lilac tag icon above their own heads warning them.
super.team_use: Turns a 4v4 into a 4v1 or 4v2 for up to 5 seconds, and lets the squad choose where each enemy reappears: in a Moss maze, on a Wrenna Sounding, in front of Oko's lance or under Hespera's sun.
super.cinematic: Vell grabs his lapels and, with a grunt, pulls his whole coat inside out. Camera dips toward the lining: hundreds of pockets, each one opening like a mouth. The storm begins: keys, gloves, umbrellas, love letters and teacups whirl around him, and the enemies nearest him drop through the floor into pockets and are gone. For a few seconds the arena is very quiet. Then Vell's allies point at the ground, and the lost come back out one by one, in a heap, patting their pockets, exactly where his squad wanted them.
super.charge: Things kept: every Mislaid stack applied and every Misplace fills it (100 points; Mislaid +3, Misplace +12, takedown +10). On his body, the coat bulges and luggage tags multiply on it; the halo above his head brightens from dull brass to bright gold. HUD: a coat icon whose pockets fill.
super.counterplay: Only enemies with Mislaid stacks are banished, so dodge his slow homing throws (they can be body-blocked by another enemy, or outrun by dashing). The 0.6 s pocket ring is a warning. Vell is rooted for 1.0 s and takes 30% more damage while the coat is inside out. Lost enemies return with a 1.0x BA shield (they had a long think), and if allies don't place markers they come back where they left.

locomotion: A shuffling old shopkeeper's walk, slightly bow-legged, hands in his pockets. The run is a hurried bustle with the coat flapping and trinkets jingling. Base: UAL Walk_Loop retimed 15% slower with a hands-in-pockets arm layer; Jog_Fwd_Loop.

victory: He takes the defeated enemy's lost thing (a glowing tag) and files it carefully in an inner pocket, then pats it. Base: UAL Interact.

name: Hespera
title: Widow of the Sun
team_job: The heaviest hitter on the field: she slings burning cinders, cages enemies in a ring of dusk, and can drop the dead sun anywhere on the map. Anything the squad holds still, she can hit.

basic.name: Cinder Sling
basic.cast: She unwinds a length of the iron chain from her waist with her right hand. A fist-sized cinder of the dead sun hangs from its end, and she whirls it once and lets go. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW with a one-loop sling windup layer.
basic.projectile: A cinder broken off the dead sun: a black, cracked lump of rock glowing orange through its cracks, with a crust that flakes off as it flies.
basic.flight: Low arc, 18 m/s, 9 m. It trails ash flakes and a thin ember ribbon. Sound: a chain whir, a release clink and a dull roar like a far-off fire.
basic.impact: It cracks open on impact in a small orange burst, leaving a 1 m scorch decal for 1.5 s.
basic.target_reaction: The target recoils with an arm thrown up against the heat, and ash settles on their shoulders.
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, splash 1 m, 1.0x BA, 0.9 attacks/s (tap).
basic.team_use: Steady poke damage between charged throws.

basic.name: Cinder Sling
basic.cast: The same with the left hand, the chain looping behind her back. Base: mirrored.
basic.projectile: Same cinder.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Charged Cinder Sling
basic.cast: Hold: she plants her boots and swings the chain overhead in widening circles (the cinder grows from fist-size to head-size as it's fed), her braid whipping and her eyes glowing gold. Release: a full-body heave. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Enter with an overhead circling arm layer (looped), then OVERHAND_THROW with a forward step.
basic.projectile: A charged cinder that grows with the hold, its cracks widening until a molten core shows, ringed by a little solar corona.
basic.flight: High arc, 14 m/s, range 9-14 m depending on charge, apex 3-5 m. It leaves a thick black smoke ribbon and drips burning slag along the path. Sound: the whir pitches up while charging, then a deep whoosh and a falling whistle.
basic.impact: It shatters in a ring of molten slag and leaves a burning puddle decal (radius 1.5-3 m) for 2 s.
basic.target_reaction: Enemies are knocked down for 0.4 s at full charge, scorched (an ember crust overlay on the body) and Burning for 2 s.
basic.numbers: Range 9-14 m, radius 1.5-3 m, damage 1.5x BA (0.4 s hold) to 3.0x BA (1.5 s), Burning 0.4x BA/s for 2 s, full charge knock-down 0.4 s.
basic.telegraph: A red-rimmed landing circle that grows with the charge, visible to enemies from the start of the hold.
basic.team_use: Big damage that only lands on targets someone else is holding still: rooted, stunned, kneeling or dancing.

skills.name: Dusk
skills.cast: She lifts the sun-shaped pauldron on her left shoulder with her right hand and tips it toward the ground like shading a lamp. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with the casting arm crossing her body to the left shoulder.
skills.projectile: A ring of setting sunlight: a 1 m tall wall of violet-orange twilight flame forming a circle on the ground.
skills.flight: The ring burns in from the outside edge over 0.4 s at the target point. Embers drift up from it and the inside dims to dusk. Sound: a long low sigh like evening wind, and a crackle.
skills.impact: A scorched ring decal with a violet glow, lasting 4 s.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies who cross the ring take heavy burn damage and are slowed: violet-orange flames lick up their legs (flame flipbook on the feet). Enemies inside see the light dim around them (a violet tint on their own screen).
skills.numbers: Range 10 m, radius 4 m, lasts 4 s. Crossing the ring: 1.5x BA and slow 40% for 1.5 s. Enemies inside take 15% more damage from Charged Cinder Sling. Cooldown 13 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see the ring with a red rim as it burns in. Allies see it violet with a white outline.
skills.team_use: A cage, not a wall: enemies inside can leave but pay for it. Hob roots or Pyrrhos knock-backs keep them inside while Hespera throws.

skills.name: Long Haul
skills.cast: She flings the full length of her chain overhand and hauls it back hand over hand, the way she drags the sun across the sky. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW into MELEE_HOOK.
skills.projectile: Her iron chain, with a heavy hook-ended shackle that glows sun-gold.
skills.flight: Straight line at 26 m/s to 10 m, the chain paying out as a ribbon with heat shimmer. On hit it snaps taut. Sound: rattling chain, a clank, then a grunt and a drag.
skills.impact: A drag mark of scorched ground along the path, 1 s.
skills.target_reaction: An enemy is hauled 5 m toward her, stumbling, with an ember shackle around the waist. An ally is hauled to her side and sees a gold shackle that breaks off as a 1.0x BA shield.
skills.numbers: Range 10 m. Enemy: pull 5 m, 1.0x BA. Ally: pull to her side and a 1.0x BA shield for 3 s. Cooldown 12 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red line flash 0.2 s before.
skills.team_use: Drag an enemy into the Dusk ring, or drag a squad mate out from under a dive.

passive.name: Nobody Says Thank You
passive.effect: Hespera is Weary: her move speed is 5% lower than normal. When an ally uses the Thanks quick-chat on her, or when she saves an ally with Long Haul, she gets +10% damage for 8 s and 5% super charge (once per ally per 20 s). Every 60 s without thanks, her next Charged Cinder Sling charges 25% faster (she's angry).
passive.tell: Her eyes and the sun pauldron glow gold when she's been thanked, and the burns on her arms flare orange when she's angry. A tiny Thanks icon floats over her head when an ally thanks her.

super.name: Setting Down the Sun
super.style: Lobbed arc (map-wide) into a ground zone
super.cast: She unwinds the whole chain from around her body, braces her boots and hauls, and something huge comes down out of the sky on the other end. She has carried it for three hundred years. Today she puts it down hard.
super.projectile: The dead sun: a 10 m sphere of black, cracked, cooling rock with molten light pouring out of its cracks and a weak, flickering corona. It falls on the end of a colossal ghostly chain that runs from Hespera's hands up into the sky.
super.flight: Hespera targets any point on the map. A sun-shaped shadow appears there and grows over 2.5 s while the sun descends slowly from the sky (a large mesh with a falling arc, its chain visible from Hespera). Sound: a deep grinding chain, wind rushing, then a muffled boom that drops all other sound for a second.
super.impact: It hits in a huge flash and shockwave. The ground at the impact is left as a molten crater (radius 7 m) that burns for 5 s and then cools to black rock, plus a 12 m scorch decal.
super.target_reaction: Enemies at the centre are hurled up and outward (1.0 s knock-up), wreathed in ember crust and Burning. Enemies at the edge are pushed out 4 m and slowed. Allies inside the shadow see a gold outline: they take no damage from the impact itself and get a warm 1.5x BA shield from the sun's light.
super.numbers: Global range. Impact radius 10 m: 6.0x BA at the centre (inside 3 m), 3.0x BA at the edge. Knock-up 1.0 s at the centre, push 4 m at the edge. Molten crater 7 m for 5 s: 1.0x BA/s to enemies. Hespera is rooted during the 2.5 s haul and Unburdened for 6 s after: +30% move speed, but -30% damage.
super.telegraph: A 2.5 s growing red-rimmed sun shadow at the impact point, visible to everyone, and the chain itself is visible across the map, pointing back at Hespera.
super.team_use: The squad's job is to keep enemies inside the shadow for 2.5 s: Hob's Cracked Bell, Moss's maze, Sena's Knot, Halven's Kneel, Thimble's Fairy Ring. If Aurvan casts his super within 5 s of hers, the sun and moon overlap into an Eclipse: the arena goes dark and the impact deals +30%.
super.cinematic: Hespera unwinds the chain from her shoulder, wraps it twice around her fists and plants her boots. Camera cuts up the chain into the sky. Something enormous is hanging there: a dead sun, black and cracked, light leaking out of it. She hauls. It comes down slowly, its shadow spreading across the arena, and everyone underneath starts to run. Then it lands. A flash, a ring of fire, a second of silence. Hespera drops the chain and rolls her shoulders. For the first time in three hundred years, her hands are empty.
super.charge: Hours carried: damage dealt with Charged Cinder Sling and Dusk fills it, and each ally's Thanks adds 5%. On her body, the sun pauldron on her shoulder brightens from tarnished gold to blazing white-gold, and the chain on her waist glows link by link. HUD: a sun icon that rises over a horizon.
super.counterplay: 2.5 s of warning with a huge shadow: leave the 10 m circle. Any stun on Hespera during the haul drops the sun early at 50% damage wherever it is in its fall. After it lands she is Unburdened (-30% damage) for 6 s, so punish her then. Allies can't use it from safety: Hespera must be alive and rooted the whole time.

locomotion: A heavy, dragging stride, as if still pulling a load, one shoulder lower than the other. The run is a grim, powerful jog with the chain rattling. Base: UAL Walk_Loop retimed 10% slower with a leaning layer; Jog_Fwd_Loop.
idle: Rubs the chafed skin under the chain, rolls her neck, glares at the sky. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with hand and neck layers.
hit: She grunts and barely moves; embers burst from her burns. Base: UAL Hit_Chest at 50% weight.
death: She drops to her knees, the chain slides off her and coils on the ground, and the sun pauldron dims to black. Then she lies down, almost gratefully. Base: UAL Death01 slowed.
victory: She sits on the ground with her back against nothing, closes her eyes and lets the sun pauldron cool. Then she says, flatly, You're welcome. Base: UAL Sitting_Idle_Loop.

Full-body heave with a forward step.
Arm crosses to tip the pauldron.

Scales from 0.25 m to 0.6 m with the charge; molten core and a small corona billboard.

Molten slag puddle that cools from orange to black over 2 s.
Ember crust shader on scorched victims.
1 m violet-orange flame ring (scrolling flame texture on a cylinder band); dims the interior.
Iron chain ribbon with heat shimmer and a glowing gold shackle end.
10 m cracked black sphere with emissive cracks and a flickering corona. Fallback: a large billboard sun and a shadow decal.
Colossal ghost chain from her hands into the sky.
Growing circular shadow with a red rim, 2.5 s.
White flash, expanding shockwave ring, molten crater decal (7 m) cooling to black.
Emissive on the sun pauldron tied to super charge.

name: Old Kerberon
title: the Gate-Dog
team_job: The gate-dog of the dead: he sets a pack of ghost hounds on whoever threatens the squad, guards a gate nobody gets through, and when all three heads wake, he becomes three fighters at once.

basic.name: Sic 'Em
basic.cast: The awake middle head growls and he points a heavy paw at the target, then slaps his thigh like calling a dog. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with a pointing paw, plus a thigh-slap hand layer on the other side.
basic.projectile: A ghost hound: a wolf-sized spectral black dog (a separate low-poly spawned mesh, about 600 tris, with NO skeleton: its 6-frame run cycle is baked as a morph-target loop, and its smoky edges hide the frame steps) made of grey-blue smoke with amber ember eyes, born from the shadow at his feet.
basic.flight: The hound springs from his shadow and bounds to the target at 14 m/s, leaving pawprints of grey ash that fade in 1 s and a ribbon of smoke from its tail. It bites once and dissolves. Sound: a deep growl, padding feet, a single bark on the bite.
basic.impact: A snap of spectral jaws (a jaw-shaped flipbook closing) and a puff of grey ash. A small ash-pawprint decal under the target, 1 s.
basic.target_reaction: The target is shoved back half a step as the jaws close on its arm or leg, with grey ash teeth marks glowing on the limb for 1 s.
basic.numbers: Range 8 m, 1.0x BA, 0.9 attacks/s. The hound can be body-blocked by any enemy in its path (it bites the first one).
basic.team_use: Hounds target whoever Kerberon or a squad mate last pinged, so the squad can call the bite.

basic.name: Sic 'Em
basic.cast: The same with the other paw. Base: mirrored.
basic.projectile: A second hound.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Gate-Dog's Lunge
basic.cast: He drops onto all fours for a moment and lunges with the middle head leading, snapping (the whole head moves with the head and neck bones), while two ghost hounds lunge alongside him. Base: UAL SWORD_DASH retimed to 0.35 s with a low crouched body layer, empty paws.
basic.projectile: Kerberon's own spectral jaws (a large jaw-shaped flipbook in front of his muzzle) and two ghost hounds flanking him.
basic.flight: A 3 m lunge in 0.25 s; the hounds run at his sides and fan out 30 degrees. Grey ash sprays from his paws. Sound: a three-voice snarl (two voices are the ghost hounds), then a crunch.
basic.impact: A burst of ash and a rust-coloured key-glint at each bite point.
basic.target_reaction: The main target is pinned for 0.4 s (the victim plays a short down-and-pinned hit reaction), with ghost jaws clamped on its shoulder.
basic.numbers: Lunge 3 m, 1.5x BA to the main target, 0.6x BA per hound bite, pin 0.4 s.
basic.telegraph: A 0.15 s crouch with his amber eyes flaring.
basic.team_use: The pin holds a target still for a skillshot.

skills.name: Guard the Gate
skills.cast: He takes one of the three great rusted keys from his collar and drives it into the ground in front of him, turning it like a lock. Base: UAL PickUp_Table reversed (setting down) blended with a two-handed key-turn wrist layer.
skills.projectile: A ghostly iron gate of the underworld: two black iron gateposts with a pair of gates, 5 m wide, glowing blue at the hinges, rising out of the ground in a puff of ash.
skills.flight: The gate rises in 0.3 s along a line perpendicular to his facing, 4 m in front of him. Sound: rusty hinges and a deep lock-clunk.
skills.impact: The gate stands for 5 s. Its ground line shows an ash threshold decal.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies who try to cross the gate are stopped and knocked back 2 m (a shove reaction) and marked Turned Away: a ghostly hound head growls over them for 2 s (their damage to Kerberon's allies is reduced 20%). Allies pass through freely: they see the gates swing open for them.
skills.numbers: Range 4 m in front, 5 m wide, lasts 5 s, 3.0x BA HP. Enemy crossing: knocked back 2 m, 0.8x BA. Turned Away: -20% damage dealt for 2 s. Cooldown 14 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see the gate with a red rim. Allies see it with a soft blue outline and open gates.
skills.team_use: A one-way wall: the squad can retreat through it and attack through it, enemies can't follow.

skills.name: Honey Cake
skills.cast: He sniffs the air, finds the ally who needs him, and bounds to them, landing on all fours in front of them, then rears up with his arms spread. Base: UAL NINJUMP_JUMP into MELEE_JUMP_LAND, then IDLE_SHIELD with arms spread.
skills.projectile: Kerberon himself, with a trail of ghostly honey-gold light, and a single honey cake that he drops at the ally's feet (a small prop).
skills.flight: Leap up to 10 m in 0.4 s toward an ally. Sound: a happy whuff, then a protective growl.
skills.impact: A ring of ash pawprints around the ally; the honey cake sits on the ground for 6 s.
skills.target_reaction: Kerberon stands guard: he takes 50% of the damage aimed at that ally for 3 s (a blue tether from him to the ally). The ally sees a small honey cake icon; picking up the cake heals 1.0x BA. If the ally is Nyssa, the guard lasts 5 s and the cake heals 2.0x BA.
skills.numbers: Leap 10 m to an ally, guard 3 s (5 s for Nyssa), redirect 50% of damage, cake heal 1.0x BA (2.0x BA for Nyssa). Cooldown 16 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see a golden honey-cake icon; enemies see a grey-rimmed tether.
skills.team_use: A bodyguard move for the squad's carry. The lore: he'd die for Nyssa, and he will.

passive.name: One Head on Duty
passive.effect: Only the middle head is awake. Every time Kerberon or his hounds bite an enemy, or he blocks damage for an ally, one of the sleeping heads stirs (Stir meter, 0-100). At 50 the left head half-wakes: his hounds come in pairs (every basic sends 2 hounds at 60% damage each). At 100 the right head also stirs: Kerberon gets +20% damage reduction until he takes 3 hits. Then the meter drains.
passive.tell: The two side heads are part of the mesh and can't move on their own. Instead their eyes are a texture swap: shut, half-open (twitching via UV flicker) and open amber. Ash snores puff from their noses while asleep (a small particle emitter on each side muzzle). When stirring, their ears twitch via a vertex shader.

super.name: All Three Awake
super.cast: He throws his middle head back and howls at the gate of the dead. One by one, the two side heads open their eyes for the first time in years, and the gate-dog is whole again for a little while.
super.projectile: Kerberon himself, wreathed in underworld ember, plus two huge spectral dog heads that rise from the sleeping side heads (large ghost-head meshes attached to the left and right shoulder bones, so they move with his torso, each the size of a person), and a great iron gate rising behind him.
super.flight: The side heads' eyes snap open (texture swap) and their spectral counterparts rear up from them, swelling to 3x size. For 7 s each head fights on its own: the left head breathes a cone of ghost-fire, the right head snaps at the nearest enemy with a lunging jaw flipbook every 1 s, and the middle head and body fight as normal. Sound: a three-voice howl in harmony, a heavy gate opening, then a running chorus of growls.
super.impact: A ring of ash and ember (radius 6 m) around him for the duration, and the gate of the dead behind him (a big spawned gate mesh) that stays 7 s.
super.target_reaction: Enemies in the left head's cone are Burning with underworld fire (blue-orange flames on their body). Enemies snapped by the right head are dragged 2 m toward Kerberon. Enemies who die near him are dragged back to the gate (a short sink-into-ash effect) and respawn 5 s later.
super.numbers: Lasts 7 s. Left head: ghost-fire cone 5 m by 50 degrees, 0.8x BA/s and Burning. Right head: a bite every 1 s on the nearest enemy within 5 m, 1.2x BA and a 2 m pull. Body: +30% damage reduction and his hounds come 3 at a time. On cast he roars: 1.5x BA in 6 m and a 0.8 s fear. Enemies killed within 6 m respawn 5 s later.
super.telegraph: A 0.8 s howl windup, with a red-rimmed 6 m ring and his eyes and both side heads' eyes glowing.
super.team_use: He becomes three fighters: a tank that pulls, burns and fears all at once. If Nyssa is on the team and casts Passage Paid, her ferry lands at his gate.
super.cinematic: Kerberon throws his head back and howls. Camera drops low, looking up at his shaggy shoulders. The two side heads, asleep all match, tongues lolling, twitch. Then their eyes open, amber and bright. Two huge ghostly dog heads rear up from them, and behind him the iron gate of the dead grinds open. For seven seconds, the old gate-dog has his brothers back. One breathes fire, one snaps and drags, the middle one leads the pack. Nobody gets past.
super.charge: Stirring: the Stir meter's overflow, bites and damage blocked for allies fill it. On his body, the side heads snore louder (bigger ash puffs), then their ears twitch, then their eyelids flicker. HUD: three small dog-head icons whose eyes open one by one.
super.counterplay: Kite him: his heads have short reach (5-6 m), and he's a slow mover during the 7 s. The left head's fire cone faces his left side, so circle to his right. Silence or a stun on cast cancels it before the side heads wake. Once it ends, the side heads fall asleep again and he's Groggy for 2 s (-20% move speed).

name: Ophira
title: of the Glass
team_job: Turns her allies into mirrors: enemy shots bounce back off them, her glass shards ricochet off them, and her gaze stops anyone who runs straight at the squad.

basic.name: Glass Shard
basic.cast: She flicks her right hand forward from the wrist, and a shard of silvered glass breaks off the cracked mirror-skin of her forearm (the crack mask on her forearm flashes where it left). Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot retimed 15% faster, with a wrist-flick hand layer.
basic.projectile: A thin, sharp sliver of mirror glass, silver on one side and black on the back, flashing reflections of the arena as it spins (a cheap environment-map reflection on a 2-quad mesh).
basic.flight: Straight, 24 m/s, 9 m, spinning on its long axis so it strobes silver-black. On hitting an enemy, it ricochets off them to a second enemy within 4 m. On hitting one of Ophira's Polished allies or any wall or terrain, it bounces off at the mirror angle and keeps going with +25% damage (up to 2 bounces). A thin glass-cyan streak trails it. Sound: a high crystalline ting, and a chime on every bounce.
basic.impact: The shard shatters into glitter on its final hit: a spray of tiny reflective flakes.
basic.target_reaction: The victim jerks aside, and fine glass glitter clings to them for 1 s, catching the light.
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, 1.0x BA, ricochet 0.6x BA (4 m), +25% per mirror bounce off allies or walls (max 2). 1.1 attacks/s.
basic.team_use: Ophira aims through her own team: shots bounced off a Polished ally hit harder and come from an angle enemies don't expect.

basic.name: Glass Shard
basic.cast: The same from the left hand, with the bronze shield arm swinging aside. Base: mirrored.
basic.projectile: Same shard.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Shield Glance
basic.cast: She swings her round polished shield up from her left forearm (a prop on the left lower-arm bone) and tilts it so it catches the light, flashing a beam of reflected light that splinters into three shards. Base: UAL IDLE_SHIELD raised quickly, into a short tilt-and-flash wrist layer.
basic.projectile: A flash of reflected light off the polished shield that splits into three glass shards in a narrow fan.
basic.flight: Three shards fan out at 22 m/s in a 20-degree spread, each able to bounce once. Sound: a bright shield-gleam chime and three tings.
basic.impact: Each shard shatters in glitter.
basic.target_reaction: As hit 1. A target hit by two or more shards is Dazzled for 0.5 s (a silver glare on the face).
basic.numbers: Range 9 m, 3 shards at 0.6x BA each, each bounces once (+25%), Dazzle 0.5 s on 2+ hits.
basic.team_use: Short burst, best when bouncing off a frontliner standing next to the target.

skills.name: Polished Shield
skills.cast: She touches her shield with two fingers, then points at an ally, and a sheen of silver glass flows over them. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with a two-finger touch on the shield first.
skills.projectile: A thin skin of mirror glass flowing over the ally like quicksilver: a reflective fresnel shell with faint crack lines.
skills.flight: A silver ribbon arcs from her shield to the ally at 30 m/s, then the glass spreads over them from head to feet in 0.2 s. Sound: a ripple like water on glass, then a clear ring.
skills.impact: The ally becomes Polished.
skills.target_reaction: The ally sees their own hero turn mirror-bright, reflecting the arena. Enemy projectiles that hit them are reflected back at the shooter (the projectile visibly reverses with a silver flash), and they can be used as a bounce surface by Ophira's shards. Enemy melee hits crack the glass (crack lines spread).
skills.numbers: Range 9 m, lasts 3 s or until it reflects 3 projectiles. Reflected projectiles deal their full damage to their owner. Melee hits are reduced 30%. Cooldown 12 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see a silver sheen with a soft white outline. Enemies see the same with a grey rim and a small mirror icon, so they know not to shoot.
skills.team_use: Put it on whoever is about to eat a big skillshot: Oko's lance, Nyssa's coins, Hespera's cinder, Wrenna's vials. Enemy marksmen and mages stop shooting.

skills.name: Look at Me
skills.cast: She lifts her head and opens her eyes fully. The snakes in her hair rise and turn forward (the snakes are mesh, not bones: a vertex-shader lift drives them up and forward, and their eye-glow brightens). Base: UAL Idle_Loop with a head-up, chin-lifted pose layer, held 0.4 s.
skills.projectile: Her gaze: a cone of green-silver light from her eyes with a mirror-surface shimmer, carrying the reflections of each enemy inside it.
skills.flight: A 50-degree cone, 8 m, hitscan after the 0.4 s windup. Sound: snakes hissing in chorus, then a glassy ring.
skills.impact: Each victim's reflection appears for a moment in front of them as a silver mirror-copy facing them (a ghost mesh of the victim, mirrored and tinted silver).
skills.target_reaction: Enemies in the cone who are FACING Ophira (their facing within 90 degrees of her) are Self-Seen: they freeze, staring at their own reflection with their arms at their sides, stunned for 1.2 s. Enemies facing away are only slowed 20% for 1 s. Petrified enemies (Lysandra's super) below 25% HP shatter into stone pieces.
skills.numbers: Cone 8 m by 50 degrees, 1.0x BA, stun 1.2 s if facing her, slow 20% for 1 s if not. Shatters petrified enemies below 25% HP. Cooldown 14 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed cone and her snakes rising for 0.4 s: turn your back.
skills.team_use: Peel: any diver running straight at the squad is facing her and gets stopped. Turning away to dodge it means they've stopped diving.

passive.name: Only a Reflection
passive.effect: Every 8 s, the first enemy projectile that hits Ophira is reflected back at its shooter. Ophira takes 20% less damage while standing in water or near a reflective surface (Wrenna and Sleeper water, Nyssa's river, Camedown's marble, Polished allies within 3 m).
passive.tell: Her mirror skin shimmers brighter when the reflect is ready, and the snakes in her hair turn their heads (vertex shader) toward the nearest enemy shooter. When it's on cooldown, a fine crack line glows across her cheek.

super.name: What You Are
super.style: Ground zone (mirror hall) with summoned reflections
super.cast: She raises her shield high, and it shatters. Every shard becomes a standing mirror, and in every mirror, every enemy sees exactly what they are.
super.projectile: A ring of tall standing mirrors (8 spawned mirror panels, 2.5 m tall, cracked silver glass in tarnished bronze frames) around a 10 m circle, and silver mirror-copies of every enemy inside, stepping out of the glass.
super.flight: The shield shatters into a burst of shards that fly out and plant upright as mirrors in a ring over 0.5 s. Each enemy inside then gets a mirror-copy of themselves (a silver tinted clone of their own mesh, playing their own attack clips) that steps out of the nearest mirror and fights them for 5 s. Ophira can move between the mirrors instantly (tap a mirror to step into it and out of another). Sound: a shatter, a ringing glass drone, then the enemies' own attack sounds played back pitched down.
super.impact: A mirror-floor decal in the circle that reflects the scene (a cheap planar reflection or a flipped-scene decal fallback), lasting 5 s.
super.target_reaction: Each enemy faces their reflection: the copy repeats every ability they cast, back at them, 0.5 s later, and their basic attacks against it are mirrored back for half damage. Their outline turns silver. Allies inside are Polished for the whole duration.
super.numbers: Radius 10 m, lasts 5 s. Each enemy reflection copies its owner's abilities and basics on a 0.5 s delay at 60% damage, aimed at its owner. Reflections have 2.0x BA HP each and shatter when killed. Allies inside: Polished (reflect projectiles) for 5 s. Ophira blinks between mirrors freely. If allied Lysandra is inside, Ophira finally looks at her: all of Lysandra's Flake stacks are removed and she heals 30%.
super.telegraph: Enemies see the red-rimmed mirror ring planting over 0.5 s before the reflections step out.
super.team_use: Enemies are forced to fight themselves for 5 s, and the squad's ranged allies are all Polished. The harder the enemy team hits, the harder they get hit back: stop casting, kill your reflection first, or walk out.
super.cinematic: Ophira lifts her polished shield over her head. Camera tilts up to it; for an instant the whole fight is reflected in it. Then it shatters. Shards fly outward and stand up as tall cracked mirrors in a ring around the fight. In each one, an enemy sees themselves, and their reflection steps out of the glass, silver, wearing their face, and starts using their own moves on them. Ophira steps into one mirror and out of another across the circle. Her gaze never turned anyone to stone. It shows you what you are.
super.charge: Reflections: every projectile reflected (by her passive or by Polished allies) and every Self-Seen enemy fills it. On her body, the cracked mirror skin fills with light crack by crack, until at full charge she shines like a mirror in sunlight. HUD: a hand mirror icon whose glass clears.
super.counterplay: Stop casting: a reflection only copies what you do, so an enemy who stops attacking makes their copy harmless. Reflections can be killed (2.0x BA HP) and the ring of mirrors can be walked out of (they're glass panels with gaps). Ophira's shield is gone for 5 s after the super, so she has no Shield Glance and her passive reflect is off.
