name: Tychon
title: God of the Last Roll
team_job: A god of luck who lost his own: every one of his attacks is a dice roll, and his squad can push the odds by standing next to him and blowing on the dice.

basic.name: Roll the Bones
basic.cast: He shakes a closed fist next to his ear with a big grin (dice rattle), blows on it, then rolls it out underhand like a craps throw. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW retimed to an underhand bowling release, with a 0.15 s shake-and-blow layer at the ear.
basic.projectile: A single ivory die the size of a fist with violet pips, glowing at the edges.
basic.flight: It bounces twice along the ground toward the aim point at 14 m/s (two small hops, tumbling), and comes to rest showing a random face. It then sits as a mine for 2.5 s, its top face glowing violet. It detonates when an enemy comes within 1.5 m, or at the end. Sound: a dice rattle, two clacks on the bounces, then a casino-chip clink when it settles.
basic.impact: It bursts in a flash of violet pips (the number on its face drawn in the explosion as pip sprites). A small pip-pattern scorch decal stays 1 s.
basic.target_reaction: Victims are knocked back a step and see the rolled number floating over their head for 0.5 s. On a 6 they are knocked down for 0.4 s. On a 1, the die fizzles with a sad squeak and a puff of smoke, and the enemy gets a small speed boost instead (Tychon's bad luck).
basic.numbers: Range 8 m, trigger radius 1.5 m, blast radius 1.8 m. Damage by face: 1 = fizzle (0.2x BA, and the enemy gains +10% speed for 1 s), 2-5 = 0.6x/0.8x/1.0x/1.2x BA, 6 = 2.0x BA and knock-down 0.4 s. 0.9 throws/s, max 3 dice on the ground.
basic.telegraph: Enemies see each settled die with a red rim and its face number. Allies see it with a white outline.
basic.team_use: Lay dice on choke points and the enemy's escape lanes. Allies near him nudge the faces up (see passive).

basic.name: Roll the Bones
basic.cast: Same throw with the left hand, a little flourish of the coat tail. Base: mirrored.
basic.projectile: Same die.
basic.flight: Same.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Doubles
basic.cast: He rattles two dice in both cupped hands overhead, kisses his fist, and throws both at once. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW with a two-hand shake-and-kiss layer.
basic.projectile: A pair of dice that land side by side.
basic.flight: Both bounce out at 14 m/s, landing 1 m apart, and show their faces. If they show doubles (a pair), they glow gold and link with a gold arc. Sound: a double rattle, then a slot-machine ding on doubles.
basic.impact: Each detonates as hit 1. Doubles detonate together in a single big gold burst instead.
basic.target_reaction: As hit 1. On doubles, every enemy in the burst is stunned 0.6 s and gold pips orbit their head.
basic.numbers: Range 8 m, each die as hit 1. Doubles (1 in 6 base): both faces' damage combined in a 3 m blast, plus a 0.6 s stun.
basic.team_use: A pair on the ground blocks a lane; a double is a free stun for the squad.

skills.name: Lucky Horseshoe
skills.cast: He unhooks the brass horseshoe from his belt, spits on it for luck, and pitches it like a game of horseshoes. Base: UAL OVERHAND_THROW retimed to an underhand pitch.
skills.projectile: The brass horseshoe, spinning flat, trailing four-leaf clovers.
skills.flight: Lobbed arc at 13 m/s to 9 m; it lands with a clang and spins around a peg of light. Sound: a clang, then a crowd cheering faintly.
skills.impact: A 4 m ring of green clover light on the ground (a horseshoe-shaped open ring decal, its opening pointing back at Tychon) for 5 s.
skills.target_reaction: Allies inside see little clovers drifting around them: every die they are involved in rolls twice and keeps the higher (Tychon's rolls and Tychon's buffs on them). Enemies inside get a black-cat glyph over their heads: Tychon's dice roll twice against them and keep the higher, and their own crits are disabled.
skills.numbers: Range 9 m, radius 4 m, lasts 5 s. Allies: Lucky (Tychon's rolls involving them roll with advantage), +10% crit chance. Enemies: Unlucky (Tychon's dice against them roll with advantage, and they can't crit). Cooldown 14 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed horseshoe ring; allies see it green with a white outline.
skills.team_use: Stack your dice inside the horseshoe and the squad will roll sixes.

skills.name: Deal Me In
skills.cast: He fans out a deck of cards from inside his coat, riffles it with a flourish, and flicks one card to each ally in range. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with a card-fan and riffle hand layer.
skills.projectile: Oversized playing cards, one per ally, spinning face down as they fly.
skills.flight: Homing, 22 m/s, one card to each ally within 10 m (up to 3, plus himself). Each card flips face up as it reaches the ally. Sound: a riffle shuffle, then a snap per card.
skills.impact: The card sticks to the ally's back, face out, and glows its suit colour.
skills.target_reaction: Each ally sees their card's suit on their own back. Hearts: heal 1.5x BA over 3 s. Spades: +20% damage for 4 s. Diamonds: +25% move speed for 4 s. Clubs: a 1.5x BA shield for 4 s. An Ace (1 in 13) gives that suit's effect doubled. Each ally can tap once to Twist: discard and draw a new random card.
skills.numbers: Range 10 m, up to 4 cards, effects as listed, Twist once per card. Cooldown 15 s.
skills.telegraph: Allies see their card face-up. Enemies see the cards with a grey rim and the suit, so they can read the threat.
skills.team_use: A random team buff that the squad can steer: anyone who doesn't like their card can twist.

passive.name: The Unluckiest God
passive.effect: Every ability Tychon casts rolls a d6, shown over his head. 1 backfires (the effect is halved, and Tychon is slowed 20% for 1 s while a little raincloud rains on him). 2-5 are normal, scaling from 80% to 110%. 6 is devastating (+100% effect). Allies within 4 m of him can tap Blow on It once per 10 s: +1 to his next roll. After three 1s in a row, his next roll is a guaranteed 6 (he loaded the dice, but it never helped).
passive.tell: His pupils are dice pips that show his last roll (a 6-state eye texture swap) and blink to a new face every time he rolls. The four-leaf clover on his belt glows green when an ally has blown on his dice. On a 1, a tiny raincloud sprite appears over his head.

super.name: The Last Roll
super.style: Lobbed arc into a random arena-scale effect
super.cast: He pulls out the die he lost his luck with, the one he rolled against the Fates, gold and chipped, and throws it as hard as he can. His whole team watches it tumble.
super.projectile: A 3 m tall golden die with violet pips and one chipped corner, tumbling across the field, then one of six outcomes.
super.flight: It flies in a high arc at 12 m/s to a target point up to 14 m away, lands with a booming bounce and tumbles across the ground for 1.5 s inside an 8 m circle, faces flashing. Allies within 6 m of the die during the tumble can tap Blow on It (each adds +1, max 6). It settles, shows its face for 0.5 s, then the effect fires. Sound: a giant dice rattle, booming clacks, a held breath from the crowd, then a different jingle for each face.
super.impact: 1 Snake Eyes: a lightning bolt strikes Tychon himself (he loses 20% HP), then the bolt jumps to every enemy within 10 m of the die. 2 Black Cat: a giant black cat silhouette crosses the circle and every enemy inside is Cursed for 6 s (their abilities fail 1 time in 3). 3 Spilt Purse: gold coins rain down; allies inside heal 2.5x BA. 4 Four-Leaf Clover: every ally within 12 m has all skill cooldowns reset. 5 Full House: five giant cards slam down around the circle as walls, trapping enemies for 2.5 s. 6 Jackpot: the die explodes in a gold blast. The settled die stays as a decal of its top face for 3 s.
super.target_reaction: Snake Eyes: struck by chain lightning, shaking (electrified hit layer). Black Cat: a black cat glyph sits over their head, and failed casts puff out in smoke. Spilt Purse: allies glow gold as coins bounce off them. Clover: allies see their skill icons flash green. Full House: enemies stagger into the card walls. Jackpot: enemies are blasted into the air and land stunned, with gold pips orbiting their heads.
super.numbers: Range 14 m, tumble circle 8 m. 1: 2.0x BA to every enemy within 10 m, Tychon loses 20% HP. 2: Cursed 6 s (1 in 3 casts fail, refunding half the cooldown). 3: allies in 8 m heal 2.5x BA. 4: allies within 12 m reset all skill cooldowns. 5: card walls (2.0x BA HP each) trap the circle for 2.5 s, 1.5x BA. 6: 6.0x BA in 8 m, stun 1.5 s, and allies' supers gain 20% charge. If Sena is on the enemy team and within 10 m of the die, it always lands on 3 (the Fates won't let him win).
super.telegraph: Enemies see the red-rimmed 8 m tumble circle and the face as it lands, 0.5 s before the effect fires.
super.team_use: Every ally wants to be next to the die to push the roll up, which pulls the squad together for a big moment. Even a 1 hits the enemies; it just hits Tychon too.
super.cinematic: Tychon fishes in his coat and pulls out a chipped golden die, the one he lost his luck with. He kisses it, shakes it next to his ear, grins, and hurls it. Camera follows it as it booms down in the middle of the fight and starts tumbling, every face flashing. His allies rush in and blow on it, and each puff nudges a face higher. It slows. It wobbles on an edge. The whole arena holds its breath. Then it falls, and whatever it says happens: a jackpot that blasts everyone into the air, a house of giant cards, or, of course, lightning on Tychon's head.
super.charge: Rolls rolled: every die, card and roll he makes fills it; 6s give double, 1s give triple (he's owed). On his body, his pupils spin through faces faster and faster, and the gold laurel in his hair blooms more leaves. HUD: a golden die whose pips fill in.
super.counterplay: The 8 m tumble circle is shown for 1.5 s, and the result is shown 0.5 s before it fires: leave the circle, or kill the allies blowing on it (blows only count from allies within 6 m). An enemy Sena within 10 m fixes the roll at 3 (just a heal). Snake Eyes costs Tychon 20% HP, so he's vulnerable right after.

name: Aurvan
title: the Wyrm Who Ate the Moon
team_job: Pulls the whole enemy team into one place with moon-tides, so every area move his squad owns hits everyone. His kit changes as the arena's moon waxes and wanes.

basic.name: Moonfrost Breath
basic.cast: He draws a breath that makes the moon in his chest flare, then exhales through his teeth with his head low and his clawed hands spread. The breath is VFX from the mouth (head bone socket); the jaw doesn't need to move. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Shoot with both hands spread low and a head-forward exhale layer.
basic.projectile: A short cone of silver moonlight frost: pale crystals, drifting star motes and a cold mist, flecked with tiny crescent shapes.
basic.flight: A 40-degree cone, 6 m, rolling out at 12 m/s for 0.25 s. Crystals tumble and mist curls behind. Sound: a long cold exhale with a faint chime of ice.
basic.impact: Hoarfrost crescents on the ground in the cone, fading over 1 s.
basic.target_reaction: Victims hunch against the cold, rime forming on their shoulders (a frost shader patch), and they are pushed 0.5 m toward the cone's centre line.
basic.numbers: Cone 6 m by 40 degrees, 0.9x BA, pull 0.5 m toward the centre line, 0.9 attacks/s. Width and effect change with the moon phase (see passive).
basic.telegraph: Enemies see a faint red-rimmed cone for 0.1 s.
basic.team_use: Each breath gathers spread-out enemies into a tighter line for the squad's area damage.

basic.name: Moonfrost Breath
basic.cast: The same, turning his head across the other way as he breathes (a short head sweep).
basic.projectile: Same.
basic.flight: Same, sweeping 20 degrees across.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Wyrm's Exhale
basic.cast: He throws his head back, the moon in his chest blazing, and roars forward. Both clawed hands rake down as the breath comes out. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Enter (head back) into Spell_Simple_Shoot with a claw-rake arm layer.
basic.projectile: A dense cone of white-blue lunar fire, with a faint ghostly dragon jaw shape at its mouth (a jaw-silhouette billboard).
basic.flight: A 60-degree cone, 7 m, for 0.4 s. Sound: a dragon's roar layered under an old man's voice.
basic.impact: A frost-and-scorch cone decal, silver and dark blue, 2 s.
basic.target_reaction: Victims are Moonstruck: slowed 30% for 1.5 s with rime crawling up their legs, and pulled 1 m toward Aurvan.
basic.numbers: Cone 7 m by 60 degrees, 1.5x BA, slow 30% for 1.5 s, pull 1 m.
basic.team_use: Drags a whole group a step closer and slows them for the frontline to catch.

skills.name: Tidal Pull
skills.cast: He clenches a clawed fist toward a spot on the ground and pulls it back to his chest, as if hauling on the sea. The moon in his chest swells. Base: UAL MELEE_HOOK with an open-claw-to-fist hand layer.
skills.projectile: A small reflection of the moon: a pale silver orb that appears 2 m above the target point, with spiralling tide rings rippling out on the ground beneath it.
skills.flight: The orb appears instantly; tide rings spiral inward on the ground for 0.8 s. Everything inside slides toward the centre. Sound: a rising surf sound and a deep moon-hum.
skills.impact: A spiral tide decal of silver water lines for 1 s; puddles of water already on the ground (Wrenna, Sleeper) swell and deepen.
skills.target_reaction: Enemies are dragged 4 m toward the centre over 0.8 s, feet skidding, arms reaching back (a drag reaction), with silver tide rings around their ankles.
skills.numbers: Range 11 m, radius 5 m, pull up to 4 m toward the centre over 0.8 s, 1.2x BA. Cooldown 13 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed spiral and the orb for 0.3 s before the pull.
skills.team_use: The squad's cluster-maker: Wrenna's Sounding, Hespera's sun, Kallix's chain sparks and Hob's seventh toll all want a cluster.

skills.name: Too Big a Shadow
skills.cast: He spreads his arms wide as if they were wings, and his shadow stretches out ahead of him across the ground into the shape of a vast dragon. Base: UAL Spell_Simple_Enter with arms spread wide, held, then a forward sweep.
skills.projectile: His shadow: a huge dragon-shaped shadow decal (wings spread, 12 m long) that glides across the ground in the aimed direction. No wings exist on the mesh; the dragon is only the shadow.
skills.flight: The shadow glides 14 m forward at 10 m/s, wings beating (a 4-frame flipbook decal). Sound: huge wingbeats, though nothing is flying.
skills.impact: Nothing is left behind except a faint chill (a frosty trail decal, 1 s).
skills.target_reaction: Enemies the shadow passes over are Dreading: they cringe and look up at an empty sky (a look-up layer), are slowed 30% and deal 15% less damage for 2 s. Allies under it see a deep blue cool tint and are hidden from enemies more than 6 m away for 2 s.
skills.numbers: Shadow 12 m long and 6 m wide, travels 14 m. Enemies: slow 30% and -15% damage for 2 s. Allies: unseen beyond 6 m for 2 s. Cooldown 15 s.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see the shadow with a red rim at its edges.
skills.team_use: Covers the squad's approach (allies hidden) while weakening the enemies it crosses.

passive.name: Moon Phases
passive.effect: The arena's moon cycles through 4 phases every 60 s: New, Waxing, Full, Waning. New: his breath is a narrow 25-degree cone that blinds for 0.5 s. Waxing: Tidal Pull cooldown -3 s. Full: his breath widens to 60 degrees and every pull is 50% stronger. Waning: he heals 15% of damage he deals. Allied Fenwick grows stronger as the moon wanes, so their best fights fall in different phases.
passive.tell: The moon in his chest shows the phase (an animated emissive mask from dark to full) and his huge shadow is always visible on the ground under him: a dragon-shaped shadow decal three times his size that follows him.

super.name: Let the Moon Out
super.style: Pull / hook (arena-scale tide) into a slam
super.cast: He tears open the scales over his chest with both claws, and the first moon, the one he swallowed, rises out of him and up into the sky. It is alive, and it wants to see the world. For a few seconds he lets it.
super.projectile: The real first moon: a large glowing cream-white sphere with gentle craters and a slow pulse like breathing, rising from his chest and hanging over the target point 6 m up, with silver tide waves spiralling in toward the point below it.
super.flight: The moon rises along an arc from his chest to a target point up to 14 m away in 1.0 s. For 3 s it hangs there and everything within 12 m is pulled toward the point below it in strong tide waves, lifting enemies slightly off the ground so they float (a 0.5 m hover). Then Aurvan clenches his fist and calls it home: it drops onto the point and rolls back into his chest. Sound: a choir of a single high voice (the moon), rushing tides, then a deep thud.
super.impact: During the pull, the ground shows huge spiral tide lines of silver water. The final drop leaves a 6 m crater of silvery frost and moonlight for 3 s.
super.target_reaction: Enemies float helplessly toward the centre, their limbs drifting as if underwater (a float layer), with silver light on their faces. On the drop they're slammed down and stunned for 1.2 s. Allies in range see a soft moon-glow and the tide doesn't affect them.
super.numbers: Range 14 m, pull radius 12 m for 3 s (enemies dragged up to 8 m to the centre, can't dash or leap while floating), drop radius 6 m: 4.0x BA, stun 1.2 s. The moon has 4.0x BA HP while out; breaking it ends the pull and drops nothing. While the moon is out, Aurvan is Hollow: his chest goes dark, he takes 40% more damage and moves 30% slower.
super.telegraph: The moon rising is a 1.0 s warning, and the pull area shows a 12 m red-rimmed spiral. The drop point glows brighter 0.5 s before it falls.
super.team_use: Gathers the enemy team in one 6 m circle for 3 s and then stuns them: everything every ally has goes there. With Hespera, it's the Eclipse; with Fenwick, it fills half his super; with Wrenna, Sounding on the drop point is a guaranteed double-damage flood.
super.cinematic: Aurvan sinks his claws into the scales over his heart and pulls them open. Light pours out. Camera pulls back as the first moon, the one he swallowed before the sky had a reflection, rises out of his chest and floats up over the battlefield. For a moment the whole arena is lit silver. The tides answer it: every enemy within reach is lifted gently off their feet and drawn toward the point beneath it, drifting like swimmers. The old wyrm watches it, hollow-chested, with something like tenderness. Then he closes his fist, and the moon comes home, straight down through everyone beneath it.
super.charge: Tides turned: metres of enemy movement caused by his pulls fill it (each metre an enemy is pulled adds charge). On his body, the moon in his chest grows brighter and its glow spreads through the scales on his arms like moonlight on water. HUD: a moon icon that waxes to full.
super.counterplay: Shoot the moon: it has 4.0x BA HP, and breaking it ends the pull with no slam. Aurvan is Hollow while it's out (+40% damage taken, -30% speed): dive him. Enemies at the edge of the 12 m area can walk out against the tide (it's a strong pull, not a stun), and the drop point glows 0.5 s before the slam.

name: Ourax
title: the Titan Who Carries the Sky
team_job: A walking hill with a village on it: he shelters the squad under his corner of the sky, his villagers shoot from his shoulders, and his super hands the sky to an enemy.

basic.name: Brush Aside
basic.cast: Ourax fights with one hand: his left arm is always raised overhead, palm up, holding a corner of the sky (an additive pose layer applied on top of every clip, with a sky-patch VFX resting on his palm). His right hand makes a slow, huge backhand sweep at knee height, the way you'd brush crumbs off a table. Base: UAL Sword_Attack (horizontal) with an empty fist, retimed 20% slower, plus the left-arm-raised layer.
basic.projectile: His stone hand, and the turf it tears up: a fan of soil, grass clods and tiny wildflowers flung along the arc, with a pale dust swing-trail.
basic.flight: Arc of 150 degrees, 3.2 m reach, 0.35 s. Clods of turf fly outward 2 m. Sound: a deep grinding whoosh, like a landslide starting, and birds taking off from his shoulders.
basic.impact: A crescent of torn turf on the ground (decal, 2 s) with a few scattered clods.
basic.target_reaction: Enemies are knocked sideways 1 m and stumble, with grass and soil stuck to them.
basic.numbers: Range 3.2 m, arc 150 degrees, 1.0x BA, 0.75 hits/s.
basic.team_use: Wide, slow sweeps push divers off whoever is standing behind him.

basic.name: Brush Aside
basic.cast: The forehand return sweep. Base: Sword_Attack reversed, same left-arm layer.
basic.projectile: Same turf fan.
basic.flight: Same, other direction.
basic.impact: Same.
basic.target_reaction: Same, pushed the other way.
basic.numbers: Same as hit 1.
basic.team_use: Same as hit 1.

basic.name: Careful Stomp
basic.cast: He lifts one enormous foot very slowly, checks under it (a head-down layer, as if making sure no villager is there), and stamps. Base: UAL MELEE_JUMP_LAND (impact frames) with a slow one-leg lift layered in front, a 0.3 s hold at the top.
basic.projectile: A ring-shaped shockwave of rolling earth: the ground ripples outward like a rug being shaken, with grass flattening in a ring.
basic.flight: The ripple rolls out to 3 m in 0.25 s. Sound: a deep thud, and a tiny chapel bell ringing on his shoulder.
basic.impact: A footprint crater with a flattened-grass ring decal, 2 s.
basic.target_reaction: Enemies are knocked up 0.3 s and land slowed 25% for 1 s.
basic.numbers: Radius 3 m, 1.4x BA, knock-up 0.3 s, slow 25% for 1 s.
basic.telegraph: The raised foot and a red-rimmed 3 m ring for 0.3 s.
basic.team_use: A short knock-up for the squad to follow up on.

skills.name: Village Militia
skills.cast: He turns his head toward his right shoulder and murmurs something to the village. Tiny villagers pop up on the rooftops, the chapel bell clangs, and they all point at the target. Base: UAL Idle_Talking_Loop (head turned to the shoulder) into a pointing right arm from Spell_Simple_Shoot.
skills.projectile: A volley from the village: tiny flaming arrows, pitchforks, and stones from a little catapult in the market square, all launched from his shoulders. The villagers themselves are small billboard sprites (8-frame flipbooks) spawned on the shoulder-top terrain of his mesh.
skills.flight: For 4 s, a volley every 0.5 s arcs from his shoulders onto the target area: a scatter of 6 tiny projectiles per volley in high arcs (13 m/s), each with a little ember or dust trail. Sound: a tiny bell, little voices shouting Charge!, a creaky catapult.
skills.impact: Each volley peppers the area with small impacts: arrows sticking out of the ground and pitchforks quivering (decals and small meshes, 2 s).
skills.target_reaction: Enemies in the area flinch repeatedly from small hits, with tiny arrows stuck in them (sprite decals) and slowed 15% while in it.
skills.numbers: Range 12 m, area radius 3.5 m, lasts 4 s, 8 volleys of 0.3x BA each (2.4x BA total if a target stays in). Slow 15% inside. Cooldown 12 s. The militia can't fire while Ourax is knocked down or after his own Shrug.
skills.telegraph: Enemies see a red-rimmed target circle with a tiny bell icon.
skills.team_use: Area denial that keeps firing while Ourax body-blocks. Wrenna's cross-bearing marks show the militia where a slow target will be.

skills.name: Shrug
skills.cast: He rolls both shoulders up and lets them drop, a titan's shrug, careful to keep the raised hand steady. The whole village on his shoulders jumps and tumbles. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with a big shoulder-roll layer (both clavicles up 0.3 s, then dropped hard) and a knee dip.
skills.projectile: A circular earthquake: the ground cracks in a radial pattern and heaves up in rings around him, with dust and falling leaves.
skills.flight: Rings of heaving ground spread out from his feet to 7 m over 0.5 s. Sound: a rumbling earthquake, crockery breaking, and tiny villagers yelping.
skills.impact: A radial crack decal with lifted turf plates for 3 s.
skills.target_reaction: Every unit in range is knocked down for 1.0 s and rolls over, including Ourax's own allies (who get a short 0.4 s stumble instead) and his villagers (their sprites tumble and the militia stops for 3 s). Enemies are dazed with a ring of dust motes around their heads.
skills.numbers: Radius 7 m. Enemies: 1.6x BA, knock-down 1.0 s. Allies: stumble 0.4 s, no damage. Village Militia is disabled for 3 s. Cooldown 16 s.
skills.telegraph: A 0.4 s shoulder lift with red-rimmed ground rings for enemies and an amber warning ring for allies.
skills.team_use: A big group knock-down for the squad to follow up on, but it costs the militia and briefly trips your own team, so call it.

passive.name: They Think I'm a God
passive.effect: Under the Sky: allies within 4 m of Ourax take 25% less damage from lobbed projectiles and from area attacks that fall from above (his hand holds the sky over them). Prayer: when Ourax drops below 40% HP, the chapel on his shoulder rings and the villagers pray, healing him 15% max HP over 3 s (once every 45 s).
passive.tell: A soft blue sky-patch glows above his raised left palm and the 4 m shelter circle shows as a pale cloud-shadow on the ground. When Prayer is ready, a tiny golden light glows in the chapel window on his shoulder; when it triggers, tiny kneeling villager sprites appear on his shoulders.

super.name: Hold This for a Moment
super.style: Pull / hook into a two-handed rampage (transform)
super.cast: He has been looking for someone strong enough to take over his corner of the sky. He picks an enemy, leans down, and hands it to them. Then, for the first time in an age, he has two hands free.
super.projectile: His corner of the sky: a massive pale-blue slab of sky with clouds drifting through it and the faint shapes of stars (a large flattened dome mesh with a scrolling cloud shader), lowered from his palm onto the target enemy. Then Ourax with both fists free, each swing throwing up rock and turf.
super.flight: The sky slab slides from his left palm onto the target within 9 m over 0.6 s (a grab-and-place motion), pinning them. For 6 s Ourax uses two-handed attacks: a double-fisted hammer slam (3 m radius) every 1.2 s on the nearest enemy, his basic sweeps become full 360-degree spins. Meanwhile the villagers on his shoulders panic (tumbling sprites, little screams), because their sky is gone. Sound: a vast creak like the sky's hinges, a gasp from the villagers, then huge stone-on-stone slams.
super.impact: Under the slab: a cloud-shadow decal with cracks forming in the ground as the weight presses down. Each two-handed slam leaves a 3 m crater decal.
super.target_reaction: The target is Holding the Sky: knees buckling, both arms forced up overhead (a held-sky pose on the victim), rooted and unable to attack, taking crushing damage every second. Allies of the target can stand next to them and help hold it: each helper within 2 m is slowed 50% but halves the crush damage and cuts the duration by 1 s.
super.numbers: Range 9 m. Target pinned for up to 5 s (each helping enemy cuts it by 1 s): 0.8x BA per second crushing. If the target survives the full duration, they heave the sky back at Ourax: he is stunned for 1.0 s. Ourax two-handed for 6 s: slams 2.0x BA in 3 m every 1.2 s, +25% damage, his passive shelter is off and Village Militia is disabled.
super.telegraph: A 0.6 s red-rimmed slab shadow on the target as he lowers it.
super.team_use: Pins the enemy's best fighter (a tank or a diver), so the squad can collapse on the rest while Ourax smashes. Enemies who come to help their friend hold it are slowed and grouped together for Wrenna, Aurvan or Hespera.
super.cinematic: Ourax stops, looks at an enemy, and something like hope crosses his mossy face. He leans down very carefully and lowers his raised hand, and the corner of the sky comes down with it, a huge slab of blue with clouds drifting through, onto the enemy's shoulders. Their knees buckle. On Ourax's back the villagers look up at an empty space where the sky used to be and scream. Ourax looks at his two free hands, flexes them, and smiles for the first time in an age. Then he starts smashing.
super.charge: Weight carried: damage he absorbs while his allies are in his shelter, and allies protected by Under the Sky, fill it. On his body, the moss on his shoulders blooms with flowers and the sky patch above his palm grows from a small blue disc to a broad blue canopy. HUD: a raised-hand icon holding a cloud.
super.counterplay: Help your friend hold it: every enemy who stands within 2 m of the target halves the crush damage and cuts 1 s off the pin. If the target survives to the end, they throw the sky back and stun Ourax for 1 s. While two-handed, Ourax has no shelter passive and no militia, so ranged allies are exposed. The 0.6 s lowering can be dodged by dashing out of the shadow.

idle: Looks down at his shoulder, nudges a little falling cart back onto the road with a fingertip, and gently blows on the chapel to put out a chimney fire. Base: UAL Idle_Loop with the left-arm layer and right-hand fingertip layers.
hit: He rocks back and every tree on his shoulders sways; a villager sprite shakes a tiny fist at the attacker. Base: UAL Hit_Chest at 40% weight.
death: He sinks to one knee, then the other, keeping the left hand raised to the very end. The sky patch above it flickers as he slowly kneels and freezes like a mountain. The villagers' houses light their windows and the bell tolls. Base: UAL Death01 truncated at the kneel and frozen.
victory: He sits down very slowly and carefully, then lets a tiny villager climb onto his finger and holds it up to the sky. Base: UAL Sitting_Enter into Sitting_Idle_Loop.
